meaning: 英文字母表的第十二個字母，大寫為 L
sentences: The teacher wrote a large L on the board and asked the class to repeat its sound. 老師在黑板上寫了一個大寫字母，並請全班重複它的發音。
Her name begins with L, so she decorated the folder with that letter. 她的名字是以那個字母開頭，所以她用它裝飾資料夾。

meaning: 英文字母表的第十二個字母，小寫為 l
sentences: In some handwriting styles, the lowercase l looks almost like the number one. 在某些手寫體裡，小寫字母看起來幾乎像數字 1。
Please use a clear l so nobody confuses it with a capital I. 請把那個小寫字母寫清楚，免得別人把它和大寫 I 搞混。

meaning: 表示驚訝、強調或輕微感嘆的語氣詞
sentences: La, you finished the puzzle much faster than I expected. 哎呀，你完成那個拼圖的速度比我預期快多了。
La, I never thought we would meet again in this little town. 哎呀，我從沒想到我們會在這個小鎮再見面。

meaning: 防禦性營地；以車輛圍成的營寨
sentences: At dusk, the settlers formed a laager before the storm moved over the plain. 黃昏時，拓荒者在暴風雨越過平原前搭起了一個防禦性營地。
The guide explained how the wagons once stood in a laager for protection. 導覽員解釋過去馬車如何圍成營寨來防衛。

meaning: 陷阱坑；落穴陷阱
sentences: The old hunters covered the laang with leaves so animals would not notice it. 老獵人用樹葉把陷阱坑蓋起來，讓動物不會察覺。
We saw a drawing of a laang in a book about traditional hunting methods. 我們在一本介紹傳統狩獵方法的書裡看到落穴陷阱的圖。

meaning: 實驗室
sentences: The scientist is conducting a secret experiment in the lab. 科學家正在實驗室裡進行一項秘密實驗。
Students must wear safety goggles when working in the chemistry lab. 學生在化學實驗室工作時必須佩戴安全護目鏡。

meaning: 拉班；《聖經》中的人物，利亞與拉結的父親
sentences: In the story, Jacob worked for Laban before marrying Rachel. 在那個故事裡，雅各先為拉班工作，之後才娶了拉結。
The class discussed why Laban plays such an important role in Genesis. 老師帶著全班討論拉班在《創世記》中為何如此重要。

meaning: 拉巴魯姆軍旗的複數；多面基督軍旗
sentences: The museum catalog described two carved labara from a late Roman church. 博物館目錄記載了一座晚期羅馬教堂出土的兩面拉巴魯姆軍旗雕飾。
Historians compared the symbols on the labara to trace changes in imperial art. 歷史學家比較那些軍旗上的符號，以追查帝國藝術的變化。

meaning: 拉巴魯姆軍旗 (羅馬基督教軍旗)
sentences: Emperor Constantine adopted the labarum as his imperial standard. 君士坦丁大帝採用了拉巴魯姆軍旗作為他的帝國標準。
The labarum featured the Chi-Rho symbol representing Christ. 拉巴魯姆軍旗上有代表基督的 Chi-Rho 符號。

meaning: 大鼠豚；帕卡鼠
sentences: At night, the labba moved quietly through the forest undergrowth. 夜裡，那隻大鼠豚安靜地穿過森林下層植被。
The biologist set up a camera to record a labba near the riverbank. 生物學家在河岸旁架起相機，想拍到一隻大鼠豚。

meaning: 潑濕；濺濕
sentences: The passing cart labbered muddy water onto the stone wall. 經過的推車把泥水濺到了石牆上。
Do not labber the papers while you are washing the paintbrushes. 你洗畫筆時不要把文件潑濕了。

meaning: l音發音錯誤；l音過度使用
sentences: The speech therapist worked with the child to correct his labdacism. 語言治療師與孩子一起糾正他對 l 音的發音錯誤。
Labdacism is a rare phonological phenomenon in linguistics. l音發音錯誤是語言學中一種罕見的音韻現象。

meaning: l 音發音異常；labdacism 的另一種學術寫法
sentences: One footnote used the older term labdacismus instead of the more familiar spelling. 某條註腳用了較舊的寫法，而不是較常見的拼法。
Students compared labdacismus with other names for speech defects in classical grammar. 學生把這種 l 音發音異常和古典語法中其他言語缺陷名稱拿來比較。

meaning: 岩薔薇樹脂；用於香水的深色芳香油樹脂
sentences: The perfumer added a little labdanum to give the blend a warm, resinous depth. 調香師加了一點岩薔薇樹脂，讓香氣更溫暖而有樹脂感。
Ancient traders valued labdanum for its strong fragrance and sticky texture. 古代商人看重這種樹脂強烈的香氣與黏稠的質地。

meaning: 動搖；削弱；使衰敗
sentences: Corruption continued to labefact the foundation of the government. 貪腐持續動搖著政府的根基。
His confidence was labefacted by the repeated failures. 他的信心因接連的失敗而動搖了。

meaning: 衰敗；削弱；labefaction 的異體寫法
sentences: The historian described the labefactation of civic order after the revolt. 歷史學家描述了叛亂後公民秩序的衰敗。
Fear and hunger led to the slow labefactation of the settlement. 恐懼與飢餓導致那個聚落逐漸衰弱。

meaning: 動搖；衰敗；削弱
sentences: The labefaction of the old regime was evident after the riot. 暴動後，舊政權的衰敗顯而易見。
They feared the moral labefaction of the next generation. 他們擔心下一代的道德淪喪（動搖）。

meaning: 削弱；使衰退
sentences: A long drought can labefy even a well-managed farming town. 長期乾旱甚至會削弱一個管理良好的農業小鎮。
The critic argued that empty slogans only labefy serious debate. 那位評論者認為空洞口號只會削弱嚴肅的討論。

meaning: 標籤
sentences: Please read the information on the food label before you buy it. 購買前請閱讀食品標籤上的資訊。
The company is planning to launch a new line under its own label. 公司計劃推出自己品牌（標籤）下的新系列產品。

meaning: 貼標籤的人；貼標機
sentences: The factory installed a new labeler to speed up the packaging line. 工廠裝了一台新的貼標機來加快包裝線速度。
She worked as the final labeler before the boxes were shipped out. 在箱子運出前，她負責最後貼上標籤。

meaning: 唇瓣；labellum 的複數
sentences: Under the microscope, the botanist compared the shape of the labella in several orchid species. 植物學家在顯微鏡下比較了幾種蘭花唇瓣的形狀。
The field notes mentioned unusually bright labella on the mountain orchids. 田野筆記提到那些高山蘭有格外鮮明的唇瓣。

meaning: 具唇瓣的
sentences: The botanist described the flower as labellate because of its prominent lip-like petal. 植物學家把那朵花描述為具唇瓣的，因為它有顯著的唇狀花瓣。
A labellate structure often makes the orchid easier to identify in the field. 具唇瓣的構造往往讓這種蘭花更容易在野外辨認。

meaning: 貼標籤的人；貼標機
sentences: The small shop uses a hand-held labeller for price tags. 那家小店用手持貼標機來貼價格標籤。
When the labeller jammed, the workers had to stop the line for a few minutes. 貼標機卡住時，工人只好讓產線停了幾分鐘。

meaning: 似唇瓣的
sentences: The insect had a labelloid plate that resembled a tiny orchid lip. 那隻昆蟲有一片似唇瓣的小板狀構造，看起來像微小的蘭花唇瓣。
Researchers noted a labelloid outgrowth near the center of the flower. 研究人員注意到花朵中央附近有一個似唇瓣的突起。

meaning: 唇瓣；蘭花中特化而明顯的花瓣
sentences: The orchid's labellum guided insects toward the flower's center. 那株蘭花的唇瓣把昆蟲引向花朵中央。
She sketched the labellum to show how different it looked from the other petals. 她畫下唇瓣，顯示它和其他花瓣有多麼不同。

meaning: 唇部；陰唇；labium 的複數
sentences: The anatomy chart labels the inner and outer labia clearly for students. 那張解剖圖為學生清楚標出了內外陰唇。
Doctors explained how the labia protect the more delicate tissues nearby. 醫師解釋了陰唇如何保護周圍較脆弱的組織。

meaning: 唇的；以雙唇或嘴唇發出的
sentences: The teacher demonstrated how a labial sound uses the lips more than the tongue. 老師示範了唇音如何比舌頭更依賴嘴唇來發音。
In the video, the speaker exaggerated each labial consonant for beginners. 影片裡，講者把每個唇音子音都刻意說得很明顯，方便初學者學習。

meaning: 唇音替代錯誤；以一種唇音代替另一種唇音的語音缺陷
sentences: The speech therapist recognized the child's labialism during the reading exercise. 語言治療師在朗讀練習時察覺到那名孩子的唇音替代問題。
The article distinguishes labialism from other articulation disorders. 那篇文章把這種唇音替代錯誤和其他構音障礙區分開來。

meaning: 唇部過度參與的構音障礙；特別指過度使用雙唇發音
sentences: The clinician described the patient's labialismus as a persistent articulation problem. 臨床醫師把那位病人的這種構音障礙描述成持續性的問題。
Careful training helped reduce the labialismus in several consonant sounds. 細緻的訓練幫助幾個子音的唇部過度發音情況減輕了。

meaning: 唇音性；唇部特徵
sentences: The phonetics lecture focused on the labiality of certain consonants. 那堂語音學課聚焦在某些子音的唇音性。
Researchers measured the labiality of the sound by studying lip movement. 研究人員透過觀察嘴唇動作來測量那個聲音的唇音特徵。

meaning: 唇化；使發音帶有圓唇特徵的過程
sentences: The chart shows when labialization happens during the production of the consonant. 那張圖表顯示了這個子音在什麼時候會出現唇化。
A slight labialization changed the sound enough for the students to notice. 輕微的唇化就讓學生聽出那個聲音有明顯差異。

meaning: 使唇化；使帶有圓唇發音特徵
sentences: Some speakers naturally labialize the consonant before a rounded vowel. 有些說話者在圓唇母音前會自然把那個子音唇化。
The coach asked the actor not to labialize the sound too strongly. 指導老師請那位演員不要把那個聲音唇化得太明顯。

meaning: 以唇音方式；藉由嘴唇地
sentences: The sound is produced labially, so the lips must close at the right moment. 那個聲音是以唇音方式產生的，所以嘴唇必須在正確時刻閉合。
He pronounced the consonant too labially for the target accent. 他把那個子音說得太偏唇音了，不符合目標口音。

meaning: 唇形科的舊學名；成員包括薄荷、羅勒與鼠尾草
sentences: Older botany books call the mint family Labiatae. 較舊的植物學書籍把薄荷科稱為唇形科。
Because basil belongs to Labiatae, its stem is square. 羅勒屬於唇形科，因此莖呈方形。

meaning: 唇形的；花冠或萼片呈上下兩唇狀的
sentences: The botanist pointed out the labiate corolla of the tiny purple flower. 植物學家指出那朵紫色小花具有唇形花冠。
A labiate blossom often helps pollinators land in a predictable way. 唇形花朵往往能讓授粉昆蟲以可預測的方式停落。

meaning: 具唇狀構造的；呈唇形的
sentences: The wild flower has a labiated petal that attracts bees. 這種野花的瓣片呈唇狀，會吸引蜜蜂。
The biologist noticed a labiated opening on the rare plant. 生物學家注意到這株稀有植物上有一個唇形開口。

meaning: 具鉗狀附屬物的；帶有夾鉗構造的
sentences: The fossil insect showed a labidophorous tail with clear forceps-like appendages. 那個昆蟲化石呈現出具鉗狀附屬物的尾端構造。
Under magnification, the segment looked distinctly labidophorous to the entomologist. 在放大觀察下，那個節段在昆蟲學家眼中明顯帶有鉗狀構造。

meaning: 鉗耳蠼屬；耳夾蟲的一個分類屬
sentences: The specimen was identified as Labidura after the forceps and wing covers were examined. 研究人員檢查尾鉗與翅鞘後，將這個標本鑑定為鉗耳蠼屬。
One famous extinct giant earwig belonged to the genus Labidura. 一種著名的已滅絕巨型耳夾蟲就屬於鉗耳蠼屬。

meaning: 鉗耳蠼科；耳夾蟲的一個科
sentences: Several striped earwigs in the collection belong to the family Labiduridae. 館藏中的幾隻條紋耳夾蟲屬於鉗耳蠼科。
The paper reviews how Labiduridae species are distributed across warm regions. 那篇論文回顧了鉗耳蠼科物種在溫暖地區的分布情形。

meaning: 下咽片；昆蟲口器中的一部分
sentences: The diagram labels the labiella near the center of the insect's mouthparts. 那張圖把下咽片標在昆蟲口器中央附近。
Students compared the labiella of two species under the stereo microscope. 學生在實體顯微鏡下比較了兩種昆蟲的下咽片。

meaning: 不穩定的；容易變化或分解的
sentences: The compound is too labile to remain intact at room temperature. 那個化合物太不穩定，無法在室溫下保持完整。
Her mood seemed labile after several sleepless nights. 幾個失眠夜之後，她的情緒顯得很容易波動。

meaning: 不穩定性；易變性
sentences: The thermal lability of the protein made the experiment difficult to repeat. 這種蛋白質的熱不穩定性讓實驗很難重複。
Emotional lability can become obvious when someone is under severe stress. 一個人承受巨大壓力時，情緒易變性可能會變得很明顯。

meaning: 使不穩定的過程；活化為易反應狀態的過程
sentences: The chemist observed rapid labilization after the solution was heated. 化學家觀察到溶液加熱後很快出現不穩定化。
This catalyst promotes the labilization of the metal complex. 這種催化劑會促進金屬錯合物的不穩定化。

meaning: 使不穩定；使變得容易反應
sentences: A small change in pH can labilize the bond and start the reaction. 酸鹼值的一點變化就可能使那個鍵不穩定並啟動反應。
The treatment was designed to labilize the complex before separation. 這項處理是為了在分離前先使該錯合物變得不穩定。

meaning: 唇齒槽的；涉及嘴唇與齒槽脊發音的
sentences: The therapist noted a labioalveolar articulation in the child's distorted consonant. 治療師注意到那名孩子失真的子音帶有唇齒槽發音特徵。
A labioalveolar sound uses the lower lip against the alveolar ridge. 唇齒槽音會用下唇接觸齒槽脊來發音。

meaning: 唇側與牙頸部的；與唇面及牙頸有關的
sentences: The dentist pointed out a shallow labiocervical groove on the front tooth. 牙醫指出那顆前牙有一道淺淺的唇側牙頸溝。
Students traced the labiocervical line while studying tooth morphology. 學生在學習牙齒形態時描畫了唇側牙頸線。

meaning: 唇齒的；用嘴唇與牙齒發出的
sentences: The sounds f and v are labiodental in English. 在英語裡，f 和 v 都是唇齒音。
The teacher showed how the lower lip touches the upper teeth in a labiodental sound. 老師示範唇齒音是如何以下唇碰觸上齒來發出的。

meaning: 唇舌的；與嘴唇和舌頭有關的
sentences: The doctor recorded a labioglossal weakness after the nerve injury. 神經受損後，醫師記錄到唇舌功能變弱。
A labioglossal exercise can improve coordination between the lips and tongue. 唇舌訓練有助於改善嘴唇與舌頭的協調。

meaning: 唇舌喉的；與嘴唇、舌頭及喉部有關的
sentences: The report describes a rare labioglossolaryngeal paralysis after surgery. 報告描述了一種術後罕見的唇舌喉麻痺。
Therapy focused on restoring labioglossolaryngeal control during speech. 治療重點放在恢復說話時的唇舌喉控制。

meaning: 唇舌咽的；與嘴唇、舌頭及咽部有關的
sentences: The patient showed labioglossopharyngeal weakness when swallowing water. 病人在吞水時出現唇舌咽部無力的現象。
The specialist tested the labioglossopharyngeal muscles during the exam. 專科醫師在檢查時測試了唇舌咽相關肌群。

meaning: 唇動記錄器；記錄嘴唇動作的儀器
sentences: The labiograph traced each lip movement during pronunciation. 唇動記錄器描出發音時的每個嘴唇動作。
A speech clinic once used a labiograph to compare vowel shapes. 語音診所曾用唇動記錄器比較母音的嘴形。

meaning: 唇喉的；在喉部發出並受嘴唇形狀影響的
sentences: The old grammar book grouped the sound with other labioguttural consonants. 那本老語法書把那個聲音歸入其他唇喉音之中。
He practiced the labioguttural articulation slowly in front of a mirror. 他對著鏡子慢慢練習那個唇喉發音。

meaning: 唇舌的；同時與嘴唇和舌頭有關的
sentences: Labiolingual sounds can seem hard at first. 唇舌音一開始可能聽起來很難。
Labiolingual movement helps the baby make that sound. 唇與舌的動作幫那個寶寶發出那個聲音。

meaning: 觀唇占卜；藉由嘴唇形態或動作占卜
sentences: Labiomancy once appeared in old folk tales. 觀唇占卜曾出現在古老民間故事裡。
Labiomancy gave her aunt a strange sense of fate. 觀唇占卜讓她阿姨對命運有種奇怪的感覺。

meaning: 與嘴唇和下巴有關
sentences: The doctor checked the labiomental area for any swelling. 醫生檢查了嘴唇與下巴之間的區域是否有腫脹。
Surgery was needed to repair the labiomental fold after the accident. 事故發生後，需要手術來修復唇頦溝。

meaning: 唇鼻的；同時與嘴唇和鼻子有關的
sentences: Labionasal pain made him touch his face all day. 唇鼻部的疼痛讓他整天一直摸臉。
Labionasal swelling looked smaller after the ice pack. 唇鼻部的腫脹在冰敷後看起來比較小。

meaning: 唇顎的；發音時同時涉及嘴唇與硬顎的
sentences: Labiopalatal sounds are rare in daily speech. 唇顎音在日常說話裡很少見。
Labiopalatal action rounded her lips and raised her tongue. 唇顎動作讓她雙唇收圓並抬起舌頭。

meaning: 使成為唇顎音；使發音同時帶有雙唇與硬顎特徵
sentences: Labiopalatalize this vowel slightly for a softer sound. 把這個母音稍微唇顎化，聲音會更柔和。
Labiopalatalize the word gently, and your mouth will relax. 輕輕把這個字唇顎化，你的嘴部會更放鬆。

meaning: 唇顎的；與嘴唇和上顎有關的
sentences: Labiopalatine surgery helped the baby drink milk more easily. 唇顎手術讓那個嬰兒更容易喝奶。
Labiopalatine changes can affect how a child speaks. 唇顎部位的變化可能影響孩子說話。

meaning: 唇咽的；與嘴唇和咽部有關的
sentences: Labiopharyngeal movement matters when a singer shapes a clear sound. 唇部與咽部的動作會影響歌手發出清楚的聲音。
Labiopharyngeal tension made her voice sound tight. 唇部與咽部的緊繃讓她的聲音聽起來很卡。

meaning: 陰唇整形術；labiaplasty 的變體拼法

sentences: Labyrinthical halls led me back to the lobby again. 迷宮般的走廊讓我又繞回大廳。
Labyrinthical steps turned a simple task into a long delay. 繁複曲折的步驟讓簡單的事拖了很久。

meaning: 像走迷宮般地；曲折複雜地
sentences: Labyrinthically the hallway twists past three locked doors. 那條走廊彎彎繞繞，經過三扇鎖住的門。
Labyrinthically our old mall sends shoppers in circles. 那間老商場的動線像迷宮一樣，讓人一直繞圈。

meaning: 迷鰓魚類；舊分類中的攀鱸類魚群
sentences: Labyrinthici appears in older books about tropical fish. 這個舊分類名稱常見於早期的熱帶魚書籍。
Labyrinthici once grouped gouramis with climbing perch. 這個舊魚類分類曾把絲足鱸和攀鱸歸在一起。

meaning: 迷宮狀的；曲折盤繞的
sentences: Labyrinthiform cracks spread across the dry mud. 乾掉的泥地上裂出迷宮般的紋路。
Labyrinthiform streets made the old town hard to navigate. 那座老城的街道像迷宮一樣，很難認路。

meaning: 迷宮似的；錯綜複雜的
sentences: Labyrinthine alleys hid a tiny noodle shop. 迷宮般的小巷裡藏著一間小麵店。
Labyrinthine rules turned a simple task into a headache. 錯綜複雜的規定把一件簡單的事弄得很麻煩。

meaning: 迷路炎；內耳迷路發炎
sentences: Labyrinthitis made her feel dizzy all morning. 迷路炎讓她整個早上都頭暈。
Labyrinthitis can upset balance after an ear infection. 迷路炎可能在耳朵感染後影響平衡感。

meaning: 迷齒龍；舊稱的一類古代兩棲動物
sentences: Labyrinthodon lived in swamps long before people appeared. 迷齒龍早在人類出現之前就住在沼澤裡。
Labyrinthodon had broad teeth that left a strange pattern. 迷齒龍有寬大的牙齒，留下奇特的紋路。

meaning: 牙齒具有迷宮般的內部結構
sentences: Scientists found a labyrinthodont fossil near the ancient riverbed. 科學家在古老河床附近發現了一具迷齒類動物的化石。
The labyrinthodont features are unique to these extinct amphibians. 迷齒類的特徵是這些已滅絕兩棲動物所獨有的。

meaning: 迷齒亞綱；古代大型兩棲動物類群
sentences: Labyrinthodonta includes many ancient amphibians with heavy bodies. 迷齒亞綱包含許多身體厚重的古代兩棲動物。
Labyrinthodonta once dominated wet land near rivers and lakes. 迷齒亞綱曾主宰河邊與湖邊的潮濕地帶。

meaning: 迷齒類動物
sentences: Labyrinthodontian fossils often show a wide skull and strong jaw. 迷齒類化石常可見寬大的頭骨和有力的下顎。
Labyrinthodontian young likely stayed close to shallow water. 迷齒類幼體很可能待在淺水附近。

meaning: 迷齒類成員；迷齒類動物
sentences: Labyrinthodontid bones were found under dark, wet soil. 一具迷齒類動物的骨頭在陰濕的土下被發現。
Labyrinthodontid remains can be large for an early amphibian. 這類早期兩棲動物的遺骸可能相當大。

meaning: 迷齒類的；似迷齒類的
sentences: Labyrinthodontoid teeth show deep folded lines inside. 迷齒類型的牙齒內部可見很深的摺疊紋。
Labyrinthodontoid features made the old fossil easy to sort. 類似迷齒類的特徵讓那塊古老化石很容易分類。

meaning: 網狀黏菌所屬的分類屬
sentences: Labyrinthula forms threadlike networks across decaying sea grass. 這種網狀黏菌在腐爛海草上形成絲狀網絡。
A Labyrinthula infection can damage the leaves of eelgrass. 這種黏菌感染可能損傷海草的葉片。

meaning: 包含網狀黏菌的分類科
sentences: Labyrinthulidae contains organisms that spread through fine filaments. 這個分類科包含靠細絲擴散的生物。
Members of Labyrinthulidae often live on marine plant material. 這個分類科的成員常生活在海洋植物材料上。

meaning: 紫膠；蟲膠；（南亞）十萬
sentences: Lac still gives old bracelets a warm red shine. 紫膠仍讓老手環帶著溫暖的紅色光澤。
Lac means one hundred thousand in some South Asian places. 在一些南亞地區，這個詞表示十萬。

meaning: 紫膠；蟲膠
sentences: Lacca once colored small beads sold at the night market. 紫膠曾替夜市販售的小珠子染上顏色。
Lacca can harden into a glossy coat on wood. 紫膠可以硬化成木器上的亮面塗層。

meaning: 紫膠染料的
sentences: Laccaic red dye stained her fingers after the craft sale. 紫膠紅染料在手作攤後把她的手指染紅了。
Laccaic pigment gave the cloth a deep crimson tone. 紫膠色素讓那塊布呈現深紅色調。

meaning: 紫膠酸的
sentences: Laccainic acid gives the dye its bright red color. 紫膠酸讓那種染料呈現鮮紅色。
Laccainic compounds were listed on the old factory label. 舊工廠標籤上列出了紫膠酸類化合物。

meaning: 植物和微生物中的含銅氧化酶
sentences: Laccase helps fungi break down complex compounds in wood. 漆酶幫助真菌分解木材中的複合化合物。
The dye maker added laccase to the plant-based mixture. 染料製作者把漆酶加入植物材料混合物。

meaning: 漆樹汁中的有毒酚類物質
sentences: Laccol in fresh lacquer sap can irritate bare skin. 生漆汁裡的有毒酚類物質會刺激裸露皮膚。
Laccol may cause a rash after direct contact. 直接接觸後，這種物質可能引起紅疹。

meaning: 岩蓋；使上覆岩層鼓起的穹狀火成岩體
sentences: Laccolith shapes this low hill near town. 岩蓋形成了鎮外這座低矮的小山。
Laccolith bodies can lift rock layers slowly. 岩蓋體會慢慢把岩層往上頂起。

meaning: 岩蓋狀的；與岩蓋有關的
sentences: Laccolithic ridges rise gently behind the road. 岩蓋狀的山脊在道路後方緩緩隆起。
Laccolithic rock forms a broad dome here. 這裡的岩石形成寬闊的穹丘狀構造。

meaning: 岩蓋狀的；與岩蓋有關的
sentences: Laccolitic layers make the hillside look swollen. 岩蓋狀的地層讓山坡看起來鼓鼓的。
Laccolitic growth pushed the older beds upward. 岩蓋狀的侵入作用把較老的岩層往上推。

meaning: 蕾絲
sentences: She wore a beautiful white dress decorated with delicate silk lace. 她穿了一件裝飾著精緻絲綢蕾絲的漂亮白洋裝。
Please remember to lace up your shoes tightly before you start running. 跑步前請記得把鞋帶繫緊。

meaning: 蕾絲窗簾；可透光但能稍微遮擋視線的薄窗簾
sentences: Lace curtain lets soft light into the room. 蕾絲窗簾讓柔和的光照進房間。
Lace curtain moves when the window is open. 窗子打開時，蕾絲窗簾會輕輕晃動。

meaning: 繫帶式的
sentences: Lace-up shoes take longer to put on. 繫帶鞋要花比較久的時間穿好。
Lace-up boots felt better after one more knot. 繫帶靴多綁一個結後穿起來更舒服。

meaning: 紐西蘭霍赫里亞屬的樹木
sentences: Lacebark has a patterned inner bark that resembles woven lace. 紐西蘭霍赫里亞的內樹皮帶有像編織蕾絲的圖案。
A lacebark tree shaded the path beside the stream. 一棵紐西蘭霍赫里亞樹替溪邊小路遮蔭。

meaning: 摻了某種物質的；被加料的
sentences: Laced coffee made him feel strange all night. 加了料的咖啡讓他整晚都覺得怪怪的。
Laced candy sent the boy straight to bed. 摻了東西的糖果讓那個男孩立刻倒床休息。

meaning: 拉栖代夢的；斯巴達的
sentences: Lacedaemonian soldiers marched in silence before dawn. 斯巴達士兵在黎明前安靜行軍。
Lacedaemonian customs shaped his plain way of living. 斯巴達的習俗塑造了他簡樸的生活方式。

meaning: 花序或花朵外觀像蕾絲的多種植物
sentences: The laceflower opened into a delicate white umbel. 蕾絲花開成精緻的白色傘形花序。
Bees gathered around the laceflower in the meadow. 蜜蜂聚集在草地上的蕾絲花周圍。

meaning: 花燭的一種；網葉花燭
sentences: Laceleaf grows well by the window with gentle light. 網葉花燭放在窗邊柔和光線下長得很好。
Laceleaf needs warm water and a little care each week. 網葉花燭每週需要溫水和一點照顧。

meaning: 無鞋帶的
sentences: Laceless shoes are handy when I rush out the door. 無鞋帶的鞋子在我趕著出門時很方便。
Laceless sneakers felt loose after the long walk. 那雙無鞋帶的運動鞋走了很久後感覺有點鬆。

meaning: 像蕾絲的
sentences: Lacelike patterns covered the glass after the cold night. 寒冷的一夜過後，玻璃上布滿了像蕾絲的花紋。
Lacelike shadows danced on the wall at sunset. 日落時，牆上晃動著像蕾絲的影子。

meaning: 製作蕾絲的人
sentences: Lacemaker my aunt visits every spring fair. 做蕾絲的人每年春天都會來逛市集。
Lacemaker with calm hands fixed the torn veil. 那位手很穩的蕾絲工匠把破掉的頭紗修好了。

meaning: 蕾絲製作；編製蕾絲的工藝
sentences: Lacemaking by hand takes patience and good light. 手工製作蕾絲需要耐心和充足的光線。
Lacemaking at home became her quiet evening hobby. 在家編製蕾絲成了她晚上安靜的小嗜好。

meaning: 男性蕾絲商人
sentences: Laceman near the corner shop knows every old pattern. 街角店旁的那位男蕾絲商人很懂各種老花樣。
Laceman with a red tie opened the market stall early. 繫紅領帶的男蕾絲商人很早就把攤位打開了。

meaning: 一片蕾絲；花邊片
sentences: Lacepiece on her collar made the plain dress softer. 她領口上的那片花邊讓素色洋裝看起來更柔和。
Lacepiece from the old box still looked clean and fine. 舊盒子裡那片蕾絲看起來仍然乾淨又精緻。

meaning: 白花碎米薺；流蘇果莢草
sentences: Lacepod in the yard grew tiny white flowers after rain. 院子裡那株白花碎米薺下雨後開出了小白花。
Lacepod along the path spread quickly before summer came. 小路旁的流蘇果莢草在夏天來之前很快就長開了。

meaning: 繫帶者；綁帶物
sentences: Lacer on old boots broke this morning. 舊靴上的鞋帶今天早上斷了。
Lacer for my apron came loose at lunch. 我圍裙的綁帶在午餐時鬆開了。

meaning: 可撕裂性
sentences: Lacerability of thin paper causes trouble at home. 薄紙容易破裂，讓家裡使用時很麻煩。
Lacerability in that soft bag worries me. 那個軟袋子很容易裂開，讓我有點擔心。

meaning: 可撕裂的；易裂的
sentences: Lacerable plastic wraps tear before I open them. 那種容易裂的塑膠包裝常常還沒打開就破了。
Lacerable fabric on this seat needs care. 這張椅子上的布料很容易裂開，需要小心。

meaning: 撕裂的；造成割傷的
sentences: Lacerant edges on the can cut skin fast. 罐頭邊緣很割手，一下就會劃傷皮膚。
Lacerant wire by the fence looks unsafe. 籬笆旁那條會割傷人的鐵絲看起來不安全。

meaning: 撕裂；割傷
sentences: Lacerate your hand on that sharp lid and you will bleed. 手要是被那個尖蓋子割傷，就會流血。
Lacerate the bag with one pull and the fruit spills out. 袋子一拉就被扯裂，水果全掉了出來。

meaning: 被撕裂的；有裂傷的
sentences: Lacerated skin near my knee stung in the shower. 我膝蓋附近裂傷的皮膚在洗澡時一陣刺痛。
Lacerated edges on the paper cut his thumb fast. 那張紙邊緣裂開得很毛，馬上割傷了他的拇指。

meaning: 尖刻地；刻薄地
sentences: Lacerately sharp words at dinner made the room go quiet. 晚餐時那些刻薄的話讓整個房間安靜下來。
Lacerately cruel jokes online left her in tears. 網路上那些尖酸的玩笑讓她哭了。

meaning: 裂傷；撕裂傷口
sentences: Laceration on his palm needed three small stitches. 他手掌上的裂傷需要縫三針。
Laceration after the fall kept bleeding through the bandage. 跌倒後的裂傷一直滲血，把紗布都弄濕了。

meaning: 造成撕裂的；尖刻傷人的
sentences: Lacerative remarks during lunch ruined her good mood. 午餐時那些傷人的話破壞了她的好心情。
Lacerative force from the broken glass tore the bag open. 碎玻璃造成的撕裂力量把袋子劃開了。

meaning: 蜥蜴座
sentences: Lacerta hangs above the roof on clear autumn nights. 秋天晴朗的夜晚，蜥蜴座會掛在屋頂上方。
Lacerta appeared between two faint stars after midnight. 午夜過後，蜥蜴座出現在兩顆暗星之間。

meaning: 天蜥座的拉丁屬格，用於恆星名稱
sentences: Lacertae appears after Alpha on the old star map. 在那張老星圖上，這個拉丁屬格寫在 Alpha 後面。
Lacertae marks the star as part of that northern constellation. 這個詞表示那顆星屬於北天的天蜥座。

meaning: 蜥蜴的；似蜥蜴的
sentences: Lacertian skin looks dry and patterned in the sun. 像蜥蜴的皮膚在陽光下看起來乾乾的，還帶有花紋。
Lacertian movements made the tiny pet seem alert. 像蜥蜴般的動作讓那隻小寵物看起來很警覺。

meaning: 蜥蜴科的蜥蜴
sentences: A Lacertid darted between two sun-warmed stones. 一隻蜥蜴科蜥蜴在兩塊曬熱的石頭間竄過。
The Lacertid raised its head when the shadow passed. 那隻蜥蜴科蜥蜴在影子掠過時抬起頭。

meaning: 有鱗目中的真正蜥蜴分類科
sentences: Lacertidae includes many swift lizards of Eurasia and Africa. 這個科包含歐亞與非洲許多行動迅速的蜥蜴。
Several Lacertidae species bask on open rocks. 這個科的數種蜥蜴在裸露岩石上曬太陽。

meaning: 蜥蜴形的；似蜥蜴的
sentences: Lacertiform toys filled the shop window last summer. 去年夏天，店家的櫥窗裡擺滿了蜥蜴形的玩具。
Lacertiform shadows slid across the warm rock. 像蜥蜴的影子滑過溫熱的岩石。

meaning: 有鱗目中的蜥蜴分類亞目
sentences: Lacertilia groups lizards by their shared body form. 這個蜥蜴分類亞目依共同體形把蜥蜴歸類。
Snakes and Lacertilia differ in limbs and eyelids. 蛇類與蜥蜴分類亞目成員在四肢和眼瞼上不同。

meaning: 與爬行動物亞目Lacertilia有關。
sentences: The zoo added a new lacertilian exhibit featuring exotic lizards. 動物園增加了一個新的蜥蜴類展覽，展示各種奇特的蜥蜴。
Biologists study lacertilian behavior to understand how reptiles adapt to the desert. 生物學家研究蜥蜴類的行為，以了解爬蟲類如何適應沙漠。

meaning: 似蜥蜴的；蜥蜴類的
sentences: Lacertiloid features gave the costume a wild look. 類蜥蜴的特徵讓那套服裝看起來很狂野。
Lacertiloid shapes on the wall caught my eye first. 牆上那些像蜥蜴的形狀最先吸引了我的目光。

meaning: 似蜥蜴的；蜥蜴般的
sentences: Lacertine feet gripped the branch without a sound. 蜥蜴般的腳安靜地抓住樹枝。
Lacertine grace showed in the creature's quick turn. 那生物迅速轉身時顯出蜥蜴般的靈巧。

meaning: 蜥蜴亞目的任何成員；似蜥蜴的
sentences: A lacertoid reptile warmed itself on the flat roof. 一隻蜥蜴類爬蟲在平屋頂上取暖。
The fossil has a lacertoid skull with broad jaw muscles. 這塊化石有一個似蜥蜴、下顎肌肉寬大的頭骨。

meaning: 肌肉發達的
sentences: Lacertose shoulders filled the old T-shirt. 那件舊T恤被結實的肩膀撐得很滿。
Lacertose legs carried him upstairs with ease. 他靠著強壯的雙腿輕鬆走上樓。

meaning: 蕾絲花邊；網狀飾紋
sentences: Lacery around the collar made the dress look soft. 領口周圍的蕾絲花邊讓這件洋裝看起來很柔和。
Lacery on the window cast pretty shapes on the floor. 窗上的網狀花紋在地板上投下好看的影子。

meaning: 小飾帶；細繩
sentences: Lacet on her hat fluttered in the warm wind. 她帽子上的小飾帶在暖風中飄動。
Lacet by the gift box came loose after lunch. 禮盒旁的細繩在午餐後鬆開了。

meaning: 神經翅目中具有薄翅的昆蟲
sentences: A lacewing settled on the porch light after midnight. 午夜後，一隻草蛉停在門廊燈上。
The lacewing's clear wings showed a web of fine veins. 那隻草蛉的透明翅膀呈現細密脈絡。

meaning: 蕾絲女工；販售蕾絲的婦女
sentences: Lacewoman by the market smiled and showed us her work. 市集旁的蕾絲女工微笑著拿作品給我們看。
Lacewoman near the corner shop fixed my torn cuff fast. 轉角店旁那位賣蕾絲的婦女很快就補好了我破掉的袖口。

meaning: 蕾絲紋木材
sentences: Lacewood on this table glows warmly in the sun. 這張桌子的蕾絲紋木材在陽光下泛著溫暖光澤。
Lacewood in their hallway gives the home a rich look. 走廊裡的那種花紋木材讓整個家顯得很有質感。

meaning: 蕾絲花邊；鏤空花紋
sentences: Lacework on the curtain made the room feel softer. 窗簾上的蕾絲花邊讓房間感覺更柔和。
Lacework around her collar looked old but beautiful. 她領口周圍的鏤空花紋看起來舊舊的，卻很漂亮。

meaning: 花邊工匠；編織蕾絲的人
sentences: Laceworker by the window moved her hands very quickly. 窗邊那位編織花邊的人手動得非常快。
Laceworker in this shop still makes each piece by hand. 這家店裡的花邊工匠仍然一件一件親手製作。

meaning: 纖維狀樹皮的樹；紙皮樹類植物
sentences: Laceybark in our yard sheds thin strips after rain. 我們院子裡那棵紙皮樹下雨後會脫落細細的樹皮。
Laceybark near the gate gives light shade in summer. 大門旁那棵纖維樹皮的樹在夏天會帶來淡淡的樹蔭。

meaning: 懈怠的；鬆懈的；怯懦的
sentences: Lache habits at work soon caused small mistakes. 工作上鬆懈的習慣很快就造成了一些小錯誤。
Lache in danger, he hid behind the door. 面對危險時他顯得怯懦，躲到了門後。

meaning: 含多種球莖植物的分類屬
sentences: Lachenalia sent up striped flowers from a small bulb. 這種球莖植物從小球莖抽出條紋花朵。
A gardener planted Lachenalia in a sunny pot. 園丁把這種植物種在向陽盆中。

meaning: 權利懈怠抗辯；因延誤而喪失權利

meaning: 淑女風範；端莊嫻雅的舉止。

Within the poem ladylikeness hides a stubborn streak. 在那首詩裡，端莊外表下其實藏著倔強性格。

meaning: 舊語：嬌小或無足輕重的女子。
sentences: In gossip ladyling suggests a petite woman treated lightly. 在閒話裡，這個詞帶有把嬌小女子看輕的意味。
By rank alone ladyling could sound gently dismissive. 單憑身分口氣，這個詞就可能顯得帶點輕慢。

meaning: 聖母領報日前後的時節。
sentences: In early spring Ladytide marked rents, fairs, and hiring. 早春時節，這段期間常用來安排地租、市集與雇工。

meaning: 動物古稱：鈎蝦類舊分類中的甲殼動物。
sentences: In older zoology laemodipod named certain whale lice and caprellids. 在較早的動物分類裡，這個古稱用來指某些鯨蝨與海蜘蛛蝦。

In taxonomy Laemodipoda referred to parasitic crustaceans that live on whales. 在分類學裡，這個古名指寄生於鯨體表的甲殼動物。

meaning: 鯨蝨類成員；屬於鯨蝨類的。

sentences: The condition laemoparalysis can leave the vocal folds unable to move normally. 喉部麻痺會使聲帶無法正常活動。
With laemoparalysis the acts of breathing or speaking may become difficult. 出現喉部麻痺時，呼吸或發聲都可能變得困難。

In the diagram laeotropism meant the spiral bent to the left. 在圖示中，這個性質表示螺旋朝左側彎去。

meaning: 小地主；小領主（蘇格蘭口語）。
sentences: In village banter lairdie mocked a petty local landowner. 在鄉間戲語裡，這個詞拿來調侃地方上的小地主。
Among tenants lairdie implied a minor laird with limited reach. 在佃戶口中，這個詞暗示勢力有限的小領主。

meaning: 像地主般的；氣派的。
sentences: On festivalday Jack noticed a lairdly pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得像地主般的、氣派。
By restday Grace found the lairdly quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有像地主般的、氣派的特質。

meaning: 領主統治；地主階層掌權。
sentences: In reform speeches lairdocracy meant rule by great landowners. 在改革演說中，這個詞表示由大地主支配的統治。
Against democracy lairdocracy evokes a political order dominated by lairds. 與民主相對時，這個詞喚起由領主階層主導的政治秩序。

meaning: 領主身分；亦指領主所有的領地（蘇格蘭）。
sentences: In Scots law lairdship could refer to status or to landed extent. 在蘇格蘭法律語境裡，這個詞既可指身分，也可指所轄土地。
By custom lairdship passed with the estate to the next heir. 依慣例，這項領主身分會隨莊園傳給下一位繼承人。

meaning: 無巢穴。
sentences: On movingday Chloe noticed a lairless pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得無巢穴。
By travelday Grace found the lairless quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有無巢穴的特質。

meaning: 罕見／疑為誤拼，確切詞義不可考。
sentences: In this glossary lairman remains too rare for a secure definition. 在這份詞表裡，這個詞過於罕見，無法確定其可靠詞義。
From surviving sources lairman stays doubtful rather than well established. 依現存資料判斷，這個詞仍屬可疑字形，未形成穩定義項。

meaning: 教堂內覆於墓穴上的墓石（古語）。
sentences: Inside kirks lairstone once named the slab laid over a grave. 在蘇格蘭教堂內，這個古詞曾指覆在墓穴上的石板。
In antiquarian prose lairstone refers to an indoor grave cover. 在古物書寫中，這個詞指室內墓位上的覆石。

meaning: 易怒、有攻擊性或對抗性，通常是在喝醉的時候。
sentences: On movingday Frank noticed a lairy pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得易怒、有攻擊性或對抗性，通常是在喝醉的時候。
By Monday Hugo found the lairy quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有易怒、有攻擊性或對抗性，通常是在喝醉的時候的特質。

meaning: 浮漿層；混凝土表面鬆弱的乳狀水泥細料層（營建）。
sentences: On fresh concrete laitance can weaken the bond of later coatings. 在新澆混凝土上，浮漿層會削弱後續塗層的黏結。
During finishing laitance forms when excess water brings fines upward. 在收面過程中，多餘水分把細料帶上表面時就會形成浮漿層。

meaning: 平信徒；亦可泛指某領域中的非專業大眾。
sentences: In the cathedral laity sat apart from the ordained clergy. 在主教座堂裡，平信徒與受聖職者分列而坐。
For the laity the legal notice needed plainer everyday wording. 對非專業大眾而言，那份法律告示需要更淺白的日常措辭。

meaning: like 的口語拼寫。
sentences: On movingday Ivy spoke lak during dinner. 晚餐時，她說話時顯得口語拼寫。
By Thursday Hugo moved lak across the room. 後來，他移動時也顯得口語拼寫。

meaning: 拉克人；亦指拉克語，主要分布於俄羅斯達吉斯坦。
sentences: In Dagestan Lak identifies both an ethnic group and its language. 在達吉斯坦，這個名稱同時指一個民族及其語言。
Among Caucasian peoples Lak has a literary tradition in Cyrillic script. 在高加索各民族之中，這個語言有以西里爾字母書寫的文學傳統。

meaning: 罕見／疑為誤拼，確切詞義不可考。
sentences: For sellers lak refrigerator lacks enough context for a firm meaning. 對販售語境而言，這個詞組脈絡不足，無法確定穩固詞義。
In ads lak refrigerator looks obscure or possibly misspelled. 從廣告語境來看，這個詞組相當冷僻，甚至可能是誤拼。

meaning: 拉卡派特岩，一種霞石正長岩。
sentences: In petrology lakarpite names a nepheline syenite variety. 在岩石學中，這個名稱指一種霞石正長岩。
Among alkaline rocks lakarpite belongs to the nepheline-rich group. 在鹼性岩之中，這種岩石屬於富含霞石的一類。

meaning: 巴布亞紐幾內亞的雙體帆船；亦指圖案為此船的早期郵票系列。
sentences: lakatoi carried cargo between islands before engines became common. 在引擎普及之前，這種雙體帆船曾在島嶼之間運送貨物。
Classic Papua lakatoi stamps remain popular with stamp collectors. 以這種船為圖案的巴布亞早期郵票，至今仍受集郵者喜愛。

meaning: 湖
sentences: We went for a boat trip on the beautiful lake last weekend. 我們上週末在美麗的湖上乘船遊覽。
The water in the mountain lake was crystal clear and cold. 山間湖泊的水清澈見底且冰涼。

meaning: 多湖地帶。
sentences: lakeland stretches across the plateau in chains of clear water. 這片多湖地帶橫跨高原，清澈水面連綿成串。
In winter lakeland roads freeze beside dozens of connected lakes. 到了冬天，這片多湖地帶的道路常在成群相連的湖泊旁結冰。

meaning: 湖區居民。
sentences: lakelander families often measure distance by coves rather than blocks. 湖區居民常以幾個海灣來估算距離，而不是幾個街區。
Seasoned lakelander traders knew every landing on the shore. 老練的湖區商旅熟悉岸邊每一處可停靠點。

meaning: 布滿湖泊的。
sentences: On washday Frank noticed a lakeled pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得布滿湖泊。
By holiday Hugo found the lakeled quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有布滿湖泊的特質。

meaning: 沒有或多個湖泊。
sentences: On washday Grace noticed a lakeless pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得沒有或多個湖泊。
By payday Hugo found the lakeless quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有沒有或多個湖泊的特質。

meaning: 小湖。
sentences: lakelet ice melted first along the shallow southern edge. 這座小湖的冰層先從南側較淺的邊緣開始融化。
By midsummer the lakelet reflected reeds and dragonflies in still water. 到了仲夏，這座小湖的靜水映出蘆葦與蜻蜓。

meaning: 類似於或具有湖泊的特徵。
sentences: On washday Ivy noticed a lakelike pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得類似於或具有湖泊的特徵。
By frostday Hugo found the lakelike quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有類似於或具有湖泊的特徵的特質。

meaning: 湖上航行、維護與操船的技能與知識。
sentences: lakemanship matters when sudden squalls race over enclosed water. 當突來的狂風掠過封閉水域時，湖上操船本領就格外重要。
Good lakemanship includes docking, weather judgment, and engine care. 良好的湖上操船能力包含靠泊、判讀天氣與保養引擎。

meaning: 北美五大湖航行用的大型船舶。
sentences: laker traffic peaks when iron ore moves east across the Great Lakes. 當鐵礦石往東穿越五大湖運送時，這類湖船的航運最繁忙。
Each autumn a laker may unload grain, coal, or limestone at port. 每到秋季，這類湖船可能在港口卸下穀物、煤或石灰石。

meaning: 在湖邊。
sentences: On restday Ben noticed a lakeside pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得在湖邊。
By festivalday Hugo found the lakeside quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有在湖邊的特質。

meaning: 位於、面向或朝向湖泊。
sentences: On restday Chloe noticed a lakeward pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得位於、面向或朝向湖泊。
By movingday Hugo found the lakeward quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有位於、面向或朝向湖泊的特質。

meaning: 蓼科的水生植物，也稱水椒
sentences: Lakeweed spread across the quiet edge of the pond. 水椒蔓延在池塘安靜的邊緣。
Small fish hid among the submerged stems of lakeweed. 小魚躲在水椒沉水莖之間。

meaning: 蘇格蘭福斯灣潮汐用語：潮水短暫逆流的現象。
sentences: A lakie briefly reverses the usual tidal flow in the Firth of Forth. 福斯灣出現這種現象時，潮流會短暫逆轉。
Local observers call lakie tide a temporary backward movement of the water. 當地把這個潮汐名稱用於水流短暫倒退的情況。

meaning: 形成湖泊。
sentences: On restday Ella tried to laking before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了形成湖泊的動作。
By restday Hugo watched them laking near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 湖泊般的；帶湖澤氣息的。
sentences: On restday Frank noticed a lakish pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得湖泊般的、帶湖澤氣息。
By meetingday Hugo found the lakish quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有湖泊般的、帶湖澤氣息的特質。

meaning: 罕見：潮濕、多水的性質。
sentences: Persistent lakishness leaves low ground wet and pondlike. 持續的多水性會使低地保持潮濕，宛如池沼。
The soil's lakishness became obvious when shallow pools remained all summer. 淺水池整個夏季不退，顯示土壤環境十分濕潤。

meaning: 湖畔詩派風格的模仿或仿作。
sentences: Critics used lakism for verse imitating the Lake poets. 評論者用這個詞指模仿湖畔詩派的詩作。
Excessive lakism copied rural diction without the original poets' force. 過度仿作只複製田園措辭，卻缺少原詩人的力量。

meaning: 屬於、關於或讓人想起湖畔詩人的。
sentences: On restday Ivy noticed a lakist pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於、關於或讓人想起湖畔詩人。
By familyday Hugo found the lakist quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於、關於或讓人想起湖畔詩人的特質。

meaning: 拉科塔人；拉科塔語。
sentences: Lakota communities preserve oral history through ceremony, kinship, and song. 拉科塔社群藉由儀式、親族關係與歌唱保存口傳歷史。
Many Lakota speakers teach children prayers and place names in their own language. 許多拉科塔語使用者會教孩子用自己的語言說祈禱詞與地名。

meaning: 印度教的財富與吉祥女神；亦作女性名。
sentences: Lakshmi is invoked in Hindu worship as a goddess of wealth and good fortune. 在印度教崇拜中，人們祈求這位女神帶來財富與吉祥。
In many homes Lakshmi images are placed beside lamps during festival prayers. 在不少家庭裡，節慶祈禱時會把這位女神的圖像置於燈火旁。

meaning: 屬於、關於或類似湖泊的。
sentences: On meetingday Ben noticed a laky pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於、關於或類似湖泊。
By Tuesday Ivy found the laky quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於、關於或類似湖泊的特質。

meaning: 馬來西亞用語：白茅。
sentences: lalang spreads quickly across disturbed ground and forms dense sharp-edged stands. 白茅會迅速蔓延到受擾動的地面，形成大片密集而葉緣銳利的草叢。
After burning, lalang often returns faster than young trees can recover. 火燒過後，白茅往往比幼樹恢復得更快。

meaning: 帶著拉拉的聲音說話。
sentences: On meetingday David tried to lall before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了帶著拉拉的聲音說話的動作。
By Thursday Ivy watched them lall near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 蘇格蘭低地語的舊稱。
sentences: Lallan poetry keeps many Lowland Scottish speech forms alive in print. 以蘇格蘭低地語寫成的詩作，讓許多低地方言形式得以留存在文字中。
Some ballads use Lallan to retain the sound of Lowland speech. 有些民謠採用蘇格蘭低地語，為的是保留低地口語的聲調與節奏。

meaning: 蘇格蘭低地的舊稱。
sentences: Lalland speech differs noticeably from Highland Gaelic in sound and vocabulary. 蘇格蘭低地的語音與詞彙，和高地方的蓋爾語有明顯差異。
Older maps mark Lalland as the broad Lowland region of Scotland. 較早的地圖把這個名稱標作蘇格蘭廣大的低地地區。

meaning: 把 r 發成 l 或 w 的錯誤發音；亦指咿呀或含混語。
sentences: lallation can make an r sound come out like l or w. 這種發音偏誤會把 r 的聲音說得像 l 或 w。
In infant speech lallation may also mean babbling without clear words. 在嬰兒語境中，這個詞也可指尚未形成清楚詞語的咿呀聲。

meaning: lall的現在分詞和動名詞。
sentences: On meetingday Hugo tried to lalling before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了現在分詞和動名詞的動作。
By springday Ivy watched them lalling near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 西非料理中用來煮湯的猴麵包樹葉粉。
sentences: lalo thickens soup with powdered baobab leaves and a light tart note. 這種猴麵包樹葉粉能使湯變稠，並帶出淡淡酸味。
Cooks stir lalo into stews when they want body without flour. 想讓燉湯更有濃度又不加麵粉時，廚師會拌入這種葉粉。

meaning: 因發音肌肉痙攣引起的言語障礙。
sentences: laloneurosis refers to speech impairment caused by spasms in speaking muscles. 這個詞指的是發音肌肉痙攣所造成的言語障礙。
With laloneurosis, words may break off when the mouth muscles seize. 出現這種障礙時，口部肌肉一痙攣，話語就可能中斷。

meaning: 任何言語障礙
sentences: Lalopathy made the speaker repeat the first syllable. 言語障礙讓說話者重複第一個音節。
A speech therapist designed exercises for her lalopathy. 語言治療師為她的言語障礙設計練習。

meaning: 對開口說話的非理性恐懼。
sentences: lalophobia can silence a person even during ordinary conversation. 即使在平常交談中，這種恐懼也可能使人說不出話。
For someone with lalophobia, speaking aloud may trigger panic before any sound emerges. 對有這種恐懼的人而言，還沒發出聲音前就可能先陷入驚慌。

meaning: 病理：發音器官麻痺。
sentences: laloplegia means paralysis of the organs used for speech. 這個詞指用來發聲與發音的器官發生麻痺。
After injury, laloplegia may leave the voice impossible to form. 受傷之後，這種麻痺可能使人根本無法成聲。

meaning: 俚語：逃亡、潛逃；亦指阿拉伯字母 ل。
sentences: lam became prison slang for a sudden escape from custody. 這個俚語後來用來指突然脫逃或潛逃。
In Arabic script lam stands between kaf and mim in the alphabet. 在阿拉伯字母表中，這個字母位於 kaf 與 mim 之間。

meaning: 藏傳佛教上師；亦作羊駝的另一拼法；另有舊義指金銀線織物。
sentences: lama guides in Tibetan Buddhism may lead rituals, lineages, or monasteries. 在藏傳佛教中，這類上師可能引領儀式、傳承或寺院事務。
In older zoological lama accounts, the animal is the same South American camelid. 在較早的動物學記述裡，這個拼法指的就是那種南美駱駝科動物。

meaning: 喇嘛教的；藏傳佛教的。
sentences: On gardenday Ella noticed a lamaic pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得喇嘛教的、藏傳佛教。
By seasonday Ivy found the lamaic quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有喇嘛教的、藏傳佛教的特質。

meaning: 藏傳佛教的舊稱
sentences: Lamaism is an old English name for Tibetan Buddhism. 這是藏傳佛教的舊英文名稱。
Older travel books used Lamaism for the region's religious tradition. 較早的旅行書籍用這個舊稱指當地宗教傳統。

meaning: 舊稱：藏傳佛教徒；亦可指屬於藏傳佛教的。
sentences: Lamaist once referred to a follower of Tibetan Buddhism. 這個舊稱曾用來指藏傳佛教的信徒。
Dated religious prose Lamaist sometimes meant an adherent rather than a cleric. 在過時的宗教散文裡，這個詞有時指一般信奉者，而不專指僧職者。

meaning: 喇嘛教的。
sentences: On gardenday Hugo noticed a Lamaistic pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得喇嘛教。
By movingday Ivy found the Lamaistic quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有喇嘛教的特質。

meaning: 舊稱：藏傳佛教徒。
sentences: Lamaite appears in older writing as a term for a Tibetan Buddhist. 這個詞見於較早的文獻中，用來指藏傳佛教徒。
From antiquarian dictionaries Lamaite is glossed as an adherent of Tibetan Buddhism. 從一些舊式字典的釋義看來，這個詞指的是藏傳佛教的信奉者。

meaning: 藏傳佛教的古舊異拼名稱
sentences: Lamanism appears as an archaic spelling in a nineteenth-century book. 這個名稱以古舊拼法出現在十九世紀書籍中。
The glossary gives Lamanism as an earlier name for Tibetan Buddhism. 詞彙表把這個名稱列為藏傳佛教的早期稱呼。

meaning: 摩門教用語：拉曼後裔群體的一員，傳統上被說成包含今之美洲原住民族。
sentences: Lamanite in Mormon scripture names a people descended from Laman. 在摩門經文中，這個詞指的是拉曼的後裔族群。
Traditional Mormon Lamanite narratives connect the term with peoples of the Americas. 傳統摩門敘事常把這個名稱連到美洲的諸民族。

meaning: 握手。
sentences: On travelday Ben tried to Lamano before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了握手的動作。
By gardenday Ivy watched them Lamano near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 古語：海牛。
sentences: lamantin is an archaic word for the aquatic mammal now called a manatee. 這個古詞指的就是如今稱為海牛的水生哺乳動物。
In older travelogues lamantin names a slow herbivorous sea mammal. 在較早的遊記中，這個詞用來稱呼一種行動緩慢、食草的海生哺乳動物。

meaning: 罕見／疑為誤拼，確切詞義不可考。
sentences: lamany is scarcely attested, and its exact meaning cannot be confirmed. 這個詞幾乎沒有可靠用例，確切詞義無法確認。
Fragmentary listings mention lamany without enough context to recover a secure sense. 零碎詞目雖提到它，卻沒有足夠語境可還原穩固詞義。

meaning: 包含金狗尾草的禾本科分類屬
sentences: Lamarckia bears golden bristles above its narrow leaves. 金狗尾草屬植物在窄葉上方長出金色芒穗。
Dry hillsides in warm regions suit Lamarckia. 溫暖地區的乾燥山坡適合這種金狗尾草。

meaning: 與拉馬克主義。
sentences: On travelday Ella noticed a Lamarckian pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得與拉馬克主義。
By picnicday Ivy found the Lamarckian quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有與拉馬克主義的特質。

meaning: 拉馬克主義：主張生物可遺傳後天獲得性狀的學說。
sentences: Lamarckianism holds that acquired traits can be inherited by offspring. 拉馬克主義認為，後天獲得的性狀可以遺傳給後代。

Several schemes Lamellirostres gathered ducks, geese, and swans by their lamellar beaks. 若干舊分法把鴨、雁與天鵝因喙部板片構造歸在這一類。

meaning: 似薄片的

meaning: 另一拼法：小薄片；小層片

Rarely printed lamellule serves as a variant form for a tiny lamella. 偶見印本把這個拼法用作小型層片的異寫。

sentences: After injury lameness made each step short and painful. 受傷後，跛行情況使每一步都短促而疼痛。
In slang lameness can also mean dullness or embarrassing uncoolness. 在口語裡，這個詞也可指無聊拙劣或令人尷尬的土氣。

meaning: 表達悲傷；哭泣或哀號；哀悼。

sentences: In slang lamester insults someone as hopelessly uncool or out of touch. 在俚語裡，這個詞用來罵人土氣又跟不上時代。
Less often lamester refers to a person or animal that limps. 較少見時，這個詞也指走路一拐一拐的人或動物。

meaning: 另一拼法：喇嘛寺；藏傳佛教僧院
sentences: Across travelogues lamestery appears as an older spelling for a lama monastery. 舊遊記中，這個拼法可指喇嘛居住修行的寺院。
Victorian writers lamestery used for a Tibetan Buddhist monastic complex. 維多利亞時代作者曾用這個拼法表示藏傳佛教僧院。

meaning: 蘇格蘭方言、舊語：跛子；殘障者
sentences: In Scots lameter was an old word for a crippled person. 在蘇格蘭方言中，這是舊時對肢體殘障者的稱呼。
From dialect speech lameter carried a harsh sense for someone lame. 在方言口語裡，這個詞帶有稱人跛足的粗重語氣。

meaning: 金屬彩條；聖誕樹用金銀絲飾帶
sentences: For holiday decor lametta means thin metallic tinsel strips. 談到節慶裝飾時，這個詞指細長的金屬亮片彩帶。
Shimmering overhead lametta caught the candlelight like strands of silver rain. 懸掛上方的金屬彩條映著燭光，像一道道銀色細雨。

meaning: 希臘神話中的食人女妖，尤指殘害兒童者
sentences: In myth lamia is a female monster said to prey on children. 在神話中，這個詞指傳說會殘害兒童的女妖。
Later legends lamia often appears with a woman above and a serpent below. 後來的傳說常把這種妖物描寫成上半身為女子、下半身為蛇。

meaning: 包含薄荷、羅勒等植物的唇形科
sentences: Lamiaceae plants often have square stems and aromatic leaves. 唇形科植物常有方形莖和芳香葉片。
Basil and mint both belong to Lamiaceae. 羅勒和薄荷都屬於唇形科。

meaning: 屬於或與薄荷唇形科及其近親相關的。
sentences: Mint and lavender are well-known lamiaceous plants. 薄荷與薰衣草是著名的唇形科植物。
The garden is full of lamiaceous herbs that smell wonderful in the spring. 花園裡種滿了唇形科的草本植物，在春天散發著美妙的香氣。

meaning: 古語：跛行者或肢體殘障者。
sentences: The old noun lamiger referred to a person who walked with difficulty. 這個古名詞指行走困難的人。
Historical glossaries define lamiger as a person with impaired mobility. 歷史詞彙表把這個詞解作行動不便者。

meaning: 天牛科唇形亞科的成員
sentences: A lamiid beetle bored a round tunnel through the branch. 一隻天牛科唇形亞科甲蟲在枝條中蛀出圓洞。
The lamiid's long antennae reached beyond its wing cases. 這隻天牛科甲蟲的長觸角伸過翅鞘。

meaning: 一個分類科
sentences: Lamiidae appears as a family name in older insect lists. 這個科名出現在較早的昆蟲名錄中。
The beetle's placement near Lamiidae has changed in newer schemes. 這種甲蟲接近這個科的分類位置在新體系中有所改變。

meaning: 罕見／古分類名，指天牛類的一支
sentences: In older entomology Lamiides named a group associated with longhorn beetles. 在較舊的昆蟲學裡，這名稱指與天牛有關的一個類群。
Some catalogues Lamiides survives only as an outdated taxonomic label. 在一些目錄中，這名稱只作為過時的分類標籤保留。

meaning: 天牛科的扁臉長角甲蟲亞科
sentences: Lamiinae contains longhorn beetles with flattened faces. 這個亞科包含臉部扁平的長角甲蟲。
A Lamiinae larva tunneled beneath the tree's bark. 一隻這個亞科的幼蟲在樹皮下鑽洞。

meaning: 核纖層蛋白；細胞核內提供支撐的纖維蛋白
sentences: Inside nuclei lamin helps support the nuclear envelope and organize DNA activity. 在細胞核內，這類蛋白協助支撐核膜並整理 DNA 活動。
Mutant forms lamin can weaken nuclear shape and disrupt gene regulation. 這類蛋白若發生突變，可能削弱細胞核形狀並干擾基因調控。

meaning: 薄層；薄片；片狀構造
sentences: As anatomy lamina can denote a thin plate forming part of a structure. 在解剖學中，這個詞可指構成某部位的薄板。
In leaves lamina usually means the broad flat blade of the leaf. 在植物學裡，它通常指葉子的寬扁葉片。

meaning: 可層壓性；可壓成薄層的性質
sentences: Under pressure laminability measures how well a substance can be formed into layers. 談到受壓加工時，這個詞衡量物質形成層狀的能力。
Manufacturers value laminability when sheets must bond smoothly without cracking. 需要把薄片平順貼合而不龜裂時，製造者會重視這種性質。

meaning: 可分成薄片的；可層壓的
sentences: On Sunday Grace noticed a laminable pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得可分成薄片的、可層壓。
By festivalday Chloe found the laminable quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有可分成薄片的、可層壓的特質。

meaning: 薄層；薄片；片狀構造的複數
sentences: Among sediments laminae are the fine layers laid down one above another. 在沉積物中，這個詞指一層層堆積的細薄層。
Pathologists call laminae the multiple thin plates visible in layered tissue. 在病理描述中，這個詞可指分層組織內看得見的多個薄板。

meaning: 褐藻科的海帶屬海藻
sentences: Laminaria forms tall underwater forests along cold coasts. 海帶屬海藻在寒冷海岸形成高大的水下森林。
Divers collected fallen Laminaria blades from the seafloor. 潛水員從海床收集掉落的海帶葉片。

meaning: 包含海帶等褐藻的分類科
sentences: Laminariaceae includes large brown algae with broad blades. 這個科包含葉片寬大的大型褐藻。
Cold rocky shores support dense Laminariaceae forests. 寒冷岩岸支持茂密的這類褐藻森林。

meaning: 某些褐藻產生的葡聚醣

meaning: 類似海帶屬。
sentences: The divers found laminarioid seaweed growing along the rocky coast. 潛水員在岩石海岸邊發現了類似海帶的藻類。
This species has a laminarioid shape with long, flat fronds. 這個物種具有類似海帶的外形，長有扁平的葉狀體。

meaning: 將薄板黏合在一起組裝成更厚的板子。
sentences: We'll laminate the piece of wood with grain going in different directions to make a really strong hull for the boat. 我們將用不同方向的紋理層壓這塊木頭，為船製作一個非常堅固的船體。

sentences: In horses laminitis inflames the tissues that secure the hoof wall. 在馬匹身上，這種病會使固定蹄壁的組織發炎。

meaning: 秘魯拉馬斯地區居民

Lamista elders preserve Quechua-linked customs during family planting rites. 拉馬斯地區的長者在家族播種儀式中保留與克丘亞相關的習俗。

sentences: lamiter was once a Scots word for a person with a disabling limp. 這曾是蘇格蘭語裡指跛行殘疾者的詞。
lamiter now survives chiefly in historical Scots glossaries rather than modern speech. 這個詞如今主要見於蘇格蘭歷史詞彙表，現代口語已罕用。

meaning: 包含死蕁麻的唇形科分類屬
sentences: Lamium flowers rise above leaves that resemble stinging nettle. 死蕁麻屬花朵長在像刺蕁麻的葉子上方。
A patch of Lamium covered the damp bank in spring. 一片死蕁麻屬植物春天覆蓋了潮濕河岸。

meaning: 英格蘭古節慶：八月一日收穫節
sentences: Lammas marked the first harvest with bread baked from the new grain. 拉姆斯節以新穀烤成的麵包標誌初收時節。

meaning: 古語／異體：蘭撒果、蘭薩果。
sentences: lansat refers to the tropical fruit now more often spelled langsat. 這個舊寫法所指的是如今較常另作一種拼法的熱帶水果。
lansat has translucent segments with a sweet and slightly tart taste. 這種果實果瓣半透明，味道清甜中帶些微酸。

meaning: 蘭斯當綢；女裝用的輕薄絲毛混紡織物。
sentences: Lightweight lansdowne blends silk and wool for women's clothing. 輕薄的蘭斯當綢混紡絲與羊毛，常用於女裝。
A dress of lansdowne drapes softly without heavy bulk. 蘭斯當綢製成的洋裝垂墜柔順，不顯厚重。

meaning: 舊式拼法：蘭撒果、蘭薩果。
sentences: lanseh is an older spelling for the fruit more commonly called langsat. 這是該熱帶水果較早期的一種拼法。
lanseh names a Southeast Asian fruit with pale, juicy flesh. 這個詞指一種東南亞水果，果肉色淡而多汁。

meaning: 礦物學：蘭斯福德石，柔軟的水合碳酸鎂礦物。
sentences: lansfordite forms as a soft hydrated magnesium carbonate mineral. 這是一種柔軟的水合碳酸鎂礦物。
lansfordite can alter quickly because the mineral is unstable in warmer conditions. 這種礦物在較暖環境下不穩定，因此可能很快轉變。

meaning: 歷史異拼：十五、十六世紀的德意志傭兵，多為長槍步兵。
sentences: lansknecht is an alternate spelling of a German mercenary foot soldier. 這是德意志傭兵步卒名稱的一種異拼。
lansknecht units carried long pikes and fought in dense blocks. 這類部隊攜帶長槍，常以密集隊形作戰。

meaning: 蘭撒果；蘭薩果的罕見異體名。
sentences: The fruit lanson has pale translucent segments beneath a yellowish rind. 蘭撒果的淡色半透明果瓣包在淡黃色果皮內。
In rare usage, lanson is another name for the Southeast Asian langsat. 在罕見用法中，這個詞是東南亞蘭撒果的另一名稱。

meaning: 歷史：十五、十六世紀德意志傭兵；亦指同名紙牌博戲。
sentences: lansquenet first meant a German mercenary, especially a pikeman. 這個詞原先指德意志傭兵，尤其是持長槍者。
lansquenet later also named a gambling card game of matching ranks. 後來它也指一種比對牌點的博戲。

meaning: 古語：陳尿，舊時可作肥料；亦可指沙鰻類小海魚。
sentences: lant was saved for manure because stale urine is rich in nitrogen. 這種陳尿曾被留下施肥，因其含氮量高。
lant can also mean a slender sand eel used as bait. 這個詞也可指細長的沙鰻類小魚，常可作餌。

meaning: 罕見詞；lantaka 的異體拼法，指東南亞船隻或要塞使用的小型青銅旋轉炮。
sentences: Historically, Malay sailors mounted lantaca on ships for close defense. 歷史上，馬來水手把小型青銅旋轉炮裝在船上作近距離防禦。
Because each lantaca pivoted freely, its crew could redirect fire quickly. 由於這種小型青銅旋轉炮可自由轉動，炮手能迅速改變射向。

meaning: 有芳香花簇的馬鞭草科多年生植物
sentences: Lantana produced clusters of orange and yellow flowers. 馬纓丹開出橙黃相間的花簇。
Butterflies gathered around the fragrant Lantana hedge. 蝴蝶聚集在芳香的馬纓丹樹籬周圍。

meaning: 古語；一種又稱 loo 的十七、十八世紀英國吃墩紙牌遊戲。
sentences: During Restoration England, lanterloo became a fashionable gambling card game. 在英國王政復辟時期，這種吃墩紙牌賭戲一度蔚為風尚。
Unlike modern bridge, lanterloo penalized players who failed to win a trick. 不同於現代橋牌，這種紙牌戲會懲罰未能贏得一墩的玩家。

meaning: 燈籠
sentences: The garden was decorated with colorful lanterns for the festival. 花園裡裝飾著繽紛的燈籠慶祝節日。
The old explorer carried a dim lantern through the dark cave. 舊探險家提著微弱的燈籠穿過黑暗的洞穴。

meaning: 罕見植物俗名；指花朵呈燈籠狀的植物，所指物種依地區而異。
sentences: In horticultural speech, lanternflower describes plants with pendant lantern-shaped blooms. 在園藝用語中，燈籠花泛指具有下垂燈籠狀花朵的植物。
Across different regions, lanternflower can denote more than one botanical species. 在不同地區，燈籠花這個俗名可能指不只一種植物。

meaning: 古語；操作幻燈機並投射影像的人。
sentences: At Victorian lectures, a lanternist projected painted glass slides onto a screen. 在維多利亞時代的講演中，幻燈師把彩繪玻璃片的影像投到幕上。
Before cinema spread, every lanternist controlled focus and slide changes by hand. 電影普及以前，每位幻燈師都以手動調焦並更換玻璃片。

meaning: 罕見植物俗名：匍匐毛茛，即具匍匐莖的毛茛屬植物。
sentences: Gardeners once called creeping crowfoot lanternleaf. 園藝用語過去曾把匍匐毛茛稱為燈葉草。
Rooting runners let lanternleaf spread across damp ground. 匍匐莖會在節上生根，使燈葉草沿潮濕地面蔓延。

meaning: 古語；持燈、掌燈或照管信號燈的人。
sentences: On dark streets, a lanternman once carried a lamp ahead of travelers. 昔日夜間街道上，掌燈人會提燈走在旅客前方。
Aboard older vessels, the lanternman tended lamps used for illumination or signaling. 在較早期的船舶上，燈務人員照管照明或發信號用的燈。

meaning: 化學舊稱；氧化鑭，化學式 La₂O₃。
sentences: Chemically, lanthana is the sesquioxide of the element lanthanum. 在化學上，氧化鑭是鑭元素的三二氧化物。
When hydrated, lanthana readily forms lanthanum hydroxide under suitable conditions. 在適當條件下，氧化鑭水合後容易形成氫氧化鑭。

meaning: 化學專門用語；鑭系元素，通常指原子序 57 至 71 的十五種元素。
sentences: In periodic tables, each lanthanide belongs to the series from lanthanum through lutetium. 在元素週期表中，每個鑭系元素都屬於從鑭到鎦的系列。
Because most lanthanide ions are trivalent, their chemical properties often resemble one another. 因多數鑭系離子呈三價，它們的化學性質往往彼此相近。

meaning: 礦物學專門用語；水合稀土碳酸鹽礦物，常富含鑭，也可含鈰或釹。
sentences: Mineralogically, lanthanite is a hydrated carbonate containing rare-earth elements. 在礦物學上，鑭碳酸鹽礦是一種含稀土元素的水合碳酸鹽。
Depending on composition, lanthanite may be named for its dominant lanthanum, cerium, or neodymium. 依成分而定，鑭碳酸鹽礦可按占優勢的鑭、鈰或釹命名。

meaning: 包含無耳巨蜥的一個分類科
sentences: Lanthanotidae contains a secretive monitor lizard from Borneo. 這個科包含婆羅洲一種隱密的巨蜥。
The family Lanthanotidae has only a very small number of living species. 這個分類科現生物種數量非常少。

meaning: 無耳巨蜥所屬的分類屬
sentences: Lanthanotus has a low body and tiny hidden ears. 無耳巨蜥屬動物身體低矮，耳孔細小隱蔽。
A Lanthanotus moved slowly beneath wet forest leaves. 一隻無耳巨蜥在潮濕森林落葉下緩慢移動。

meaning: 化學專門用語；化學元素「鑭」，原子序 57，符號 La。
sentences: On the periodic table, lanthanum has atomic number fifty-seven. 在元素週期表上，鑭的原子序是五十七。
As a soft metal, lanthanum oxidizes readily when exposed to air. 鑭是一種軟金屬，暴露在空氣中很容易氧化。

meaning: 化學專門用語；存在於鴉片中的微量生物鹼。
sentences: Among minor opium alkaloids, lanthopine occurs in very small amounts. 在鴉片的次要生物鹼中，蘭托品僅以極少量存在。
Unlike morphine, lanthopine has never become a major therapeutic alkaloid. 不同於嗎啡，蘭托品從未成為主要的治療用生物鹼。

meaning: 用琴鍵或按鈕演奏的管樂器
sentences: The musician played the lantum with both hands. 樂手用雙手演奏琴鍵管樂器。
A lantum has pipes controlled by keys or buttons. 這種管樂器的音管由琴鍵或按鈕控制。

meaning: 覆蓋著絨毛或細軟的毛（胎毛）；柔軟或模糊。
sentences: On Friday Jack noticed a lanuginose pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得覆蓋著絨毛或細軟的毛（胎毛）、柔軟或模糊。
By picnicday Ben found the lanuginose quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有覆蓋著絨毛或細軟的毛（胎毛）、柔軟或模糊的特質。

meaning: 有柔毛的；覆有細絨毛的。
sentences: On Saturday Anna noticed a lanuginous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得有柔毛的、覆有細絨毛。
By Monday Chloe found the lanuginous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有有柔毛的、覆有細絨毛的特質。

meaning: 罕見名詞；表面覆有柔細絨毛的性質或狀態。
sentences: Under magnification, the lanuginousness of a young stem appears as dense soft hairs. 在放大觀察下，幼莖的柔毛狀態呈現為密集細軟的毛。
In botanical description, lanuginousness distinguishes a woolly surface from a smooth one. 在植物形態描述中，柔毛性可區分覆絨毛表面與光滑表面。

meaning: 醫學專門用語；胎兒身上短、細、柔軟的毛，通常在出生前後脫落。
sentences: During fetal development, lanugo helps hold the protective vernix on the skin. 在胎兒發育期間，胎毛有助於讓保護性的胎脂附著在皮膚上。
For most newborns, lanugo disappears before birth or soon afterward. 對多數新生兒而言，胎毛會在出生前或出生不久後消失。

meaning: 罕見詞形／疑似誤拼，現無可核實的通行英語義。
sentences: No dependable English definition of lanum can be given from standard usage. 依標準用法，目前無法為這個罕見詞形提出可靠的英語定義。
Absent a verified source, lanum cannot safely be equated with water. 在沒有可核實來源時，不能把這個疑似誤拼安全地解作水。

meaning: 歷史語言學專名；拉努維烏姆的居民或其古代方言；作形容詞時指該城或其居民。
sentences: In ancient Latium, Lanuvian was a local variety closely related to Latin. 在古代拉提姆，拉努維烏姆方言是與拉丁語關係密切的地方語言變體。
An inhabitant of Lanuvium could historically be called a Lanuvian. 在歷史用法中，拉努維烏姆的居民可稱為拉努維烏姆人。

meaning: 拉丁詞形／古物學用語；古羅馬的大盤或托盤，也可指天平的秤盤。
sentences: At Roman banquets, a lanx held food for presentation at the table. 在古羅馬宴席上，大托盤用來盛放並呈上食物。
In Latin metrology, lanx could also denote one pan of a balance. 在拉丁度量用語中，這個詞也可指天平的一側秤盤。

meaning: 繫索；用來固定、懸掛或防止物件遺失的短繩或帶子。
sentences: For fall protection, a lanyard connects a worker harness to an anchor. 作為防墜裝備，繫索會把作業者的安全帶連接到錨點。
Around the neck, a lanyard can suspend an identification badge securely. 掛在頸部時，掛繩可穩妥懸掛識別證。

meaning: 跌倒。
sentences: On Saturday Hugo tried to lao before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了跌倒的動作。
By springday Chloe watched them lao near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 專名；寮國人、寮語，亦可作形容詞表示寮國的或寮族的。
sentences: As the national language, Lao is written in its own abugida script. 寮語是寮國國語，以自身的元音附標文字書寫。
Many Lao people live beside the Mekong River and its tributaries. 許多寮國人居住在湄公河及其支流沿岸。

meaning: 老底嘉的；也指態度冷淡或搖擺的人。
sentences: On Saturday Jack noticed a Laodicean pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得老底嘉的、也指態度冷淡或搖擺的人。
By rainyday Chloe found the Laodicean quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有老底嘉的、也指態度冷淡或搖擺的人的特質。

meaning: 宗教與文學用語；對信仰或原則冷淡、不熱心的態度，源自《啟示錄》對老底嘉教會的描述。
sentences: In Christian rhetoric, Laodiceanism signifies spiritual lukewarmness rather than open disbelief. 在基督宗教修辭中，老底嘉式冷淡指靈性上的不冷不熱，而非公開不信。
By figurative extension, Laodiceanism can describe indifference toward an important principle. 引申而言，老底嘉式冷淡也可形容對重要原則漠不關心。

meaning: 屬於、來自或屬於寮國人民民主共和國、寮國人民或寮國語言。
sentences: On Sunday Ben noticed a Laotian pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於、來自或屬於寮國人民民主共和國、寮國人民或寮國語言。
By payday Chloe found the Laotian quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於、來自或屬於寮國人民民主共和國、寮國人民或寮國語言的特質。

meaning: 圈
sentences: The little girl was sitting on her grandmother's lap. 小女孩正坐在祖母的腿上。
He managed to complete one more lap before the race ended. 他設法在比賽結束前又跑完了一圈。

meaning: 以拉帕喬樹內皮製成的花草茶
sentences: Lapacho tea released a woody scent in the clay pot. 拉帕喬茶在陶壺中散發木質香氣。
The herbalist simmered lapacho bark for a warm drink. 草藥師燉煮拉帕喬樹皮來製作熱飲。

meaning: 從拉帕喬樹皮分離出的天然酚類化合物
sentences: Lapachol gives some bark extracts a deep yellow color. 拉帕醌讓某些樹皮萃取物呈深黃色。
Chemists isolated lapachol from the inner bark of the tree. 化學家從那種樹的內皮分離出拉帕醌。

meaning: 瀉藥;瀉藥。
sentences: On Sunday Chloe noticed a lapactic pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得瀉藥、瀉藥。
By harvestday Chloe found the lapactic quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有瀉藥、瀉藥的特質。

meaning: 包含智利鈴蘭的分類屬
sentences: Lapageria bears waxy bell-shaped flowers on twining stems. 智利鈴蘭屬植物在纏繞莖上開蠟質鐘形花。
A Lapageria climbed the shaded trellis beside the cottage. 一株智利鈴蘭屬植物攀上小屋旁的陰涼棚架。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；切除部分腹壁的手術。
sentences: In older surgical nomenclature, laparectomy meant excision of part of the abdominal wall. 在舊式外科命名中，腹壁切除術指切除部分腹壁。
Modern surgeons would describe a laparectomy more precisely by naming the tissue removed. 現代外科醫師會直接指出切除的組織，更精確地描述這類腹壁切除手術。

meaning: 罕見且過時的醫學術語；腹壁疝，即腹腔內容物從腹壁薄弱處突出。
sentences: Through a weakened abdominal wall, a laparocele forms as viscera push outward. 當內臟從腹壁薄弱處向外突出時，便形成腹壁疝。
Unlike a solid tumor, a laparocele is a hernial protrusion of abdominal contents. 腹壁疝不同於實體腫瘤，是腹腔內容物形成的疝性突出。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口切開膽囊。
sentences: Through an abdominal incision, laparocholecystotomy opened the gallbladder for direct access. 經由腹部切口，剖腹膽囊切開術會打開膽囊以便直接處置。
Before less invasive methods, laparocholecystotomy could permit removal of gallstones without removing the organ. 在微創方法出現前，剖腹膽囊切開術可在不切除器官的情況下取出膽石。

meaning: 罕見外科術語；經腹部切口切除全部或部分結腸。
sentences: By an abdominal approach, laparocolectomy removes diseased colon tissue. 採腹部進路時，剖腹結腸切除術會移除病變的結腸組織。
Depending on disease extent, laparocolectomy may involve part or all of the colon. 依疾病範圍而定，剖腹結腸切除術可能涉及部分或整段結腸。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部手術把結腸接到腹壁，建立人工開口。
sentences: By bringing colon outward, laparocolostomy creates a stoma in the abdominal wall. 剖腹結腸造口術把結腸引到體外，在腹壁形成造口。
After a laparocolostomy, intestinal contents can leave through the surgically created opening. 完成剖腹結腸造口術後，腸內容物可經手術建立的開口排出。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口切開結腸。
sentences: Through open abdominal access, laparocolotomy makes an incision into the colon. 經開放式腹部進路，剖腹結腸切開術會在結腸上作切口。
Unlike colectomy, laparocolotomy opens the colon without naming removal of bowel tissue. 不同於結腸切除術，剖腹結腸切開術只表示打開結腸，並不表示切除腸組織。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部與陰道進路切開子宮。
sentences: Combining abdominal and vaginal access, laparocolpohysterotomy involved an incision into the uterus. 剖腹陰道子宮切開術結合腹部與陰道進路，並切開子宮。
Because laparocolpohysterotomy names multiple operative routes, modern terminology favors a clearer procedural description. 由於此術名同時包含多重手術進路，現代術語偏好更清楚的程序描述。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部進路切開陰道。
sentences: From an abdominal approach, laparocolpotomy created an operative opening into the vagina. 從腹部進路施作時，剖腹陰道切開術會在陰道形成手術開口。
Historically, laparocolpotomy distinguished an abdominal route from a purely vaginal incision. 在歷史用法中，剖腹陰道切開術用以區別腹部進路與單純陰道切開。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口切除膀胱。
sentences: Through open abdominal surgery, laparocystectomy removed the urinary bladder. 經開放式腹部手術，剖腹膀胱切除術會移除膀胱。
Unlike laparocystotomy, laparocystectomy denotes excision rather than a simple incision. 不同於剖腹膀胱切開術，剖腹膀胱切除術表示切除，而非單純切開。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口切開膀胱。
sentences: Through the abdominal wall, laparocystotomy opened the bladder for surgical access. 經由腹壁，剖腹膀胱切開術會打開膀胱以進行處置。
In historical practice, laparocystotomy allowed direct removal of some bladder stones. 在早期醫療中，剖腹膀胱切開術可讓醫師直接取出某些膀胱結石。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部進路切開陰道；elytro- 是表示陰道的舊式構詞成分。
sentences: Using an obsolete root, laparoelytrotomy denotes an abdominal operation that incises the vagina. 這個術名採用已過時的詞根，指從腹部進路切開陰道的手術。
In modern writing, laparoelytrotomy is replaced by a clearer description of the operative route. 在現代書寫中，這個罕見術名會改用更清楚的手術進路描述。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部手術在腸道建立人工開口或吻合口。
sentences: Through an abdominal operation, laparoenterostomy creates a new opening involving the intestine. 經由腹部手術，剖腹腸造口術會建立涉及腸道的新開口。
Depending on its purpose, laparoenterostomy may divert bowel contents or join intestinal segments. 依手術目的而定，剖腹腸造口術可改道腸內容物或連接腸段。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口切開腸道。
sentences: After opening the abdomen, laparoenterotomy makes an incision into the intestine. 打開腹腔後，剖腹腸切開術會進一步切開腸道。
Where obstruction required direct access, laparoenterotomy could expose the intestinal lumen. 當腸阻塞需要直接處置時，剖腹腸切開術可顯露腸腔。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口直接檢視胃內部。
sentences: Before flexible endoscopes, laparogastroscopy allowed visual inspection of the stomach through an abdominal opening. 軟式內視鏡問世前，剖腹胃內檢查可經腹部開口直接觀察胃內。
Unlike routine gastroscopy, laparogastroscopy required operative access through the abdominal wall. 不同於一般胃鏡檢查，剖腹胃內檢查需要經腹壁取得手術進路。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口切開胃。
sentences: Following abdominal entry, laparogastrotomy opens the stomach with a surgical incision. 進入腹腔後，剖腹胃切開術會以手術切口打開胃。
To reach a gastric foreign body, laparogastrotomy once provided direct access. 為了取出胃內異物，剖腹胃切開術過去可提供直接進路。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口切開肝臟。
sentences: Via open abdominal access, laparohepatotomy makes an incision into liver tissue. 經開放式腹部進路，剖腹肝切開術會切開肝組織。
Rather than removing the liver, laparohepatotomy denotes cutting into it for access. 剖腹肝切開術表示切入肝臟以取得進路，而不是移除肝臟。

meaning: 罕見舊稱；經腹部切口切除子宮，即腹式子宮切除術。
sentences: With open abdominal access, laparohysterectomy removes the uterus. 經由開放式腹部進路，腹式子宮切除術會移除子宮。
Compared with vaginal hysterectomy, laparohysterectomy uses an abdominal operative route. 相較於陰式子宮切除術，腹式子宮切除術採用腹部手術進路。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部手術把子宮固定於腹壁或其他支撐組織。
sentences: To correct uterine displacement, laparohysteropexy surgically fixed the uterus through an abdominal approach. 為矯正子宮移位，腹式子宮固定術會從腹部進路固定子宮。
Rather than excising tissue, laparohysteropexy aimed to support the uterus in position. 腹式子宮固定術的目的不是切除組織，而是把子宮支撐在適當位置。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口切開子宮。
sentences: Through abdominal access, laparohysterotomy creates an incision in the uterus. 經腹部進路，剖腹子宮切開術會在子宮上形成切口。
Unlike hysterectomy, laparohysterotomy opens the uterus without denoting its removal. 不同於子宮切除術，剖腹子宮切開術只表示打開子宮，並不表示將其移除。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部切口切開迴腸。
sentences: After abdominal entry, laparoileotomy opens the ileum with an incision. 進入腹腔後，剖腹迴腸切開術會以切口打開迴腸。
For direct ileal access, laparoileotomy exposes the lumen without specifying bowel removal. 為直接進入迴腸，剖腹迴腸切開術會顯露腸腔，但不表示切除腸段。

meaning: 罕見且過時的醫學術語；腹壁肌肉的炎症。
sentences: When abdominal muscles become inflamed, older terminology may label the condition laparomyitis. 腹部肌肉發炎時，舊式術語可稱此狀況為腹肌炎。
Unlike peritonitis, laparomyitis concerns muscle rather than the abdominal lining. 不同於腹膜炎，腹肌炎涉及的是肌肉，而非腹腔內膜。

meaning: 罕見外科術語；經腹部切口切除肌瘤，通常指子宮肌瘤。
sentences: Through an abdominal approach, laparomyomectomy removes one or more uterine fibroids. 經腹部進路，剖腹肌瘤切除術會移除一個或多個子宮肌瘤。
While preserving the uterus, laparomyomectomy excises selected benign muscle tumors. 剖腹肌瘤切除術在保留子宮的同時，切除選定的良性肌肉腫瘤。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部進路切開肌瘤。
sentences: By cutting into a myoma, laparomyomotomy differs from complete excision of the growth. 剖腹肌瘤切開術是切入肌瘤，有別於把腫塊完整切除。
In historical nomenclature, laparomyomotomy specified an abdominal route to incise a muscle tumor. 在舊式命名中，剖腹肌瘤切開術特指由腹部進路切入肌肉腫瘤。

meaning: 罕見舊稱；經腹部切口切除腎臟，即腹式腎切除術。
sentences: Through a transabdominal route, laparonephrectomy removes a kidney. 經腹腔進路，腹式腎切除術會移除一枚腎臟。
Unlike nephrotomy, laparonephrectomy denotes removal of the kidney rather than incision into it. 不同於腎切開術，腹式腎切除術表示移除腎臟，而非切入腎臟。

meaning: 罕見且過時的外科術語；經腹部進路切開腎臟。
sentences: Through transabdominal access, laparonephrotomy makes an incision into a kidney. 經腹腔進路，剖腹腎切開術會在腎臟上作切口。
For direct renal access, laparonephrotomy opens kidney tissue without denoting organ removal. 為直接進入腎臟，剖腹腎切開術會切開腎組織，但不表示移除器官。

meaning: 罕見醫學舊語：以縫線閉合腹壁或腹部傷口的手術。
sentences: Surgeons perform laparorrhaphy to close an abdominal wound. 外科醫師施行剖腹縫合術以閉合腹部傷口。
Careful laparorrhaphy restores the divided layers of the abdominal wall. 細緻的剖腹縫合術會重新接合腹壁各個切開層次。

meaning: 罕見醫學舊語：經腹部切口切除輸卵管的手術。
sentences: A laparosalpingectomy removes a fallopian tube through an abdominal incision. 經腹輸卵管切除術透過腹部切口移除一條輸卵管。
Severe tubal disease once prompted laparosalpingectomy by open surgery. 嚴重輸卵管病變過去可能促使醫師採用開腹方式切除輸卵管。

meaning: 罕見醫學舊語：經腹部切口切開輸卵管的手術。
sentences: In laparosalpingotomy, the surgeon reaches and opens a fallopian tube through the abdomen. 經腹輸卵管切開術中，外科醫師由腹部進入並切開輸卵管。
Unlike tube removal, laparosalpingotomy creates an opening in the affected tube. 與切除輸卵管不同，經腹輸卵管切開術是在患側輸卵管上造口。

meaning: 專門醫學用語：以腹腔鏡經小切口檢查或操作腹腔內器官的程序。
sentences: During laparoscopy, a camera enters the abdomen through a small incision. 腹腔鏡檢查時，攝影鏡頭會經由小切口進入腹部。
Many gallbladder operations use laparoscopy instead of a large open incision. 許多膽囊手術採用腹腔鏡，而不做大型開腹切口。

meaning: 罕見醫學舊語：經腹部切口切除脾臟的手術。
sentences: Open laparosplenectomy removes the spleen through an incision in the abdomen. 開腹脾臟切除術經由腹部切口移除脾臟。
Before minimally invasive methods, laparosplenectomy required wide abdominal access. 微創方法出現以前，經腹脾臟切除術需要較大的腹部手術通道。

meaning: 罕見醫學舊語：經腹部切口進入並切開脾臟的手術。
sentences: With laparosplenotomy, an abdominal incision provides access for cutting into the spleen. 經腹脾臟切開術利用腹部切口進入並切開脾臟。
Because the spleen bleeds readily, laparosplenotomy demands strict control of hemorrhage. 脾臟容易出血，因此經腹脾臟切開術必須嚴格控制失血。

meaning: 罕見昆蟲學形容詞：腹部有斑點的；亦指腹部氣門位於腹板間膜上的。
sentences: Entomologists call a spotted abdomen laparostict in older descriptive terminology. 在較舊的形態描述術語中，昆蟲學家稱有斑點的腹部為腹斑型。
Certain scarab beetles are laparostict because their abdominal spiracles lie in connecting membranes. 某些金龜子屬腹氣門型，因其腹部氣門位於連接膜上。

meaning: 昆蟲學舊分類專名：腹氣門型金龜子類群，包括許多糞金龜。
sentences: Older taxonomies placed many dung beetles in Laparosticti. 較舊的分類法把許多糞金龜歸入腹氣門類群。
Members of Laparosticti have abdominal spiracles positioned in the connecting membranes. 腹氣門類群成員的腹部氣門位於連接膜上。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：對腹腔與胸腔進行內視鏡檢查。
sentences: Combined laparothoracoscopy permits endoscopic inspection of both abdominal and chest cavities. 腹胸腔聯合內視鏡檢查可察看腹腔與胸腔。
When disease crosses the diaphragm, laparothoracoscopy can assess both sides of that boundary. 疾病跨越橫膈膜時，腹胸腔聯合內視鏡檢查可評估其兩側。

meaning: 用於剖腹手術的手術器械
sentences: The laparotome has a broad blade suited to abdominal surgery. 剖腹刀有適合腹部手術的寬刃。
A surgeon selected the laparotome from the sterilized tray. 外科醫師從消毒托盤中選取剖腹刀。

meaning: 過時醫學用語：施行剖腹術的外科醫師。
sentences: Historically, a laparotomist specialized in operations that opened the abdominal cavity. 過去所謂剖腹術醫師，專門施行開啟腹腔的手術。
An experienced laparotomist had to control bleeding from a long abdominal incision. 經驗豐富的剖腹術醫師必須控制長腹部切口的出血。

meaning: 進行剖腹手術。
sentences: On rainyday Ivy tried to laparotomize before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了進行剖腹手術的動作。
By familyday David watched them laparotomize near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 專門醫學用語：切開腹壁以進入腹腔的手術。
sentences: Emergency laparotomy opens the abdomen so surgeons can control internal bleeding. 緊急剖腹術會打開腹腔，讓外科醫師控制內出血。
After a laparotomy, the abdominal wall is closed in separate layers. 剖腹術完成後，腹壁會分層閉合。

meaning: 罕見婦科醫學舊語：經腹部途徑切開子宮頸的手術。
sentences: Through laparotrachelotomy, a surgeon approaches and incises the cervix from the abdomen. 經腹子宮頸切開術由腹部進入並切開子宮頸。
Modern gynecology seldom describes cervical surgery as laparotrachelotomy. 現代婦科很少以經腹子宮頸切開術描述子宮頸手術。

meaning: 膝上板；放在大腿上作為書寫、閱讀或置物平面的輕便板。
sentences: The lapboard supported her notebook while she sat without a desk. 她沒有書桌可用時，以膝上板托住筆記本。
A padded lapboard keeps a writing surface steady across both thighs. 有軟墊的膝上板能讓雙腿上的書寫平面保持穩定。

meaning: 罕見英國方言農業詞：為晾乾而堆成的小捆或小堆乾草。
sentences: Farm workers shaped each lapcock loosely so air could dry the hay. 農工把每個小草堆堆得鬆散，讓空氣能吹乾乾草。
Before baling, a lapcock kept cut grass gathered above the damp ground. 打包以前，小草堆使割下的草集中並離開潮濕地面。

meaning: 鳶尾科的一個植物分類屬
sentences: Lapeirousia sends slender flowers above grasslike leaves. 這種鳶尾科植物從似草葉片上方長出纖細花朵。
A dry hillside supported several Lapeirousia bulbs. 乾燥山坡孕育了幾株這種鳶尾科球莖植物。

meaning: 翻領；外套或西裝前襟向外翻折、連接衣領的部分。
sentences: His name badge was pinned to the left lapel. 他的名牌別在左側翻領上。
Each lapel folds outward from the front opening of the jacket. 每片翻領都從外套前方開口處向外翻折。

meaning: 罕見職業舊稱：製作或縫製衣服翻領的人。
sentences: In divided garment work, a lapeler formed and stitched coat lapels. 在分工製衣中，翻領工負責塑形並縫製外衣翻領。
Precise pressing helped the lapeler produce a crisp folded edge. 精準熨燙可幫助翻領工做出俐落的折邊。

meaning: 有翻領。
sentences: On holiday Frank noticed a lapelled pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得有翻領。
By Saturday Ella found the lapelled quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有有翻領的特質。

meaning: 一膝之量；坐著時雙腿或裙襬所能承載的數量。
sentences: She carried a lapful of apples while seated in the cart. 她坐在車上，腿上捧著滿滿一抱蘋果。
One lapful of laundry covered both of his knees. 一大抱待洗衣物蓋住了他的雙膝。

meaning: 罕見古語：石匠或石材雕刻工。
sentences: A medieval lapicide cut inscriptions into blocks of stone. 中世紀石匠會把銘文刻入石塊。
Steady blows let the lapicide shape a capital without cracking it. 穩定敲擊讓石匠能塑造柱頭而不使其裂開。

meaning: 寶石的同義詞。
sentences: On holiday Ivy noticed a lapidarian pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得寶石的同義詞。
By marketday Ella found the lapidarian quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有寶石的同義詞的特質。

meaning: 罕見詞：寶石切磨師或寶石鑑賞專家。
sentences: The lapidarist judged the gem by its color, clarity, and cut. 寶石專家依顏色、淨度與切工評判寶石。
Under magnification, an expert lapidarist can distinguish inclusions from surface scratches. 在放大觀察下，熟練的寶石專家能分辨內含物與表面刮痕。

meaning: 屬於或關於寶石和寶石，或加工它們的藝術。
sentences: On payday Anna noticed a lapidary pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於或關於寶石和寶石，或加工它們的藝術。
By holiday Ella found the lapidary quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於或關於寶石和寶石，或加工它們的藝術的特質。

meaning: 向人投擲石塊或其他物體作為懲罰，有時直至死亡。
sentences: On payday Ben tried to lapidate before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了向人投擲石塊或其他物體作為懲罰，有時直至死亡的動作。
By payday Ella watched them lapidate near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 正式或古語：以石塊投擲攻擊，尤指作為刑罰的石刑。
sentences: Some ancient laws prescribed lapidation as a form of execution. 某些古代法律規定以石刑作為處決方式。
Death by lapidation results from a crowd repeatedly throwing stones at the condemned person. 石刑致死是眾人反覆向受刑者投擲石塊的結果。

meaning: 罕見古語：投石者，尤指執行石刑的人。
sentences: A lapidator throws stones at a person or target. 投石者向人或目標投擲石塊。
Under a sentence of stoning, each lapidator participated directly in the punishment. 在石刑判決下，每名投石者都直接參與刑罰。

meaning: 罕見詞形／疑似誤拼，現無可核實的通行英語義。
sentences: Because lapideon is an unverifiable rare form, it should not be assigned a modern definition. 由於這是無法核實的罕見詞形，不應為它指定現代詞義。
No standard English sense for lapideon can be confirmed. 目前無法確認這個罕見詞形有任何標準英語義。

meaning: 石頭的本質；石質的。
sentences: On payday Frank noticed a lapideous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得石頭的本質、石質。
By hikingday Ella found the lapideous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有石頭的本質、石質的特質。

meaning: 能夠石化其他身體。
sentences: On payday Grace noticed a lapidescent pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得能夠石化其他身體。
By festivalday Ella found the lapidescent quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有能夠石化其他身體的特質。

meaning: 生活在岩石或石頭周圍或下面。
sentences: On payday Hugo noticed a lapidicolous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得生活在岩石或石頭周圍或下面。
By movingday Ella found the lapidicolous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有生活在岩石或石頭周圍或下面的特質。

meaning: 形成或轉化為石頭；石化。
sentences: On payday Ivy noticed a lapidific pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得形成或轉化為石頭、石化。
By washday Ella found the lapidific quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有形成或轉化為石頭、石化的特質。

meaning: 罕見地質學舊語：物質變成石頭的過程；石化。
sentences: Mineral deposition can cause lapidification of buried organic remains. 礦物沉積可使埋藏的有機遺骸發生石化。
Through lapidification, dissolved minerals gradually replace the original tissue. 在石化過程中，溶解礦物逐漸取代原有組織。

meaning: 變成石頭或石頭。
sentences: On harvestday Anna tried to lapidify before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了變成石頭或石頭的動作。
By meetingday Ella watched them lapidify near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 罕見詞：切割、研磨或雕刻寶石的工匠；寶石專家。
sentences: Using a rotating wheel, the lapidist polished facets on the gemstone. 寶石工匠用旋轉砂輪拋光寶石刻面。
An accomplished lapidist chooses cuts that reduce flaws and preserve weight. 熟練的寶石工匠會選擇能減少瑕疵並保留重量的切法。

meaning: 罕見詞：石質、石性；像石頭般堅硬的性質。
sentences: Increasing mineral content gave the deposit greater lapidity. 礦物含量增加，使沉積物具有更強的石質特性。
Complete lapidity distinguishes petrified tissue from merely dried tissue. 完全石質化可區分石化組織與僅僅乾燥的組織。

meaning: lapidoso的陰性複數形式。
sentences: On harvestday David noticed a lapidose pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得陰性複數形式。
By familyday Ella found the lapidose quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有陰性複數形式的特質。

meaning: 具有小石頭的形狀。
sentences: On harvestday Ella noticed a lapilliform pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得具有小石頭的形狀。
By picnicday Ella found the lapilliform quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有具有小石頭的形狀的特質。

meaning: 罕見火山學詞形：火山礫，即直徑約二至六十四毫米的火山碎屑；同火山礫單數形式。

meaning: 過時航海用語：面向船首時的左舷；後由 port 取代，以免與 starboard 混淆。
