Because larboard sounded like starboard, mariners replaced it with port. 因舊稱與右舷的英文讀音相近，航海者改以另一名稱表示左舷。

meaning: 罕見、過時航海用語：左舷值班隊的水手；larbowlines 的異體拼法。
sentences: The larbolins formed the ship’s old-fashioned port watch. 這群左舷班水手組成船上舊式的左舷值班隊。
At their watch change, larbolins relieved the opposite division. 到了換班時刻，左舷班水手接替另一值班隊。

meaning: 罕見、過時航海用語：編入左舷值班隊的水手們。
sentences: The larbowlines stood watch as the vessel’s port-side division. 這群左舷班水手以船上左舷分隊的身分值勤。
When duty rotated, larbowlines alternated with the starboard watch. 值勤輪替時，左舷班水手與右舷班交替當值。

meaning: 罕見法律用語：犯竊盜罪者；竊賊。
sentences: A larcener unlawfully takes another person’s property intending permanent deprivation. 竊盜者非法取走他人財物，並意圖使物主永久失去它。
Unlike a borrower, the larcener has no intention of returning the property. 竊盜者不同於借用者，並無歸還財物的打算。

meaning: 偷竊的；鬼頭鬼腦。
sentences: On washday Anna noticed a larcenic pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得偷竊的、鬼頭鬼腦。
By Saturday Hugo found the larcenic quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有偷竊的、鬼頭鬼腦的特質。

meaning: 帶偷竊性的。
sentences: On washday Ben noticed a larcenish pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得帶偷竊性。
By Sunday Hugo found the larcenish quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有帶偷竊性的特質。

meaning: 罕見法律用語：犯竊盜罪者；與 larcener 同義。
sentences: A convicted larcenist has been found guilty of unlawful taking. 經定罪的竊盜犯已被裁定非法取走財物。
Every larcenist intends to deprive the rightful owner of property. 每名竊盜犯都有使合法物主失去財物的意圖。

meaning: 犯有竊盜罪，有偷竊傾向。
sentences: On washday David noticed a larcenous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得犯有竊盜罪，有偷竊傾向。
By marketday Hugo found the larcenous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有犯有竊盜罪，有偷竊傾向的特質。

meaning: 以一種盜竊的方式。
sentences: On washday Ella spoke larcenously during dinner. 晚餐時，她說話時顯得以一種盜竊的方式。
By rainyday Hugo moved larcenously across the room. 後來，他移動時也顯得以一種盜竊的方式。

meaning: 法律用語：未經同意取走他人動產，並意圖使物主永久失去該財物的竊盜罪。
sentences: Taking a wallet with intent to keep it may constitute larceny. 取走皮夾並打算據為己有，可能構成竊盜罪。
Common-law larceny requires both unlawful taking and wrongful intent. 普通法上的竊盜罪同時要求非法取走行為與不法意圖。

meaning: 落葉松屬的落葉針葉樹
sentences: A larch turns golden before shedding its soft needles. 落葉松在掉落柔軟針葉前會變成金黃色。
The mountain cabin stood among tall larch trees. 山間小屋坐落在高大的落葉松之間。

meaning: 落葉松樹的或關於落葉松樹的。
sentences: The mountainside was covered in a thick larchen forest. 山坡上覆蓋著茂密的落葉松林。
They used larchen wood to build the sturdy fence around the cabin. 他們使用落葉松木來建造木屋周圍堅固的圍欄。

meaning: 豬脂經煉製而成的食用脂肪；亦可作動詞，指在肉中嵌入脂肪條。
sentences: Rendered pork fat becomes lard after impurities are removed. 豬脂經煉製並去除雜質後便成為豬油。
Bakers sometimes use lard to make a flaky pie crust. 烘焙者有時用豬油製作酥鬆的派皮。

meaning: 罕見或方言用語：酪梨（牛油果）的舊稱或別稱。
sentences: The regional name lard fruit refers to the avocado. 這個地方名稱指的就是酪梨。
Because lard fruit has oily flesh, the comparison evokes animal fat. 這種果實的果肉富含油脂，因此其別稱讓人聯想到動物脂肪。

meaning: 過時醫學用語：早期病理學曾用來稱呼澱粉樣變組織中的澱粉樣物質。
sentences: Nineteenth-century pathologists called amyloid substance lardacein. 十九世紀病理學家曾把澱粉樣物質稱為脂樣蛋白。
Modern medicine treats lardacein as historically obsolete terminology. 現代醫學把這個名稱視為已淘汰的歷史術語。

meaning: 類似豬油。
sentences: On washday Jack noticed a lardaceous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得類似豬油。
By seasonday Hugo found the lardaceous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有類似豬油的特質。

meaning: 食品貯藏室；尤指傳統住宅中陰涼、用來保存食物的小室。
sentences: The stone-floored larder keeps cheese and preserves relatively cool. 石地板的食品貯藏室能讓乳酪和醃藏食品保持較低溫。
Before refrigeration, a larder provided cool storage for household food. 冰箱普及前，食品貯藏室為家中食物提供陰涼的存放處。

meaning: 礦物學專門用語：單斜晶系的含水銨硼酸鹽礦物，化學式為 NH₄B₅O₈·4H₂O。
sentences: The mineral larderellite contains ammonium, boron, oxygen, and water. 拉德雷爾石含有銨、硼、氧與結晶水。
Crystalline larderellite belongs to the monoclinic crystal system. 結晶狀的拉德雷爾石屬於單斜晶系。

meaning: 古舊職稱：管理食品貯藏室及其存糧的人。
sentences: A household larderer controlled access to stored provisions. 宅邸的食品貯藏管理人掌管存糧的取用。
The chief larderer accounted for meat, cheese, and other provisions. 首席食品貯藏管理人負責核算肉類、乳酪及其他存糧。

meaning: 罕見名詞：一整間食品貯藏室所能容納的量。
sentences: One larderful of provisions could sustain the household for weeks. 滿滿一貯藏室的糧食可供一家人維持數週。
Their winter larderful included cured meat, grain, and preserves. 他們冬季的一整室存糧包括醃肉、穀物與醃藏食品。

meaning: 類似於食品儲藏室或具有食品儲藏室的特徵。
sentences: On restday Ella noticed a larderlike pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得類似於食品儲藏室或具有食品儲藏室的特徵。
By restday Hugo found the larderlike quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有類似於食品儲藏室或具有食品儲藏室的特徵的特質。

meaning: 罕見形容詞：外觀、質地或稠度像豬油的。
sentences: A lardiform deposit looks pale, greasy, and fatlike. 脂樣沉積物看起來色淡、油膩且像脂肪。
Pathologists once described waxy tissue as lardiform. 病理學家過去曾把蠟樣組織描述為豬油狀。

meaning: 罕見、古舊礦物名稱：皂石或滑石質、外觀帶油脂感的石材。
sentences: Soft lardite can be cut like other varieties of soapstone. 柔軟的脂皂石可像其他皂石品種一樣切削。
A greasy sheen gives lardite its fatlike descriptive name. 油脂般的光澤使這種石材得到帶有脂感的名稱。

meaning: 主要為東亞藤本植物的木通科
sentences: Lardizabalaceae contains woody vines with unusual hanging fruits. 這個科包含結出奇特垂掛果實的木質藤本。
A Lardizabalaceae vine wound through the forest canopy. 一株木通科藤本穿過森林樹冠。

meaning: 屬於或與Lardizabalaceae有關的。
sentences: On restday Hugo noticed a lardizabalaceous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於或與有關。
By travelday Hugo found the lardizabalaceous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於或與有關的特質。

meaning: 烹飪用語：切成小條或小丁的豬脂，通常經鹽醃，用於增添風味。
sentences: A crisp lardon adds salty pork flavor to a salad. 一小塊煎脆的鹹豬脂能為沙拉增添鹹香。
The cook browned each lardon before adding the vegetables. 廚師先把每一小條豬脂煎上色，再加入蔬菜。

meaning: 古舊且侮辱性的用語：肥胖或貪吃的人。
sentences: Calling someone a lardworm insults that person’s weight or appetite. 以肥蟲稱呼他人，是針對其體重或食量的侮辱。
The obsolete slur lardworm compares a corpulent person to greasy vermin. 這個過時蔑稱把肥胖者比作油膩的害蟲。

meaning: 含豬油的；油膩的。
sentences: On meetingday Anna noticed a lardy pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得含豬油的、油膩。
By Monday Ivy found the lardy quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有含豬油的、油膩的特質。

meaning: 罕見詞形／疑似誤拼，現無可核實的通行英語義。
sentences: No standard English meaning can be reliably assigned to lareabell. 目前無法可靠判定這個罕見字形的標準英語義。
Without an authoritative attestation, lareabell may be a misspelling. 在缺乏權威例證下，這個字形可能是誤拼。

meaning: 一個分類科
sentences: Larentiidae appears among the named families of geometrid moths. 這個科名出現在尺蛾類的分類科名中。
Several Larentiidae species rest with wings spread on tree bark. 這個科的數種蛾張翅停在樹皮上。

meaning: 方言眼語：laugh 的擬音拼法，可表示「笑」或「笑出聲」。
sentences: In eye dialect, larf represents a nonstandard pronunciation of laugh. 在方言式拼寫中，這個字模擬「笑」的非標準讀音。
A comic voice may say larf where standard spelling has laugh. 喜劇式口吻可能以方言拼法代替標準的「笑」字。

meaning: 罕見詞形／疑似誤拼，現無可核實的通行英語義。
sentences: No established English expansion is reliably verifiable for larfbg. 目前無法可靠核實這串罕見字母的固定英語全稱。
As an unattested string, larfbg has no safely assignable conventional meaning. 作為缺乏可靠例證的字串，它沒有可安全判定的慣用義。

meaning: 罕見詞形／疑似誤拼，現無可核實的通行英語義。
sentences: No conventional English definition is reliably verifiable for larflm. 目前無法可靠核實這串罕見字母的慣用英語定義。
As a possibly malformed initialism, larflm lacks a safely assignable meaning. 它可能是拼寫有誤的首字母縮略串，無法安全判定詞義。

meaning: 大的
sentences: They live in a large house with a beautiful swimming pool. 他們住在一間帶有漂亮游泳池的大房子裡。
The company is planning to expand its business into larger markets. 公司計劃將業務擴展到更大的市場。

meaning: 解剖學用語：消化道末段，由盲腸、結腸、直腸與肛管構成，主要吸收水分並形成糞便。
sentences: The large intestine absorbs water and compacts waste into feces. 大腸吸收水分，並把廢物壓實形成糞便。
After the small bowel, the large intestine continues through the colon to the rectum. 小腸之後，消化道經由大腸的結腸部分延續至直腸。

meaning: 腦容量大的。
sentences: On meetingday Grace noticed a largebrained pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得腦容量大。
By Sunday Ivy found the largebrained quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有腦容量大的特質。

meaning: 手大的。
sentences: On meetingday Hugo noticed a largehanded pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得手大。
By springday Ivy found the largehanded quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有手大的特質。

meaning: 心胸寬廣的另一種形式。
sentences: On meetingday Ivy noticed a largehearted pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得心胸寬廣的另一種形式。
By marketday Ivy found the largehearted quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有心胸寬廣的另一種形式的特質。

meaning: 罕見名詞：寬宏、慷慨而富同情心的品格。
sentences: Her largeheartedness led her to forgive the sincere apology. 她的寬宏使她原諒了真誠道歉的人。
True largeheartedness combines generosity with sympathy for others. 真正的寬厚結合了慷慨與對他人的同情。

meaning: 很大程度上
sentences: The success of the project was largely due to our teamwork today. 專案的成功很大程度上（很大程度上）歸功於我們今天的團隊合作。
The city's population managing to be largely from local areas now. 這座城市的人口現在竟然（能）大多來自當地。

meaning: 適用於各種大口魚類。
sentences: On gardenday Anna noticed a largemouth pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得適用於各種大口魚類。
By holiday Ivy found the largemouth quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有適用於各種大口魚類的特質。

meaning: 嘴大的；說話誇張的。
sentences: On gardenday Ben noticed a largemouthed pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得嘴大的、說話誇張。
By payday Ivy found the largemouthed quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有嘴大的、說話誇張的特質。

meaning: 放大。
sentences: On gardenday Chloe tried to largen before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了放大的動作。
By harvestday Ivy watched them largen near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 巨大、寬廣或數量多的性質；古義亦指慷慨。
sentences: The largeness of the hall allows thousands to gather inside. 大廳的寬廣使數千人能在其中聚集。
In older prose, largeness can denote generosity rather than physical size. 在較古老的散文中，這個詞可表示慷慨，而非實際尺寸巨大。

meaning: 慷慨贈與的錢財或禮物；亦指慷慨施予，為 largesse 的異體拼法。
sentences: Royal largess once rewarded loyal servants with money or land. 王室的慷慨賞賜過去會以金錢或土地獎勵忠誠臣僕。
Private largess funded meals for families facing hunger. 私人的慷慨捐助資助了面臨飢餓家庭的餐食。

meaning: 比慢板慢，但不如慢板慢；幾乎是小行板。
sentences: On gardenday Frank noticed a larghetto pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得比慢板慢，但不如慢板慢、幾乎是小行板。
By hikingday Ivy found the larghetto quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有比慢板慢，但不如慢板慢、幾乎是小行板的特質。

meaning: 豐富;充足。
sentences: On gardenday Grace noticed a largifical pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得豐富、充足。
By festivalday Ivy found the largifical quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有豐富、充足的特質。

meaning: 有點大。
sentences: On gardenday Hugo noticed a largish pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得有點大。
By movingday Ivy found the largish quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有有點大的特質。

meaning: 冷僻或古語：慷慨施予的行為，或所贈的財物；有時帶賄賂意味。
sentences: Ancient political largition could buy favor through lavish gifts. 古代政治上的厚贈可能藉豪奢禮物收買支持。
A charitable largition bestows wealth freely upon people in need. 慈善性的慷慨施予會把財物無償給予有需要的人。

meaning: 施予的；贈與的。
sentences: On gardenday Jack noticed a largitional pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得施予的、贈與。
By restday Ivy found the largitional quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有施予的、贈與的特質。

meaning: 堅強莊嚴。
sentences: On travelday Anna noticed a largo pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得堅強莊嚴。
By meetingday Ivy found the largo quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有堅強莊嚴的特質。

meaning: 專名詞形：喬治亞的法定貨幣拉里；一拉里等於一百特特里。
sentences: Lari is the Georgian currency divided into one hundred tetri. 拉里是喬治亞貨幣，每一單位分為一百特特里。
One Lari contains exactly one hundred units called tetri. 一拉里恰好包含一百個稱為特特里的小單位。

meaning: 喬治亞的法定貨幣單位拉里；一拉里等於一百特特里。
sentences: The lari serves as the official currency of Georgia. 拉里是喬治亞的官方貨幣。
Each Georgian lari is subdivided into one hundred tetri. 每一喬治亞拉里可細分為一百特特里。

meaning: 專名：可作姓氏；不是通行英語普通名詞。
sentences: As a surname, Laria functions as a proper name. 作為姓氏，這個名稱屬於專名。
Unlike a common noun, Laria identifies a family name. 它不像普通名詞，而是用來標識家族姓氏。

meaning: 套索；用來套捕牲畜的長繩。
sentences: A ranch hand swung the lariat before roping the calf. 牧場工人先揮動套索，再套住小牛。
The lariat tightened around the steer without breaking. 套索在閹牛身上收緊而沒有斷裂。

meaning: 罕見、方言或過時詞：落葉松。
sentences: In older dialect, larick denotes a deciduous conifer. 在舊方言中，此詞指一種落葉針葉樹。
Unlike most conifers, a larick sheds its needles annually. 這種樹不同於多數針葉樹，每年會落針葉。

meaning: 鷗科成員，包括海鷗和燕鷗等
sentences: A larid circled above the fishing boat in the wind. 一隻鷗科鳥在風中繞著漁船盤旋。
The larid snatched a small fish from the surface. 那隻鷗科鳥從水面叼走一條小魚。

meaning: 包含海鷗、燕鷗等鳥類的鷗科
sentences: Laridae includes gulls, terns, and related shorebirds. 鷗科包含海鷗、燕鷗和近親涉水鳥。
A Laridae colony crowded the flat island at low tide. 一群鷗科鳥在退潮時擠滿平坦小島。

meaning: 拉林。
sentences: On travelday Grace noticed a laridine pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得拉林。
By Tuesday Jack found the laridine quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有拉林的特質。

meaning: 罕見詞：作繫帶用的長皮條或皮帶。
sentences: A rawhide larigo secured the pack to the saddle. 一條生皮繫帶把行囊固定在馬鞍上。
Horse gear once included a larigo for tight fastening. 馬具過去包含一條可緊縛物件的長皮帶。

meaning: 音樂專門用語：管風琴的高音變音音栓，通常為一又三分之一英尺音栓。
sentences: The organist added the larigot to brighten the upper register. 管風琴師加入高音變音音栓，使高音域更明亮。
At one and one-third feet, the larigot sounds a high fifth. 這種一又三分之一英尺音栓會發出高音域的五度音。

meaning: 鳥類學專門用語：鷗科鳥類。
sentences: Any lariid typically has long wings and webbed feet. 鷗科鳥類通常具有長翼與蹼足。
That coastal lariid feeds on fish and marine invertebrates. 那種沿海鷗科鳥類以魚和海洋無脊椎動物為食。

meaning: 動物分類專名：鷗科，包含鷗等近緣鳥類。
sentences: Within bird taxonomy, Lariidae is the gull family. 在鳥類分類學中，鷗科就是鷗類所屬的科。
Most Lariidae possess webbed feet suited to aquatic habitats. 多數鷗科鳥類有適應水域環境的蹼足。

meaning: 歷史貨幣名：拉林，一種彎成鉤狀的銀幣，昔日流通於印度洋沿岸。
sentences: Merchants weighed each silver larin during Indian Ocean trade. 印度洋貿易中的商人會秤量每枚鉤形銀幣。
Bent like a hook, the larin circulated around the Persian Gulf. 這種銀幣彎如鉤子，曾在波斯灣周邊流通。

meaning: 鷗科中的海鷗亞科
sentences: Larinae contains the larger gulls found around many coasts. 這個亞科包含許多海岸常見的大型海鷗。
A member of Larinae stole food from the harbor pier. 一隻海鷗亞科鳥從港口碼頭搶走食物。

meaning: 屬於或屬於海鷗科，鷗科。
sentences: The biologist studied the larine population nesting on the cliffs. 生物學家研究了在懸崖上築巢的海鷗族群。
We watched the larine birds diving into the sea for fish. 我們看著鷗類鳥兒潛入海中捕魚。

meaning: 罕見、過時教育用語：藉音樂或節奏教授算術的方法。
sentences: Through larithmics, arithmetic drills followed musical rhythm. 透過這種教學法，算術練習會配合音樂節奏。
Early advocates of larithmics linked counting with melody. 此早期教學法的倡導者把計數與旋律相連。

meaning: 松科的落葉松屬
sentences: Larix loses its needles each autumn unlike most conifers. 落葉松屬不像多數針葉樹，每年秋天會掉針葉。
A Larix cone remained attached to the bare winter branch. 一個落葉松屬球果仍掛在冬季裸枝上。

meaning: 罕見化學用語：取自落葉松的苦味結晶性物質。
sentences: Chemically, larixin is described as a bitter crystalline substance. 在化學文獻中，此物質被描述為苦味結晶。
Larch tissue was historically processed to obtain larixin. 過去人們會處理落葉松組織以取得這種結晶物。

meaning: 雀形目中會唱歌的小型雀形鳥
sentences: A lark rose singing from the wheat field at sunrise. 日出時，一隻雲雀從麥田飛起歌唱。
The lark hovered above the meadow before dropping into the grass. 那隻雲雀在草地上方盤旋後降入草叢。

meaning: 罕見或過時詞：嬉鬧者；愛惡作劇的人。
sentences: A habitual larker turns serious occasions into playful mischief. 慣於嬉鬧的人會把嚴肅場合變成惡作劇。
Noisy pranks marked him as a larker among his companions. 吵鬧的惡作劇使他在同伴中顯得像個淘氣鬼。

meaning: 非正式用語：愛嬉鬧、淘氣的特質。
sentences: Her sudden larkiness disrupted the otherwise solemn ceremony. 她突然的嬉鬧打斷了原本莊嚴的儀式。
Despite the tension, larkiness spread through the group. 儘管氣氛緊張，眾人仍逐漸鬧成一片。

meaning: 尤指英式非正式用語：嬉鬧；開玩笑或惡作劇。
sentences: Their larking ended when the window cracked. 他們的胡鬧在窗戶裂開時停止了。
After hours of larking, the children finally settled down. 孩子們嬉鬧數小時後終於安靜下來。

meaning: 嬉鬧地。
sentences: On familyday Hugo spoke larkingly during dinner. 晚餐時，她說話時顯得嬉鬧。
By harvestday Jack moved larkingly across the room. 後來，他移動時也顯得嬉鬧。

meaning: 愛嬉鬧的。
sentences: On familyday Ivy noticed a larkish pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得愛嬉鬧。
By frostday Jack found the larkish quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有愛嬉鬧的特質。

meaning: 罕見詞：嬉鬧、愛開玩笑的性情。
sentences: His larkishness surfaced whenever the mood grew too formal. 每當氣氛過於拘謹，他愛玩鬧的性情就會顯露。
Unrestrained larkishness can turn harmless fun into disruption. 毫無節制的嬉鬧可能使無害玩笑變成擾亂。

meaning: 像雲雀的；像愛玩的人。
sentences: On picnicday Anna noticed a larklike pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得像雲雀的、像愛玩的人。
By hikingday Jack found the larklike quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有像雲雀的、像愛玩的人的特質。

meaning: 罕見詞：小雲雀；雲雀幼鳥。
sentences: One hungry larkling waited low in the grass. 一隻飢餓的雲雀幼鳥伏在草叢低處等待。
Before fledging, the larkling depended on its parents for food. 在離巢前，這隻小雲雀仰賴親鳥餵食。

meaning: 快活的；愛玩鬧的。
sentences: On picnicday Chloe noticed a larksome pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得快活的、愛玩鬧。
By movingday Jack found the larksome quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有快活的、愛玩鬧的特質。

meaning: 飛燕草屬的植物，尤其是飛燕草和翠雀花
sentences: Larkspur sent blue flower spikes above the cottage garden. 飛燕草在小屋花園上方長出藍色花穗。
A vase of larkspur brightened the wooden kitchen table. 一瓶飛燕草讓木製廚房桌明亮起來。

By washday Jack found the larky quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有愛胡鬧的特質。

By restday Jack watched them larm near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

By gardenday Jack found the larmoyant quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有愛哭的、感傷做作的特質。

sentences: Current dictionaries provide no verifiable English sense for Larnaudian. 現有詞典未提供此詞可核實的英語義。
Because evidence is lacking, Larnaudian may represent a misspelling. 由於缺乏證據，此詞形可能是誤拼。

sentences: An ancient larnax could hold cremated human remains. 古代的小型棺槨可盛放火化後的人類遺骸。
Painted decoration sometimes covered the sides of a larnax. 彩繪裝飾有時會覆滿這種箱形棺槨的側面。

sentences: The scientist identified several laroid species during the coastal survey. 科學家在海岸調查期間鑑定出了幾種鷗類物種。
Its laroid appearance makes it difficult to distinguish from a common gull. 它那類海鷗的外表讓人很難將它與普通海鷗區分開來。

meaning: 加拿大方言、歷史用語：以油鞣皮製成的高筒軟靴。
sentences: Each larrigan reached high enough to protect the lower leg. 每隻高筒軟靴都高至足以保護小腿。
Oil-tanned leather made the larrigan flexible and water-resistant. 油鞣皮使這種軟靴柔韌且耐水。

meaning: 淘氣、粗野而不守規矩的
sentences: On Monday Anna noticed a larrikin pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得淘氣、粗野而不守規矩。
By Monday Anna found the larrikin quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有淘氣、粗野而不守規矩的特質。

meaning: 罕見澳洲用語：流氓少年式的；頑皮粗野、蔑視規矩的。
sentences: The larrikinalian conduct combined rowdiness with contempt for authority. 這種流氓少年式行為兼具喧鬧與蔑視權威。
Such larrikinalian antics alarmed respectable residents of the district. 這類頑皮粗野的胡鬧使當地守規矩的居民不安。

sentences: His cheerful larrikiness mixed mischief with open irreverence. 他那快活的不羈氣質混合了淘氣與公然的不敬。
Rowdy larrikiness often resists solemn rules and social restraint. 粗野頑皮的作風往往抗拒嚴肅規矩與社會約束。

meaning: 澳洲用語：粗野頑皮、反權威的行為或作風。
sentences: Public larrikinism brought jeering and minor vandalism to the street. 公開的粗野胡鬧使街上出現嘲罵與輕微破壞。
Australian larrikinism can imply irreverence as well as rowdiness. 澳洲的這種作風可兼指不敬權威與喧鬧粗野。

meaning: 罕見詞形／疑似誤拼，現無可核實的通行英語義。
sentences: Current standard dictionaries provide no dependable sense for larriman. 現行標準詞典未提供此詞形的可靠詞義。
Absent trustworthy evidence, larriman should not be equated with larrikin. 缺乏可信證據時，不應把此詞逕自等同於澳洲的粗野少年。

sentences: One sharp larrup knocked the hat from his head. 猛烈的一擊把他頭上的帽子打落。
With a single larrup, the boxer staggered his opponent. 拳手只重擊一下便使對手踉蹌。

meaning: 過時詞形：卡車或貨車，為 lorry 的舊拼法。
sentences: In dated spelling, larry could denote a lorry. 在過時拼法中，此詞可指卡車或貨車。
A horse-drawn larry once carried heavy freight along the road. 這種馬拉貨車過去會沿路運送重貨。

meaning: 男性名字；通常為 Lawrence 的暱稱，屬專名。
sentences: As a given name, Larry often shortens Lawrence. 作為名字，此名通常是勞倫斯的暱稱。
In English naming practice, Larry functions as a masculine proper noun. 在英語命名慣例中，此名是男性專有名詞。

meaning: 斯堪地那維亞男性名字，源自 Laurentius，屬專名。
sentences: Across Scandinavia, Lars is established as a masculine given name. 在斯堪地那維亞，此名是通行的男性名字。
Derived from Laurentius, Lars belongs to the Lawrence name family. 此名源自勞倫提烏斯，與勞倫斯同源。

meaning: 礦物學專門用語：斜方晶系的鉛鋅矽酸鹽礦物，化學式為 PbZnSiO4。
sentences: Mineralogically, larsenite is a lead zinc silicate. 在礦物學上，此礦物是一種鉛鋅矽酸鹽。
Crystals of larsenite belong to the orthorhombic system. 這種礦物的晶體屬於斜方晶系。

meaning: 使無知者震驚的事物；使用者介面姿態調整工具
sentences: The absurd sculpture was a lart that startled every visitor. 那座荒誕雕塑是件讓每位訪客吃驚的東西。
A programmer installed lart to adjust the interface posture. 程式設計師安裝了這個姿態調整工具。

meaning: 羅馬神話專名：水澤仙女拉倫達；因洩露朱庇特的祕密而遭割舌，亦稱 Lara。
sentences: In Roman myth, Larunda revealed Jupiter's secret to Juno. 在羅馬神話中，拉倫達向茱諾洩露了朱庇特的祕密。
After Larunda lost her tongue, Mercury escorted her toward the underworld. 拉倫達失去舌頭後，墨丘利押送她前往冥界。

meaning: 包含許多常見海鷗的鷗科分類屬
sentences: Larus gulls gathered wherever fishing boats returned. 海鷗屬鳥類聚集在漁船返港的地方。
A Larus bird balanced on the harbor railing. 一隻海鷗屬鳥停在港口欄杆上保持平衡。

meaning: 幼蟲；動物發育中與成體明顯不同、通常會經變態的未成熟階段。
sentences: A caterpillar is the larva of a butterfly or moth. 毛毛蟲是蝴蝶或蛾的幼蟲。
Before metamorphosis, each larva feeds and grows rapidly. 在變態之前，每隻幼蟲都會快速進食與生長。

meaning: 被囊目或尾海鞘亞綱的舊稱
sentences: Larvacea refers to small tunicates that keep a tail as adults. 這個舊稱指成體仍保留尾巴的小型被囊動物。
A drifting Larvacea filters tiny food particles from seawater. 一隻漂浮的尾海鞘過濾海水中的微小食物顆粒。

meaning: 幼蟲；larva 的複數形。
sentences: Mosquito larvae develop in water before becoming flying adults. 蚊子的幼蟲先在水中發育，之後才成為會飛的成蟲。
These beetle larvae tunnel through decaying wood for food. 這些甲蟲幼蟲鑽行於腐木中覓食。

meaning: 屬於或與幼蟲有關的：
sentences: On Tuesday David noticed a larval pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於或與幼蟲有關的：。
By frostday Anna found the larval quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於或與幼蟲有關的：的特質。

meaning: 歷史動物分類專名：尾索動物中的幼形綱，今通常稱為 Appendicularia；成體保留幼生般的尾部。
sentences: Historically, Larvalia grouped tunicates that retain a tail as adults. 在歷史分類中，幼形綱包含成體仍保有尾部的被囊動物。
Modern zoology generally calls Larvalia by the name Appendicularia. 現代動物學通常把幼形綱稱為尾海鞘綱。

meaning: 罕見昆蟲學用語：飼養或培育幼蟲的容器或場所。
sentences: Inside the larvarium, controlled humidity supports insect development. 在幼蟲飼育容器內，受控的濕度有助昆蟲發育。
Adequate ventilation keeps a larvarium from becoming moldy. 充足通風可防止幼蟲飼育箱發霉。

meaning: 暗;朦朧;被掩蓋或可疑的疾病病例。
sentences: On Tuesday Grace noticed a larvate pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得暗、朦朧、被掩蓋或可疑的疾病病例。

meaning: 罕見或過時詞形：幼蟲，為 larva 的異體。
sentences: In obsolete usage, larve names an immature animal stage. 在過時用法中，此詞指動物的未成熟階段。
Before becoming an adult, a larve may undergo metamorphosis. 在成為成體前，這種幼體可能經歷變態。

meaning: 殺死幼蟲。
sentences: On Tuesday Ivy noticed a larvicidal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得殺死幼蟲。
By washday Anna found the larvicidal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有殺死幼蟲的特質。

meaning: 殺幼蟲劑；專門殺死昆蟲幼蟲的藥劑。
sentences: This larvicide kills mosquitoes before they reach adulthood. 這種殺幼蟲劑會在蚊子羽化前將其殺死。
Applied to standing water, the larvicide targets developing insects. 把殺幼蟲劑施於積水中，可消滅正在發育的昆蟲。

meaning: 棲息在幼蟲中的；寄生於幼蟲的
sentences: On Wednesday Anna noticed a larvicolous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得棲息在幼蟲中的、寄生於幼蟲。
By meetingday Anna found the larvicolous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有棲息在幼蟲中的、寄生於幼蟲的特質。

meaning: 具有幼蟲的形狀或結構
sentences: On Wednesday Ben noticed a larviform pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得具有幼蟲的形狀或結構。
By gardenday Anna found the larviform quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有具有幼蟲的形狀或結構的特質。

sentences: On Wednesday Chloe noticed a larvigerous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得帶有幼蟲的皮膚。
By travelday Anna found the larvigerous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有帶有幼蟲的皮膚的特質。

meaning: 地質學專門用語：產於挪威拉爾維克一帶、富含長石的粗粒火成岩，常呈藍銀色閃光。
sentences: Polished larvikite often displays blue or silvery feldspar flashes. 拋光後的這種岩石常顯現藍色或銀色長石閃光。
Quarried near Larvik, larvikite serves widely as decorative stone. 這種岩石開採於拉爾維克附近，廣泛用作裝飾石材。

sentences: On Wednesday Ella noticed a larviparous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得產下或放置活幼蟲，而不是卵。
By picnicday Anna found the larviparous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有產下或放置活幼蟲，而不是卵的特質。

sentences: On Wednesday Frank tried to larviposit before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了存放活的幼蟲而不是卵的動作。
By Monday Ben watched them larviposit near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

sentences: During larviposition, the female deposits living larvae rather than eggs. 在直接產幼蟲的過程中，雌體產下活幼蟲而非卵。
Some flies reproduce by larviposition after eggs hatch internally. 有些蠅的卵在體內孵化後，會直接產下幼蟲。

meaning: 以昆蟲幼蟲為食
sentences: On Wednesday Hugo noticed a larvivorous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得以昆蟲幼蟲為食。
By Wednesday Ben found the larvivorous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有以昆蟲幼蟲為食的特質。

meaning: 罕見動物學用語：極幼小或剛形成的幼蟲。
sentences: A newly formed larvule represents an especially early developmental stage. 剛形成的幼體代表特別早期的發育階段。
Soon after hatching, the tiny larvule begins feeding. 孵化不久後，這隻極幼小的幼蟲便開始進食。

sentences: On Wednesday Jack noticed a laryngal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得喉部。
By Friday Ben found the laryngal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有喉部的特質。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉部疼痛。
sentences: Persistent laryngalgia means pain localized in the larynx. 持續的喉痛是指疼痛集中於喉部。
Unlike general throat soreness, laryngalgia specifically concerns the larynx. 不同於一般喉嚨不適，此症狀特指喉部疼痛。

meaning: 屬於或關於喉部的。
sentences: He went to the clinic for a laryngeal examination after losing his voice. 他在失聲後去診所接受了喉部檢查。
Smoking can cause serious laryngeal problems over time. 吸菸隨著時間推移可能會導致嚴重的喉部問題。

meaning: 罕見詞形／疑似誤拼，現無可核實的通行英語義。
sentences: Standard medical terminology does not establish laryngeating as a noun. 標準醫學術語並未確立此詞為名詞。
Because laryngeating lacks a verifiable definition, its intended sense remains uncertain. 由於此詞沒有可核實的定義，其原意仍不確定。

meaning: 醫學專門用語：以手術切除部分或全部喉部。
sentences: A total laryngectomy removes the entire larynx. 全喉切除術會移除整個喉部。
Following laryngectomy, breathing may occur through a neck stoma. 接受喉切除術後，患者可能經由頸部造口呼吸。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉部阻塞。
sentences: Severe laryngemphraxis obstructs airflow through the larynx. 嚴重喉阻塞會妨礙空氣通過喉部。
When laryngemphraxis becomes complete, normal breathing is endangered. 當喉部完全阻塞時，正常呼吸便會受到威脅。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：用來檢視喉部內部的內視鏡。
sentences: A laryngendoscope allows direct inspection inside the larynx. 喉部內視鏡可直接檢視喉內。
Light from the laryngendoscope illuminates the vocal folds. 喉部內視鏡發出的光會照亮聲帶。

meaning: 喉部；larynx 的複數形。
sentences: Comparative anatomy examines how animal larynges differ in structure. 比較解剖學研究各種動物喉部的結構差異。
Both larynges showed the same congenital abnormality. 兩個喉部都呈現相同的先天異常。

meaning: 喉部的；與喉有關的
sentences: The doctor noticed a laryngic irritation after the concert. 演唱會後，醫生注意到她有喉部刺激。
A laryngic infection can make speaking painful. 喉部感染可能會讓說話變得疼痛。

meaning: 患有喉痙攣或與喉痙攣有關。
sentences: On Thursday Ivy noticed a laryngismal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得患有喉痙攣或與喉痙攣有關。
By frostday Ben found the laryngismal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有患有喉痙攣或與喉痙攣有關的特質。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉痙攣，即喉部肌肉突發性不自主收縮，可能阻礙呼吸。
sentences: Acute laryngismus can briefly obstruct breathing. 急性喉痙攣可能短暫阻塞呼吸。
During laryngismus, the laryngeal muscles contract involuntarily. 發生喉痙攣時，喉部肌肉會不自主收縮。

meaning: 與喉炎有關或患有喉炎。
sentences: On Friday Anna noticed a laryngitic pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得與喉炎有關或患有喉炎。
By hikingday Ben found the laryngitic quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有與喉炎有關或患有喉炎的特質。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉炎，即喉部發炎，常引起聲音沙啞或失聲。
sentences: Viral laryngitis often makes the voice hoarse. 病毒性喉炎常使聲音沙啞。
Persistent laryngitis may cause pain while speaking. 持續性喉炎可能造成說話疼痛。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉氣囊，即與喉腔相通的充氣囊狀擴張，有時會形成頸部腫塊。
sentences: An internal laryngocele may narrow the airway. 內型喉氣囊可能使氣道變窄。
A large laryngocele can bulge through the neck. 大型喉氣囊可能向頸部外側隆起。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉穿刺術，即以針穿刺喉部。
sentences: Emergency laryngocentesis creates access through the larynx with a needle. 緊急喉穿刺術以針穿過喉部建立通道。
Unlike an incision, laryngocentesis uses a puncture. 喉穿刺術不同於切開術，採用的是穿刺方式。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉正中切開術，通常經甲狀軟骨切開喉部。
sentences: Median laryngofission divides the thyroid cartilage to expose the larynx. 喉正中切開術會切開甲狀軟骨以暴露喉部。
Surgical laryngofission provides direct access to the laryngeal cavity. 喉正中切開術可直接進入喉腔。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：沿正中線切開喉部的手術，常涉及切開甲狀軟骨。
sentences: In laryngofissure, the surgeon opens the larynx along its midline. 進行喉正中切開術時，外科醫師沿中線打開喉部。
Traditional laryngofissure may split the thyroid cartilage. 傳統喉正中切開術可能會劈開甲狀軟骨。

meaning: 醫學專門用語：記錄喉部運動或聲帶振動的儀器。
sentences: A laryngograph records patterns of vocal-fold vibration. 喉動描記器會記錄聲帶振動的模式。
With a laryngograph, researchers can measure changes during phonation. 研究人員可用喉動描記器測量發聲時的變化。

meaning: 醫學專門用語：喉部的影像造影或圖形記錄檢查。
sentences: Contrast laryngography can outline structures within the larynx. 喉部對比造影可顯示喉內構造的輪廓。
Unlike laryngoscopy, laryngography produces an image or tracing. 喉部造影不同於喉鏡檢查，會產生影像或描記圖。

meaning: 屬於或關於喉科的。
sentences: On Friday Ivy noticed a laryngological pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於或關於喉科。
By familyday Ben found the laryngological quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於或關於喉科的特質。

meaning: 較舊醫學用語：專門診治喉部疾病的醫師。
sentences: A laryngologist specializes in diseases of the larynx. 喉科醫師專門診治喉部疾病。
The laryngologist examined the singer's persistent hoarseness. 喉科醫師檢查了歌手持續的聲音沙啞。

meaning: 醫學用語：研究與診治喉部及其疾病的醫學分科。
sentences: Modern laryngology covers voice, airway, and swallowing disorders. 現代喉科學涵蓋嗓音、氣道與吞嚥障礙。
Within laryngology, vocal-fold disease is a central concern. 在喉科學中，聲帶疾病是核心診療領域。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉部構造或功能的測量。
sentences: Clinical laryngometry quantifies dimensions or movements of the larynx. 臨床喉部測量會量化喉部的尺寸或運動。
Precise laryngometry can compare laryngeal measurements over time. 精確的喉部測量可比較不同時期的測量值。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉麻痺，尤指控制喉部或聲帶的肌肉失去運動功能。
sentences: Unilateral laryngoparalysis can leave one vocal fold immobile. 單側喉麻痺可使一側聲帶無法活動。
Severe laryngoparalysis may impair both breathing and speech. 嚴重喉麻痺可能同時妨礙呼吸與說話。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉部疾病或病變的統稱。
sentences: Chronic laryngopathy may alter voice quality. 慢性喉部病變可能改變音質。
This laryngopathy affects the tissues surrounding the vocal folds. 這種喉部疾病會影響聲帶周圍組織。

meaning: 屬於、屬於或連接喉部和咽部的
sentences: The patient suffered from laryngopharyngeal reflux, causing a chronic cough. 該名患者患有咽喉反流，導致慢性咳嗽。
Doctors examined the laryngopharyngeal tissue for signs of infection. 醫生檢查了咽喉部位的組織，看是否有感染跡象。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉咽炎，即喉部與咽部同時發炎。
sentences: Acute laryngopharyngitis can cause hoarseness and painful swallowing. 急性喉咽炎可能造成聲音沙啞與吞嚥疼痛。
Because laryngopharyngitis involves two regions, both the larynx and pharynx are inflamed. 喉咽炎涉及兩個部位，因此喉部與咽部都會發炎。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：經喉部聽診所聽得的聲音，或此種聽診現象。
sentences: In laryngophony, vocal sounds are assessed over the larynx. 喉音聽診會在喉部位置評估嗓音。
Abnormal laryngophony may reflect altered transmission of laryngeal sound. 異常喉音聽診現象可能反映喉音傳導改變。

meaning: 古舊醫學用語：喉結核，即結核病侵犯喉部。
sentences: Historical laryngophthisis referred to tuberculous disease of the larynx. 古稱的喉結核是指結核病侵犯喉部。
Untreated laryngophthisis could produce ulcers and severe hoarseness. 未治療的喉結核可能造成潰瘍與嚴重聲音沙啞。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉成形術，即修復或重建喉部的外科手術。
sentences: Reconstructive laryngoplasty restores the shape or function of the larynx. 重建性喉成形術可恢復喉部的形態或功能。
After trauma, laryngoplasty may repair damaged laryngeal structures. 喉部受創後，喉成形術可修復受損構造。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉麻痺，即喉部肌肉失去運動能力。
sentences: Bilateral laryngoplegia can compromise the airway. 雙側喉麻痺可能危及氣道通暢。
When laryngoplegia affects vocal-fold motion, the voice may weaken. 喉麻痺影響聲帶活動時，聲音可能變弱。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉出血，即血液由喉部組織流出。
sentences: Traumatic laryngorrhagia requires prompt control of the bleeding. 外傷性喉出血需要迅速止血。
Profuse laryngorrhagia may threaten the airway as blood accumulates. 大量喉出血可能因血液積聚而威脅氣道。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉部分泌物異常增多或流出。
sentences: Persistent laryngorrhea produces excessive discharge from the larynx. 持續性喉溢液會使喉部分泌物過度流出。
Inflammation may accompany laryngorrhea and increased mucus. 發炎可能伴隨喉溢液與黏液增加。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉硬結病，一種侵犯喉部的慢性肉芽腫性病變。
sentences: Advanced laryngoscleroma can scar and narrow the laryngeal airway. 晚期喉硬結病可能使喉部氣道結疤並狹窄。
Chronic laryngoscleroma forms firm granulomatous lesions in the larynx. 慢性喉硬結病會在喉部形成堅硬的肉芽腫病灶。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉鏡，用於觀察喉部與聲帶的器械。
sentences: A rigid laryngoscope gives a direct view of the vocal folds. 硬式喉鏡可直接觀察聲帶。
Using the laryngoscope, the physician inspected the entrance to the airway. 醫師用喉鏡檢查氣道入口。

meaning: 屬於或關於喉鏡檢查的。
sentences: On Sunday David noticed a laryngoscopic pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於或關於喉鏡檢查。
By frostday Chloe found the laryngoscopic quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於或關於喉鏡檢查的特質。

meaning: 屬於或關於喉鏡檢查的。
sentences: On Sunday Ella noticed a laryngoscopical pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於或關於喉鏡檢查。
By seasonday Chloe found the laryngoscopical quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於或關於喉鏡檢查的特質。

meaning: 較舊醫學用語：施行喉鏡檢查的人員或醫師。
sentences: An experienced laryngoscopist can inspect the vocal folds safely. 經驗豐富的喉鏡檢查者能安全檢視聲帶。
The laryngoscopist positioned the instrument to view the glottis. 喉鏡檢查者調整器械位置以觀察聲門。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉鏡檢查，即用喉鏡觀察喉部與聲帶。
sentences: Flexible laryngoscopy allows examination through the nose. 軟式喉鏡檢查可經鼻腔進行。
During laryngoscopy, the vocal folds are viewed directly. 進行喉鏡檢查時，可直接觀察聲帶。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉痙攣，即聲帶突發性不自主閉合而使氣流受阻。
sentences: Sudden laryngospasm can temporarily prevent air from entering the lungs. 突發喉痙攣可能暫時阻止空氣進入肺部。
After extubation, laryngospasm may cause noisy or absent breathing. 拔管後的喉痙攣可能造成呼吸有雜音或無法呼吸。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉部運動停止或停滯。
sentences: Complete laryngostasis means that normal laryngeal motion has ceased. 完全性喉部運動停止表示正常喉部活動已中止。
With laryngostasis, the affected structures remain motionless. 發生喉部運動停滯時，受影響的構造會保持不動。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉狹窄，即喉腔異常變窄。
sentences: Severe laryngostenosis restricts airflow through the larynx. 嚴重喉狹窄會限制空氣通過喉部。
Scar-related laryngostenosis may develop after injury or surgery. 疤痕造成的喉狹窄可能在受傷或手術後形成。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉造口術，即在喉部建立外科開口。
sentences: A laryngostomy creates an opening into the larynx. 喉造口術會建立通往喉部的開口。
Following laryngostomy, the opening must remain unobstructed. 喉造口術後，造口必須保持暢通。

meaning: 觀察說話或唱歌時聲帶振動的儀器
sentences: The laryngostroboscope revealed an uneven vocal-fold vibration. 喉部頻閃鏡顯示聲帶振動不均。
A singer watched the laryngostroboscope video after rehearsal. 歌手在排練後觀看喉部頻閃鏡錄下的影像。

meaning: 進行喉切開術的長而尖的手術器械
sentences: The laryngotome has a long pointed blade for opening the larynx. 喉切開刀有用於打開喉部的長尖刀刃。
The surgeon handled the laryngotome with careful precision. 外科醫師精準地操作喉切開刀。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉切開術，即以外科方式切開喉部。
sentences: Emergency laryngotomy opens the larynx through a surgical incision. 緊急喉切開術以外科切口打開喉部。
Unlike laryngostomy, laryngotomy denotes the incision itself. 喉切開術不同於喉造口術，指的是切開這項操作本身。

meaning: 與喉和氣管有關。
sentences: The child needed surgery to fix a laryngotracheal blockage. 這個孩子需要手術來修復喉氣管阻塞。
Laryngotracheal injuries often require immediate medical attention. 喉氣管損傷通常需要立即就醫。

meaning: 喉氣管炎。
sentences: The child was diagnosed with laryngotracheitis after developing a barking cough. 孩子出現犬吠樣咳嗽後，被診斷為喉氣管炎。
Laryngotracheitis can cause hoarseness and breathing difficulty. 喉氣管炎可能引起聲音沙啞和呼吸困難。

meaning: 醫學用語：喉氣管鏡檢查，即以內視鏡檢查喉部與氣管。
sentences: Diagnostic laryngotracheoscopy examines both the larynx and trachea. 診斷性喉氣管鏡檢查會同時檢視喉部與氣管。
During laryngotracheoscopy, an endoscope passes through the upper airway. 進行喉氣管鏡檢查時，內視鏡會通過上呼吸道。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉氣管切開術，即切開喉部及氣管上段的手術。
sentences: An urgent laryngotracheotomy can establish an airway through the larynx and upper trachea. 緊急喉氣管切開術可經喉部與氣管上段建立氣道。
In laryngotracheotomy, the incision crosses laryngeal and tracheal structures. 喉氣管切開術的切口會跨越喉部與氣管構造。

meaning: 古舊醫學用語：喉型傷寒，即伴有顯著喉部病變或併發症的傷寒。
sentences: Historical laryngotyphoid described typhoid fever with marked laryngeal involvement. 古稱的喉型傷寒指伴有明顯喉部病變的傷寒。
In laryngotyphoid, typhoid infection was accompanied by serious throat symptoms. 喉型傷寒是傷寒感染伴隨嚴重喉部症狀的情形。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：喉前庭炎，即喉部入口區域發炎。
sentences: Acute laryngovestibulitis inflames the vestibule of the larynx. 急性喉前庭炎會使喉部前庭發炎。
Swelling from laryngovestibulitis may narrow the laryngeal entrance. 喉前庭炎造成的腫脹可能使喉部入口變窄。

meaning: 喉，喉頭
sentences: The larynx contains the vocal cords that help us produce sound. 喉頭包含聲帶，能幫助我們發出聲音。
Inflammation of the larynx can make your voice sound hoarse. 喉頭發炎可能會讓聲音變得沙啞。

meaning: 她們；陰性直接受詞代名詞
sentences: No las vi en la tienda esta mañana. 今天早上我在店裡沒有看到她們。
Elena las puso sobre la mesa. 艾蓮娜把那些東西放在桌上。

meaning: 工具格形式；表示用某物作為工具
sentences: In the exercise, lasa marked the tool used for the action. 在練習中，工具格形式標示動作所使用的工具。
The teacher circled lasa to show how the sentence expressed means. 老師圈出工具格形式，說明句子如何表達使用的手段。

meaning: 古舊植物名：繖形科雷射草類植物。
sentences: The herb lasarwort belongs to the carrot family. 雷射草屬於繖形科草本植物。
Botanical lasarwort bears flowers in umbrella-shaped clusters. 植物雷射草的花會聚成傘狀花序。

meaning: 歷史用語：受僱於歐洲船隻的南亞或東南亞水手；現今可能帶有冒犯色彩。
sentences: A lascar historically served aboard a European merchant ship. 歷史上的拉斯卡水手曾在歐洲商船上工作。
The term lascar commonly referred to sailors from South or Southeast Asia. 拉斯卡一詞通常指來自南亞或東南亞的水手。

meaning: 放肆;淫蕩的，受情慾驅使的，好色的。
sentences: On springday Ivy noticed a lascivious pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得放肆、淫蕩的，受情慾驅使的，好色。
By Thursday David found the lascivious quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有放肆、淫蕩的，受情慾驅使的，好色的特質。

meaning: 以一種淫蕩的方式。
sentences: On springday Jack spoke lasciviously during dinner. 晚餐時，她說話時顯得以一種淫蕩的方式。
By Friday David moved lasciviously across the room. 後來，他移動時也顯得以一種淫蕩的方式。

meaning: 淫蕩或挑逗性慾的性質、言行或狀態。
sentences: The court condemned the performance's explicit lasciviousness. 法院譴責該表演露骨的淫穢性。
Open lasciviousness made the scene unsuitable for children. 公然的淫蕩內容使該場景不適合兒童觀看。

meaning: 雷射
sentences: Modern medical surgery often uses lasers for precise and clean cuts. 現代醫療手術常利用雷射進行精確、乾淨的切割。
The scientist used a laser to measure the distance to the moon accurately. 科學家利用雷射精確地測量了到月球的距離。

meaning: 繖形花科的雷射草屬植物
sentences: Laserpitium carries flat umbels above aromatic stems. 雷射草屬植物在芳香莖頂端長出平展傘形花序。
A wild Laserpitium grew on the sunny limestone slope. 一株野生雷射草屬植物長在向陽石灰岩坡。

meaning: 繖形科植物雷射草，曾用以取得樹脂
sentences: Laserwort produces resin from its thick underground parts. 雷射草從肥厚地下部位產生樹脂。
The herbalist recognized laserwort by its broad divided leaves. 草藥師從寬大的裂葉認出雷射草。

meaning: 疏忽、鬆懈。
sentences: On marketday Ben noticed a lash pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得疏忽、鬆懈。
By Sunday David found the lash quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有疏忽、鬆懈的特質。

meaning: 用鞭子抽打者；亦可指負責以繩索綁牢物品的人。
sentences: The wagoner acted as lasher and drove the team with a whip. 馬車夫充當揮鞭者，以鞭子驅趕牲口。
A cargo lasher secures containers against movement at sea. 貨物綁紮工會固定貨櫃，防止其在海上移動。

meaning: 伴隨著野蠻的批評。
sentences: On marketday David spoke lashingly during dinner. 晚餐時，她說話時顯得伴隨著野蠻的批評。
By marketday David moved lashingly across the room. 後來，他移動時也顯得伴隨著野蠻的批評。

meaning: 沒有睫毛。
sentences: On marketday Ella noticed a lashless pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得沒有睫毛。
By rainyday David found the lashless quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有沒有睫毛的特質。

meaning: 過時詞：潛伏、隱匿或尚未顯現的狀態；相當於 latency。
sentences: In obsolete English, latence denoted a hidden or dormant state. 在過時英語中，這個詞表示隱藏或休眠狀態。
Rather than delay alone, latence could signify concealment from view. 這個古詞不只可能涉及延遲，也可表示未顯露於外。

meaning: 延遲時間；亦指某事物潛伏、尚未顯現的狀態。
sentences: During online play, high latency makes controls respond slowly. 進行線上遊戲時，高延遲會使操作反應變慢。
Following infection, viral latency can persist without obvious symptoms. 感染後，病毒可在沒有明顯症狀下持續潛伏。

meaning: 遲到
sentences: I apologize for my lateness; I missed the bus. 我為我的遲到深表歉意；我沒趕上公車。
Her constant lateness is becoming a problem for the team. 她經常遲到，正成為團隊的一個問題。

meaning: 攝影專門用語：以均勻微量曝光增強感光乳劑或潛影感度的處理。
sentences: Before full exposure, latensification gives the emulsion a controlled uniform exposure. 正式曝光前，預曝光增感會使感光乳劑均勻接受受控的微量曝光。
Under low-light conditions, latensification can increase a photographic plate's effective sensitivity. 在低光條件下，預曝光增感可提高攝影乾版的有效感度。

meaning: 仍處於不活躍或隱藏階段；休眠的。
sentences: The virus can remain latent in the body for many years without showing symptoms. 病毒可以在人體內潛伏多年而不出現症狀。
He discovered a latent talent for painting when he retired. 他在退休時發現了自己隱藏的繪畫天分。

meaning: 罕見動詞：使成潛伏狀態；使暫時不顯現。
sentences: As a rare transitive verb, latentize means to render something latent. 作為罕見及物動詞，它表示使某物進入潛伏狀態。
In photographic wording, exposure may latentize an image until development reveals it. 按攝影用語，曝光可使影像暫成潛影，直到顯影才呈現。

meaning: 以一種潛在的方式
sentences: On frostday Hugo spoke latently during dinner. 晚餐時，她說話時顯得以一種潛在的方式。
By harvestday Frank moved latently across the room. 後來，他移動時也顯得以一種潛在的方式。

meaning: 罕見用語：潛伏、隱而未現的性質或狀態。
sentences: Because no symptoms appeared, the infection retained its latentness. 由於沒有症狀出現，感染仍維持潛伏狀態。
Although the image was invisible, its latentness ended during development. 影像原本不可見，但其潛伏狀態在顯影時終止。

meaning: 之後
sentences: I'm busy right now; can I call you back a bit later? 我現在很忙，可以等會兒再給你回電話嗎？
Later, we decided to go for a movie after dinner. 稍後我們決定晚餐後去看電影。

meaning: 解剖學所用拉丁詞形：latus（側部、體側）的複數，指兩側。
sentences: In Latin anatomical phrasing, latera is the plural of latus. 在拉丁解剖表述中，這個詞形是「側部」的複數。
On a bilaterally symmetric body, the latera are its two sides. 對左右對稱的身體而言，該複數詞指身體兩側。

meaning: 朝向身體一側；遠離內側平面。
sentences: On seasonday Anna spoke laterad during dinner. 晚餐時，她說話時顯得朝向身體一側、遠離內側平面。
By hikingday Frank moved laterad across the room. 後來，他移動時也顯得朝向身體一側、遠離內側平面。

meaning: 位於身體或器官的一側或另一側，特別是在正中面最遠的區域。
sentences: The medial side of the knee faces the other knee, while the outer side of the knee is lateral. 膝蓋的內側面向另一個膝蓋，而膝蓋的外側則面向外側。
A fish senses changes in hydrodynamic pressure with its lateral line. 魚用側線感知水動力壓力的變化。

meaning: 屬於或屬於側面的；側。
sentences: On seasonday Ben noticed a lateralis pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於或屬於側面的、側。
By festivalday Frank found the lateralis quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於或屬於側面的、側的特質。

meaning: 側性：偏向或慣用身體某一側的特性；亦指位於側方的狀態。
sentences: Because she writes with her left hand, her laterality favors the left. 她用左手書寫，因此側性偏左。
In motor assessment, laterality describes preference for one side of the body. 在動作評估中，側性描述身體對某一側的偏好。

meaning: 神經科學用語：某項認知或神經功能較集中於大腦一側的現象。
sentences: For most right-handed adults, language lateralization favors the left hemisphere. 對多數慣用右手的成人而言，語言功能的側化偏向左半球。
Although both hemispheres participate, lateralization can make one side more specialized. 儘管兩個半球都會參與，側化仍可使其中一側更為專司某功能。

meaning: 將功能定位於大腦的左側或右側
sentences: On seasonday Ella tried to lateralize before dinner. 晚餐前，她做了將功能定位於大腦的左側或右側的動作。
By restday Frank watched them lateralize near the gate. 到了門邊，大家看著他們完成這個動作。

meaning: 以橫向方式完成。
sentences: On seasonday Frank spoke laterally during dinner. 晚餐時，她說話時顯得以橫向方式完成。
By meetingday Frank moved laterally across the room. 後來，他移動時也顯得以橫向方式完成。

meaning: 專名：羅馬的拉特朗教堂與宮殿建築群；亦作定語指在此舉行的宗教會議或締結的條約。
sentences: As Rome's cathedral, the Lateran Basilica is the pope's episcopal seat. 拉特朗大殿是羅馬主教座堂，也是教宗的主教座所在地。
Five ecumenical councils assembled at the Lateran between 1123 and 1517. 一一二三至一五一七年間，共有五次大公會議在拉特朗舉行。

meaning: 側臥（側臥）
sentences: On seasonday Hugo noticed a latericumbent pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側臥（側臥）。
By travelday Frank found the latericumbent quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側臥（側臥）的特質。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：向側方彎曲；同 lateral flexion。
sentences: When the neck bends toward one shoulder, lateriflexion occurs. 頸部朝一側肩膀彎曲時，就會發生側屈。
During spinal examination, lateriflexion is measured separately in each direction. 脊椎檢查時，左右兩個方向的側屈會分別測量。

meaning: 側面開花的
sentences: On seasonday Jack noticed a laterifloral pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側面開花。
By picnicday Frank found the laterifloral quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側面開花的特質。

meaning: 在莖側開花的
sentences: On hikingday Anna noticed a lateriflorous pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得在莖側開花。
By Monday Grace found the lateriflorous quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有在莖側開花的特質。

meaning: 生長於葉基部一側。
sentences: On hikingday Ben noticed a laterifolious pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得生長於葉基部一側。
By Tuesday Grace found the laterifolious quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有生長於葉基部一側的特質。

meaning: 過時動物分類名：側行蛛類，指以橫向步態著稱的一群蜘蛛。
sentences: In older arachnid taxonomies, Laterigradae grouped spiders that move sideways. 在早期蛛形綱分類中，側行蛛類包含會橫向移動的蜘蛛。
Because crab spiders walk laterally, taxonomists once placed them among Laterigradae. 因蟹蛛會側向行走，分類學家過去曾把牠們歸入側行蛛類。

meaning: 具有涉及側向運動的運動模式。
sentences: On hikingday David noticed a laterigrade pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得具有涉及側向運動的運動模式。
By Thursday Grace found the laterigrade quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有具有涉及側向運動的運動模式的特質。

meaning: 具側脈的；葉脈位於側面的
sentences: On hikingday Ella noticed a laterinerved pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得具側脈的、葉脈位於側面。
By Friday Grace found the laterinerved quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有具側脈的、葉脈位於側面的特質。

meaning: 地質用語：熱帶濕潤地區經強烈淋溶形成、富含鐵鋁氧化物的紅色風化土或岩層。
sentences: After intense tropical weathering, laterite becomes enriched in iron and aluminum oxides. 經強烈的熱帶風化後，紅土會富集鐵與鋁的氧化物。
Where stone is scarce, hardened laterite can be cut into building blocks. 在石材稀少之處，硬化紅土可切成建築用磚塊。

meaning: 屬於或關於紅土的。
sentences: On hikingday Grace noticed a lateritic pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得屬於或關於紅土。
By Sunday Grace found the lateritic quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有屬於或關於紅土的特質。

meaning: 磚塊的紅色。
sentences: On hikingday Hugo noticed a lateritious pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得磚塊的紅色。
By springday Grace found the lateritious quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有磚塊的紅色的特質。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：器官或身體部位向側方轉位；同 lateral version。
sentences: If an organ turns sideways from its normal axis, lateriversion is present. 若器官偏離正常軸線而轉向側方，即屬側向轉位。
Rather than bending alone, lateriversion involves a sideward turning of position. 側向轉位不只是彎曲，而是位置朝側方轉動。

meaning: 地質專門用語：岩石或土壤經強烈風化與淋溶而轉化成紅土的過程。
sentences: Where rainfall is abundant, laterization leaches silica from deeply weathered rock. 在雨量充沛處，紅土化會從深度風化的岩石中淋失矽。
Over long tropical weathering, laterization concentrates relatively insoluble iron oxides. 經長期熱帶風化，紅土化會使較難溶的鐵氧化物富集。

meaning: 腹部側面的
sentences: On festivalday Anna noticed a lateroabdominal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得腹部側面。
By holiday Grace found the lateroabdominal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有腹部側面的特質。

meaning: 側面和前面
sentences: On festivalday Ben noticed a lateroanterior pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側面和前面。
By payday Grace found the lateroanterior quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側面和前面的特質。

meaning: 側面和尾部
sentences: On festivalday Chloe noticed a laterocaudal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側面和尾部。
By harvestday Grace found the laterocaudal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側面和尾部的特質。

meaning: 側位和頸部位
sentences: On festivalday David noticed a laterocervical pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側位和頸部位。
By frostday Grace found the laterocervical quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側位和頸部位的特質。

meaning: 醫學專門用語：器官或身體部位偏離正常位置而移向一側。
sentences: When the jaw shifts off the midline, laterodeviation may become visible. 下顎偏離中線時，側偏可能會變得明顯。
Unlike rotation, laterodeviation describes displacement toward one side. 側偏不同於旋轉，指的是朝某一側移位。

meaning: 側面和背側都有
sentences: On festivalday Frank noticed a laterodorsal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側面和背側都有。
By hikingday Grace found the laterodorsal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側面和背側都有的特質。

meaning: 醫學專門用語：肢體或眼球離開身體中線、朝外側移動。
sentences: As the eye moves toward the temple, lateroduction takes place. 眼球朝太陽穴方向移動時，便產生外轉。
During limb movement, lateroduction carries the part away from the midline. 肢體動作中的外展會使該部位遠離身體中線。

meaning: 醫學專門用語：頸部、軀幹或器官向一側彎曲，即側屈。
sentences: By tilting her head rightward, she demonstrated cervical lateroflexion. 她把頭向右傾，示範了頸椎側屈。
Compared with rotation, lateroflexion shortens one side of the trunk. 與旋轉相比，側屈會縮短軀幹的一側。

meaning: 側緣的；位於邊緣側面的
sentences: On festivalday Ivy noticed a lateromarginal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側緣的、位於邊緣側面。
By washday Grace found the lateromarginal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側緣的、位於邊緣側面的特質。

meaning: 頸背側面的
sentences: On festivalday Jack noticed a lateronuchal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得頸背側面。
By restday Grace found the lateronuchal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有頸背側面的特質。

meaning: 罕見醫學用語：器官或身體部位位於正常位置的側方；側位。
sentences: If the uterus lies abnormally to one side, lateroposition describes that placement. 若子宮異常位於一側，側位可描述這種位置。
Without implying a bend, lateroposition identifies a sideward location. 側位只表明位置在側方，不必然表示有彎曲。

meaning: 側面和後面
sentences: On movingday Ben noticed a lateroposterior pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側面和後面。
By gardenday Grace found the lateroposterior quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側面和後面的特質。

meaning: 神經醫學用語：身體不由自主地傾倒、偏行或被推向一側的傾向。
sentences: Following a brainstem lesion, lateropulsion may pull the body toward one side. 腦幹受損後，側向傾倒可使身體不自主偏向一側。
Even while standing still, lateropulsion can disturb balance. 即使站著不動，側向傾倒傾向也會破壞平衡。

meaning: 側氣門的；與側氣門有關的
sentences: On movingday David noticed a laterostigmatal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側氣門的、與側氣門有關。
By familyday Grace found the laterostigmatal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側氣門的、與側氣門有關的特質。

meaning: 昆蟲學罕見形容詞：具側生氣門的；位於體側氣門附近的。
sentences: In entomological description, laterostigmatic structures lie beside a lateral spiracle. 在昆蟲學描述中，側氣門性的構造位於體側氣門旁。
Because the opening sits laterally, the segment is termed laterostigmatic. 由於開口位於體側，該體節可稱為側氣門性的。

meaning: 與顱骨顳區的外側部分有關
sentences: On movingday Frank noticed a laterotemporal pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得與顱骨顳區的外側部分有關。
By Monday Hugo found the laterotemporal quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有與顱骨顳區的外側部分有關的特質。

meaning: 醫學用語：器官或身體部位向側方扭轉。
sentences: In ocular anatomy, laterotorsion rotates the eye toward the temple. 在眼部解剖中，這種側向扭轉會使眼球轉向太陽穴一側。
A marked laterotorsion can alter an organ's normal alignment. 明顯的側向扭轉可能改變器官的正常位置。

meaning: 側面和腹面都有
sentences: On movingday Hugo noticed a lateroventral pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得側面和腹面都有。
By Wednesday Hugo found the lateroventral quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有側面和腹面都有的特質。

meaning: 醫學用語：器官或身體部位向側方偏移，尤指子宮側傾。
sentences: During examination, lateroversion places the uterus off the midline. 檢查時，子宮側傾會使子宮偏離身體中線。
Unlike torsion, lateroversion describes displacement without axial twisting. 不同於扭轉，側向偏移並不涉及繞軸旋轉。

meaning: 罕見學術用語：變得潛伏、隱而不顯的過程或狀態。
sentences: In older scholarly prose, latescence denotes a transition into latency. 在較早期的學術散文中，這個詞表示轉入潛伏狀態。
Such latescence leaves an influence present but no longer apparent. 這種潛隱狀態使影響仍然存在，卻不再明顯。

meaning: 潛伏的，隱藏的，隱密的
sentences: On washday Anna noticed a latescent pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得潛伏的，隱藏的，隱密。
By Saturday Hugo found the latescent quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有潛伏的，隱藏的，隱密的特質。

meaning: （主要是英國方言、英格蘭北部、蘇格蘭、愛爾蘭）以遲到為特徵；典型的遲到
sentences: On washday Ben noticed a latesome pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得（主要是英國方言、英格蘭北部、蘇格蘭、愛爾蘭）以遲到為特徵、典型的遲到。
By Sunday Hugo found the latesome quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有（主要是英國方言、英格蘭北部、蘇格蘭、愛爾蘭）以遲到為特徵、典型的遲到的特質。

meaning: 最新的
sentences: The store is showing the latest collection of summer clothes. 這家商店正在展示最新的夏季服裝系列。
My computer is running the latest version of the operating system. 我的電腦正運行著最新版本的作業系統。

meaning: 古語、副詞：不久以前；近來。
sentences: The archaic adverb latewhile means not long ago. 這個古副詞意為不久以前。
Writers once placed latewhile where modern English prefers lately. 從前的作者會在現代英語使用「近來」之處採用這個古詞。

meaning: 植物的乳白色汁液，亦指製造橡膠的乳膠
sentences: Latex oozed from the cut stem and hardened in the air. 乳膠從割開的莖流出，並在空氣中凝固。
Gloves made from latex protect hands from many liquids. 乳膠製手套能保護雙手免受許多液體沾染。

meaning: 植物乳膠異常流動的病變或狀態
sentences: Latexosis caused milky sap to leak from several plant tissues. 乳膠異常讓乳白汁液從數處植物組織滲出。
The diseased stem showed latexosis after the branch was cut. 那根患病莖在枝條切開後顯現乳膠異常。

meaning: 建築用的細長板條；地質學亦指板條狀晶體。
sentences: Plaster grips each wooden lath through the gaps behind it. 灰泥穿過木板條間的縫隙後便能牢牢附著。
Under magnification, a feldspar lath appears as a narrow crystal. 在放大觀察下，板條狀長石呈現為狹長晶體。

meaning: 車床：使工件旋轉以便切削、鑽孔或成形的工具機。
sentences: A woodturner's lathe spins the stock against a cutting tool. 木工車床讓坯料旋轉並接觸刀具。
For accurate cylinders, the lathe holds the work on its axis. 為加工精確圓柱，車床會把工件固定在旋轉軸上。

meaning: 罕見異體：lathi，指南亞使用的長而粗重的棍棒。
sentences: As a rare variant, lathee names the South Asian heavy staff. 作為罕見異體，這個詞指南亞的粗重長棍。
Historical spellings sometimes give lathee for the bamboo baton called a lathi. 歷史拼法有時以這個形式指稱稱作印度長棍的竹製棍棒。

meaning: 罕見或過時用語：操作車床的工人。
sentences: Before automated machining, a latheman shaped rotating workpieces by hand. 自動化加工出現前，車床工靠手工切削旋轉中的工件。
An experienced latheman controlled both spindle speed and tool feed. 熟練的車床工會同時控制主軸轉速與刀具進給。

meaning: 由一個或多個板條製成。
sentences: On washday Hugo noticed a lathen pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得由一個或多個板條製成。
By harvestday Hugo found the lathen quality easy to notice. 後來大家也看出它具有由一個或多個板條製成的特質。

meaning: 肥皂泡，使起泡
sentences: Rub the soap between your hands until it forms a thick lather. 在雙手之間摩擦肥皂，直到產生濃稠的泡沫。
The barber lathered his face before shaving. 理髮師在剃鬚前在他的臉上塗抹肥皂泡。

meaning: 起泡能力；形成泡沫的難易程度。
sentences: Hard water can reduce a soap's latherability. 硬水會降低肥皂的起泡能力。
Greater latherability lets a cleanser form foam with less rubbing. 較強的起泡能力讓清潔劑只需輕搓便能產生泡沫。

meaning: 能夠形成泡沫。
sentences: On washday Jack noticed a latherable pattern at lunch. 午餐時，那個情境顯得能夠形成泡沫。

meaning: 罕見英格蘭史用語：肯特郡傳統「拉斯」行政區的最高行政官。
sentences: Historically, a lathereeve served as the chief officer of a Kentish lathe. 歷史上，郡區長擔任肯特郡傳統行政區的最高行政官。
Local administration within the lathe fell to its lathereeve. 該傳統行政區的地方行政由郡區長負責。

meaning: 使某物布滿泡沫的人；亦為過時建築用語，指釘裝板條的工人。
sentences: At a traditional shave, the latherer spreads foam across the beard. 在傳統刮鬍過程中，塗泡者會把泡沫抹滿鬍鬚。
On historic building sites, a latherer nailed strips beneath wet plaster. 在早期建築工地，板條工會把細木條釘在濕灰泥下方。

meaning: 生物化學專門用語：馬汗與唾液中的界面活性蛋白，可使液體潤濕毛皮並產生泡沫。
sentences: In horse sweat, latherin helps water penetrate the oily coat. 在馬汗中，這種蛋白質有助水分穿透帶油脂的毛皮。
Because latherin lowers surface tension, exertion can produce visible foam. 由於這種蛋白質會降低表面張力，馬匹活動時可能產生可見泡沫。

meaning: 蘇格蘭地名「拉瑟倫」的非標準小寫；該地是高地凱瑟尼斯的一座村落及民政教區。
sentences: On maps, lowercase latheron should appear as a capitalized Scottish place name. 在地圖上，這個小寫詞形應改成首字母大寫的蘇格蘭地名。
Roads through latheron connect settlements along the Caithness coast. 穿過拉瑟倫的道路連接凱瑟尼斯海岸各聚落。

meaning: 罕見或過時植物名：肥皂草，因根葉含皂苷而可起泡。
sentences: The old plant name latherwort refers to soapwort. 這個古老植物名指肥皂草。
Crushed latherwort can foam because the plant contains saponins. 肥皂草搗碎後會因含皂苷而產生泡沫。

sentences: A Latinian expression bears features associated with the Latin language. 所謂拉丁語式表達，帶有與拉丁語相關的特徵。

meaning: 罕見形容詞：拉丁語、拉丁民族或其文化的。
sentences: Romance languages share a Latinic inheritance from ancient Latin. 羅曼語族共享源自古拉丁語的拉丁傳承。

Borrowing an entire Latin phrase creates an obvious Latinism. 借入完整的拉丁短語會形成明顯的拉丁語成分。

meaning: 語言學用語：借自拉丁語或仿照拉丁語形成的詞語、慣用法或句法。

meaning: 罕見用語，指一小艇能載運的量

meaning: 化石植物學，月桂木屬的木化石

sentences: A lecidioid apothecium lacks a distinct raised margin. 石耳衣狀子囊盤沒有明顯隆起的邊緣。
The specimen's lecidioid crust helped identify its lichen group. 標本的石耳衣狀殼層有助於辨認地衣類群。

meaning: 含蛋黃的；與卵黃營養物質有關的
sentences: A lecithal egg supplies nutrients to the developing embryo. 含卵黃的卵為發育中的胚胎提供養分。
The lecithal yolk distribution differs among animal groups. 不同動物類群的卵黃分布各不相同。

meaning: 罕見生化用語，指與卵磷脂結合的白蛋白
sentences: A chemist isolated lecithalbumin from the yolk fraction. 化學家從卵黃部分分離出卵磷脂白蛋白。
The lecithalbumin forms a lipid-protein complex in older accounts. 早期記載把卵磷脂白蛋白視為脂質與蛋白質複合物。

meaning: 卵黃含量或卵黃特性的程度
sentences: Researchers measured lecithality when comparing egg types. 研究人員比較卵型時測量卵黃特性的程度。
High lecithality provides an embryo with more stored nutrients. 高卵黃含量為胚胎提供較多儲存養分。

meaning: 動物體內的主要磷脂質；它在蛋黃中含量特別豐富，商業上是從大豆中提取的。它是細胞膜的主要成分，通常用作食品添加劑（作為乳化劑）
sentences: Ginny studied a lecithin in the lab. Ginny 在實驗中研究了動物體內的主要磷脂質。
Giovanni identified the lecithin during testing. Giovanni 在檢驗時辨認出動物體內的主要磷脂質。

meaning: 催化卵磷脂水解的酵素
sentences: The lecithinase breaks lecithin into smaller lipid products. 卵磷脂酶把卵磷脂分解成較小的脂質產物。
Bacterial culture showed lecithinase activity in an assay. 一項分析在細菌培養物中檢測到卵磷脂酶活性。

meaning: 罕見胚胎學用語，指形成卵黃細胞的細胞或構造
sentences: A lecithoblast produces yolk material in a developing ovum. 卵黃形成細胞在發育中的卵內產生卵黃物質。

sentences: Serum contains a lecithoprotein complex. 血清含有卵磷脂蛋白複合物。
Biochemists group lecithoprotein with phospholipid-protein compounds. 生物化學家把卵磷脂蛋白歸入磷脂蛋白質化合物。

meaning: 罕見方言形容詞，漏水的
sentences: The leck roof leaked throughout the autumn storm. 那座漏水的屋頂整場秋季暴風雨都在滴水。

meaning: 德語借詞，形容食物美味可口
sentences: The baker called the tart lecker and warm. 麵包師說這份溫熱的塔很好吃。

meaning: 一種斜方二蝶形無色礦物，含氫、氮、氧、鉀、鈉和硫
sentences: Gregg studied a lecontite in the lab. Gregg 在實驗中研究了斜方二蝶形無色礦物，含氫、氮、氧、鉀、鈉和硫。

meaning: 罕見專門形容詞，形狀像馬蹄鐵
sentences: A lecotropal opening curves into a horseshoe-like outline. 一個馬蹄鐵形開口彎成近似馬蹄的輪廓。
The fossil's lecotropal shell surrounds the central aperture. 化石的馬蹄鐵形殼體圍繞中央開口。

meaning: 講台；放置演講稿或書本的斜面支架
sentences: The speaker placed her notes on the lectern. 講者把講稿放在講台上。
A brass lectern stood beside the choir stalls. 唱詩班座席旁立著一座黃銅講台。

meaning: 閱讀的行為
sentences: Guido discussed lection over dinner. Guido 晚餐時談到閱讀的行為。
Guillermo noticed lection in the debate. Guillermo 在辯論中注意到閱讀的行為。

meaning: 按教會曆指定禮拜讀經段落的經課集
sentences: The priest opened the lectionary for Advent. 牧師翻開經課集查看降臨期讀經。
Each Sunday the lectionary assigns passages for public worship. 經課集為每個星期日指定公開禮拜的經文。

sentences: A Roman lectisternium placed divine images beside a feast. 古羅馬神像宴席儀式把神像安置在宴席旁。
The museum reconstructs a lectisternium with couches and tables. 博物館以臥榻和桌子重現這種儀式。

meaning: 在宗教禮拜中朗讀經文的平信徒或讀經員
sentences: The lector read the psalm before the sermon. 讀經員在講道前朗讀詩篇。
A trained lector proclaimed the passage clearly. 受過訓練的讀經員清楚宣讀經文。

meaning: 與讀經或講授有關的；帶有說教意味的
sentences: The homily adopted a lectorial tone at worship. 禮拜中的講道採用了說教式語氣。
The lectorial notes explain how to read the passage aloud. 讀經講義說明了如何朗讀這段經文。

meaning: 講師的職位或身分
sentences: His lectorship included weekly public seminars. 他的講師職位包括每週公開研討會。
The college renewed her lectorship for one term. 學院把她的講師任期續延了一期。

meaning: 正模未指定時，後來選定的物種或亞種標準標本或插圖
sentences: The lectotype anchors the species name when no holotype was chosen. 正模未選定時，選定標本固定了物種名稱。

meaning: 女性講師；女性讀經員

sentences: Harvey met a lectrice at the market. Harvey 在市場遇到一位女性相當於講師。
Hazel thanked the lectrice for helping. Hazel 感謝那位女性相當於講師提供幫助。

meaning: 罕見醫學形容詞，使人臥床不起的
sentences: A lectual illness left the patient unable to walk. 一種使人臥床不起的疾病讓患者無法行走。
Doctors recorded lectual weakness after the injury. 醫師記錄了受傷後使人臥床的虛弱。

meaning: 演講
sentences: The history professor gave a fascinating lecture on ancient Egypt. 歷史系教授做了一場關於古代埃及的精彩講座（演講）。
I need to attend a professional lecture on computer science tonight. 我今晚需要參加一場關於計算機科學的專業講座。

meaning: 一個聽講座的人
sentences: Heidi met a lecturee at the market. Heidi 在市場遇到一位一個聽講座的人。
Hein thanked the lecturee for helping. Hein 感謝那位一個聽講座的人提供幫助。

meaning: 罕見詞，可靠資料未能確認其具體義項
sentences: A manuscript preserves lectureproof in an obscure heading. 一份手稿在難解標題中保存了這個罕見詞。
Editors cannot verify lectureproof in surviving lexicons. 編輯無法在現存詞典中核實這個詞。

meaning: 講師
sentences: The guest lecturer gave an inspiring speech to all the students. 客座講師對所有的學生發表了一場激勵人心的演講。

meaning: 講師職位或講師任期
sentences: The department created a lectureship in public health. 該系設立了公共衛生講師職位。

meaning: 女性講師；女性讀經員

The congregation thanked the lecturess for reading. 會眾感謝女讀經員朗讀經課。

meaning: 簡短講座；短講
sentences: The doctor gave a lecturette on heatstroke prevention. 醫師作了一場預防中暑的短講。
A ten-minute lecturette explained preservation rules. 十分鐘的短講說明了保存規範。

meaning: 罕見植物學用語，指玉蕊科植物，通常用複數指該類群
sentences: A lecyth tree bears a hard-walled capsule fruit. 一株玉蕊科植物結出果壁堅硬的蒴果。

meaning: 罕見植物學用語，指玉蕊科植物

sentences: Lecythidaceae includes tropical trees with large woody fruits. 這個科包含結大型木質果實的熱帶樹木。
Brazil nuts come from a tree in Lecythidaceae. 巴西堅果來自這個分類科的一種樹。

meaning: 屬於或與Lecythidaceae科相關的，包括巴西堅果。
sentences: The Brazil nut tree is a famous example of a lecythidaceous species. 巴西堅果樹是玉蕊科物種的一個著名例子。

A Lecythis branch bent under a cluster of unopened fruits. 一根這個植物屬的枝條被一串未熟果實壓彎。

sentences: A lecythoid capsule has a thick, woody wall. 玉蕊科樣蒴果具有厚實木質果壁。
Several lecythoid forms occur in tropical genera. 多個熱帶屬呈現玉蕊科樣的形態。

meaning: 古典詞，古希臘盛油小瓶的異體稱法
sentences: An archaeologist found a lecythus beside burial goods. 考古學家在陪葬品旁發現一只盛油小瓶。
A Greek lecythus often held perfumed oil. 希臘式盛油瓶常用來盛香油。

meaning: 受引導的；在控制或領導之下的
sentences: A led expedition followed the river upstream. 一支受引導的探險隊沿河向上游前進。
A led discussion kept the committee focused on evidence. 由人引導的討論讓委員會專注於證據。

meaning: 勒達；第38號主帶小行星，勿與木星衛星混淆
sentences: Astronomers catalogued Leda as asteroid 38. 天文學家把勒達編為第38號小行星。
An observatory tracked Leda across several nights. 天文台連續幾晚追蹤勒達的運行。

meaning: 一個男人；一個人
sentences: Hon met a lede at the market. Hon 在市場遇到一位一個男人。
Honzo thanked the lede for helping. Honzo 感謝那位一個男人提供幫助。

meaning: 罕見詞，指語言或演說
sentences: A glossary translates leden as language or speech. 詞彙表把這個罕見詞譯為語言或演說。
Philologists discuss leden in an obsolete Germanic source. 語言學家在一份過時的日耳曼語資料中討論這個詞。

meaning: 化學物質、礦物或生物學名詞
sentences: Howard studied a lederite in the lab. Howard 在實驗中研究了化學物質、礦物或生物學名詞。
Hsi identified the lederite during testing. Hsi 在檢驗時辨認出化學物質、礦物或生物學名詞。

A stone ledge runs beneath the castle window. 城堡窗下有一道石製水平突出面。

meaning: 有壁架的；有一個或多個狹窄突出面的
sentences: A ledged cliff provides nesting sites for seabirds. 有岩架的懸崖為海鳥提供築巢地。

meaning: 沒有壁架或突出水平面的

A ledgeless window frame sheds rain efficiently. 無壁架的窗框能有效排走雨水。

meaning: 帳簿
sentences: The accountant recorded the transactions in the general ledger. 會計師將交易記錄在總帳中。
Please check the entries in the sales ledger. 請核對銷售帳簿中的記錄。

meaning: 罕見詞，可靠資料未能確認其具體義項
sentences: A manuscript preserves ledgerdom in a heading. 一份手稿在標題中保存了這個罕見詞。

meaning: 創建或開發壁架（採礦、建築等）或由此創建的壁架的行為或過程
sentences: Hunter discussed ledging over dinner. Hunter 晚餐時談到創建或開發壁架或由此創建的壁架的行為或過程。
Hurf noticed ledging in the debate. Hurf 在辯論中注意到創建或開發壁架或由此創建的壁架的行為或過程。

meaning: 多岩架的；由岩架或礁石組成的

meaning: 杜香屬植物

A Ledum shrub flowered beside the northern bog. 一叢杜香屬灌木在北方沼澤旁開花。

meaning: 酒糟；發酵液沉澱出的酵母和殘渣

Wine aged on the Lee can change its texture. 帶酒糟陳年的葡萄酒可能改變口感。

meaning: 背風的；位於避開風或流體來向的一側

sentences: Jacob planned to leeches the loose part. Jacob 打算對鬆動的部件進行這個處理。

Physicians applied leechkin to draw blood from swollen skin. 醫師使用這種小水蛭讓腫脹的皮膚放血。

meaning: 像水蛭般黏附、吸取資源或寄生的

meaning: 罕見航海名詞；固定起重臂或桅具的繩索裝置

The damaged leefang left the boom unstable in rough water. 損壞的繩索裝置使吊桿在浪濤中不穩。

meaning: 形容詞；浮萍科的，或與浮萍科有關的。
sentences: lemnaceous plants spread across the still pond until almost no open water remained. 浮萍科植物鋪滿了平靜的池面，幾乎不剩露出的水面。
lemnaceous growth is common in nutrient-rich ditches where tiny floating fronds multiply fast. 浮萍科植物常見於養分充足的溝渠，細小漂浮葉狀體會迅速繁殖。

meaning: 名詞；浮萍。
sentences: lemnad clusters gathered where the drainage channel widened into quiet water. 浮萍群聚在排水道變寬、流速轉緩的地方。
lemnad can blanket a tank within days when warm weather and sunlight favor rapid division. 天氣溫暖又有日照時，浮萍幾天內就能鋪滿整個水槽。

meaning: 形容詞；利姆諾斯島的，或與其居民、語言有關的。
sentences: Lemnian earth was prized in antiquity as a medicinal clay from the island of Lemnos. 古代人重視來自利姆諾斯島的藥用黏土。
Lemnian inscriptions preserve evidence for an extinct Aegean language related to Etruscan. 利姆諾斯島的銘文保存了與伊特魯里亞語相關的已滅絕愛琴語言證據。

meaning: 名詞；八字形閉合曲線。
sentences: lemniscate appears on the graph when the equation produces a sideways figure eight. 當方程式畫出橫向的八字形時，圖上就會出現這種曲線。
lemniscate traced by the laser crossed itself neatly at the center of the screen. 雷射描出的這條曲線在螢幕中央整齊地自我交叉。

meaning: 形容詞；呈八字形曲線的。
sentences: lemniscatic path in the simulator looped around two lobes before crossing the middle. 模擬器中的八字形路徑會繞過兩個環瓣後穿過中央。
lemniscatic design on the pendant made the silver line resemble an infinity sign. 吊墜上的八字形設計讓銀線看起來像無限符號。

meaning: 名詞；丘系，帶狀上行神經纖維束。
sentences: lemniscus carries fine touch and vibration signals upward through the brainstem. 丘系會把精細觸覺與震動訊號往上傳過腦幹。
lemniscus damage can leave a patient clumsy at locating pressure on the skin. 丘系受損會讓病人難以準確判斷皮膚受壓的位置。

meaning: 罕見古醫學名詞；對瘟疫或流行病的記述、論述。
sentences: lemography in that eighteenth-century title meant a written account of plague outbreaks, not modern statistics. 這個十八世紀書名中的詞是指對瘟疫爆發的文字記述，不是現代統計學。
lemography sounds archaic now because medicine replaced it with epidemiology and outbreak history. 這個詞如今聽來很古老，因為醫學後來改用流行病學與疫情史等名稱。

meaning: 罕見古醫學名詞；流行病學，尤指傳染病研究。
sentences: lemology was once used for the study of epidemics before epidemiology became standard English. 這個詞曾用來指研究流行病，後來標準英語改用流行病學。
lemology in the old preface referred to tracing how contagion moved through a crowded city. 舊序言裡的這個詞指的是追查傳染如何在人口稠密的城市中擴散。

meaning: 檸檬
sentences: I like to put a slice of fresh lemon in my tea. 我喜歡在茶裡放一片新鮮檸檬。
The lemon juice added a refreshing taste to the salad. 檸檬汁為這份沙拉增添了清爽的味道。

meaning: 檸檬水
sentences: Would you like a glass of cold and refreshing lemonade? 妳想喝杯冰涼清爽的檸檬水嗎？
She made a batch of homemade lemonade for the garden party. 她為遊園會做了一批手作檸檬水。

meaning: 包含美洲蝴蝶的分類屬
sentences: Lemonias butterflies rest with closed wings on low leaves. 這個蝴蝶屬停在低矮葉片上時會合起翅膀。
A Lemonias flashed orange spots across the forest clearing. 一隻這個蝴蝶屬成員在林間空地飛過，露出橙色斑點。

meaning: 包含婆羅門蛾的鱗翅目分類科舊名
sentences: Lemoniidae was an earlier family name for the Brahmaeid moths. 這個科名是婆羅門蛾的早期分類名稱。
An old moth catalogue places the species in Lemoniidae. 一本舊蛾類目錄把該物種列在這個科名下。

meaning: 專有名詞；人名、地名或分類學名
sentences: Francis visited Lemoniinae during a holiday. Francis 假日時造訪了這個地方。
Francisco read about Lemoniinae before the trip. Francisco 旅行前讀了這個地方的資料。

meaning: 形容詞；略帶檸檬般酸味、香氣或色調的。
sentences: lemonish glaze gave the cake a light citrus edge without making it sharply sour. 微帶檸檬感的糖霜讓蛋糕有淡淡柑橘味，卻不會酸得太明顯。
lemonish scent drifted from the soap after the first splash of hot water. 第一波熱水一潑下去，肥皂就飄出淡淡檸檬香。

meaning: 形容詞；形狀像檸檬的。
sentences: lemonlike fruit hung from the branch with pointed ends and a swollen middle. 枝頭上的果實兩端尖、中間鼓，看起來像檸檬。
lemonlike hull on the small rescue buoy helped it ride upright in choppy water. 小型救生浮標的檸檬形外殼讓它在碎浪中仍能保持正立。

meaning: 北美西部的紫草科開花植物
sentences: Lemonweed bears small flowers above its gray-green leaves. 檸檬草屬植物在灰綠葉片上方開小花。
A lemonweed patch grew on the dry western hillside. 一片檸檬草屬植物長在西部乾燥山坡。

meaning: 紐西蘭常綠小樹，葉片搓碎有檸檬香
sentences: Lemonwood leaves smell citrusy when rubbed between the fingers. 檸檬木葉在指間搓揉時有柑橘香。
A lemonwood tree formed a low canopy beside the road. 一棵檸檬木在道路旁形成低矮樹冠。

meaning: 形容詞；有檸檬香、檸檬味或檸檬黃色調的。
sentences: lemony steam rose from the pan after zest was stirred into the melted butter. 把檸檬皮屑拌進融化奶油後，鍋裡冒出帶檸檬香的蒸氣。
lemony polish left the old wood with a clean smell and a faint yellow sheen. 那種帶檸檬香的亮光劑讓舊木頭留下乾淨氣味與淡淡黃澤。

meaning: 專有名詞；人名、地名或分類學名
sentences: Fritz visited Lemosi during a holiday. Fritz 假日時造訪了這個地方。
Gabriel read about Lemosi before the trip. Gabriel 旅行前讀了這個地方的資料。

meaning: 鐵器時代和羅馬時期居住在現代利穆贊地區的高盧部落
sentences: Gail visited Lemovices during a holiday. Gail 假日時造訪了這個地方。
Gale read about Lemovices before the trip. Gale 旅行前讀了這個地方的資料。

meaning: 名詞；洪都拉斯的貨幣單位倫皮拉。
sentences: lempira notes were easier to use at the market than foreign bills. 在市場裡，倫皮拉紙鈔比外國鈔票更容易使用。
lempira paid for the bunk, the locker, and a bowl of soup at the roadside hostel. 這筆倫皮拉剛好付了路邊旅舍的床位、置物櫃和一碗湯。

meaning: 名詞；《箴言》所提到的一位君王。
sentences: Lemuel is addressed in Proverbs as a king warned by his mother against drunkenness and injustice. 《箴言》中有人直接勸告這位君王，要遠離醉酒與不義。
Lemuel remains an uncertain biblical figure, and some commentators identify him with Solomon. 這位聖經人物的身分至今仍不確定，有些註解者把他視為所羅門。

meaning: 原產馬達加斯加及鄰近島嶼的狐猴類靈長動物
sentences: A lemur leaped between branches above the forest floor. 一隻狐猴在森林地面上方的枝條間跳躍。
The lemur used its long tail to balance on the narrow limb. 那隻狐猴用長尾巴在細枝上保持平衡。

meaning: 死者的靈魂或鬼魂，被認為是邪惡的
sentences: Geoffrey met a lemures at the market. Geoffrey 在市場遇到一位死者的靈魂或鬼魂，被認為是邪惡的。
George thanked the lemures for helping. George 感謝那位死者的靈魂或鬼魂，被認為是邪惡的提供幫助。

meaning: 名詞；古羅馬為驅逐亡靈而舉行的節期。
sentences: Lemuria was observed in ancient Rome with rites meant to drive restless spirits from the house. 古羅馬人在這個節期舉行儀式，要把不安的亡靈從家中驅走。
Lemuria included the tossing of black beans behind the shoulder during the midnight ritual. 這個節期的午夜儀式包含把黑豆往肩後拋出去。

meaning: 形容詞；神話中利莫里亞大陸的，或與之有關的。
sentences: Lemurian lore in occult writing describes a vanished land somewhere in the Indian Ocean. 神秘學著作中的這套傳說描述了一塊位於印度洋某處、已經消失的土地。
Lemurian ruins in the novel signal that the author is borrowing from lost-continent mythology. 小說裡的利莫里亞遺跡顯示作者借用了失落大陸神話。

meaning: 名詞；狐猴類動物；古用法。
sentences: lemurian grips branches with long fingers and moves best after dusk. 這類狐猴會用長手指抓住樹枝，並在黃昏後活動得最靈活。
lemurian eyes reflect torchlight strongly because many species forage at night. 這類狐猴的眼睛在手電筒下反光很強，因為許多種類夜間覓食。

meaning: 狐猴科的任何狐猴
sentences: A lemurid groomed its companion on the warm branch. 一隻狐猴科動物在溫暖枝條上替同伴理毛。
The lemurid's large eyes reflect light in the dusk. 那隻狐猴科動物的大眼睛在黃昏反射光線。

meaning: 包含真正狐猴的靈長類分類科
sentences: Lemuridae includes the true lemurs of Madagascar. 這個科包含馬達加斯加的真正狐猴。
Members of Lemuridae often live in social groups. 這個科的成員常以社群方式生活。

meaning: 屬於或與Lemuriformes下目有關的。
sentences: The lemuriform primates are mostly found on the island of Madagascar. 狐猴型靈長類動物主要分布在馬達加斯加島。
The scientist studied the unique teeth of the lemuriform skeleton. 科學家研究了這具狐猴型骨骼獨特的牙齒。

meaning: 狐猴科的舊亞科，包含不屬於狐猴亞科的物種
sentences: Lemurinae was once used for a subgroup outside the modern lemur subfamily. 這個舊亞科名過去用於現代狐猴亞科以外的一群狐猴。
Older classifications placed several species in Lemurinae. 較早分類把數個物種歸入這個舊亞科。

meaning: 形容詞；狐猴類的，或似狐猴的。
sentences: lemurine features in the skull included huge eye sockets and a shortened snout. 那顆頭骨上的狐猴類特徵包括巨大的眼窩與縮短的吻部。
lemurine tail patterns help several species signal one another in the trees. 狐猴類尾巴上的花紋能幫助幾種樹棲物種彼此示意。

meaning: 屬於靈長類動物總科Lemuroidea（狐猴）的或與之相關的
sentences: Some ancient fossils show lemuroid features in their limb structures. 一些古代化石在其肢體構造中展現出狐猴類的特徵。
We watched a documentary about the behavior of lemuroid species. 我們看了一部關於狐猴類物種行為的紀錄片。

meaning: 包含狐猴的靈長類分類總科
sentences: Lemuroidea groups the major lemur lineages together. 這個分類總科把主要狐猴支系歸在一起。
A fossil skull was compared with living members of Lemuroidea. 一個化石頭骨與現生狐猴類比較。

meaning: 俄羅斯女性小名Лена（莉娜）的音譯
sentences: Ginny met a Len at the market. Ginny 在市場遇到一位俄羅斯女性小名Лена的音譯。
Giovanni thanked the Len for helping. Giovanni 感謝那位俄羅斯女性小名Лена的音譯提供幫助。

meaning: 女性名，相當於英文Lena
sentences: Glen met a Lena at the market. Glen 在市場遇到一位女性名，相當於英文。
Glenn thanked the Lena for helping. Glenn 感謝那位女性名，相當於英文提供幫助。

meaning: 罕見礦物學名詞；似長石礦物群的舊稱。
sentences: lenad was proposed as a short group name for feldspathoid minerals in older mineralogy. 這個詞曾被提出作為似長石礦物群的簡短名稱。
lenad is mostly of historical interest because modern mineralogy uses more exact group labels. 這個名稱如今主要只有歷史價值，因為現代礦物學改用更精確的群名。

meaning: 名詞；古雅典祭祀戴奧尼索斯並舉行戲劇競賽的節慶。
sentences: Lenaea brought comedy competitions to Athens during the midwinter festival of Dionysus. 這個冬季節慶把喜劇競賽帶進了雅典的酒神祭典。
Lenaea gave playwrights a chance to test new comic work before an Athenian audience. 這個節慶讓劇作家有機會先在雅典觀眾面前試演新喜劇。

meaning: 專有名詞；人名、地名或分類學名
sentences: Graham visited Lenaean during a holiday. Graham 假日時造訪了這個地方。
Grant read about Lenaean before the trip. Grant 旅行前讀了這個地方的資料。

meaning: 專有名詞；人名、地名或分類學名
sentences: Granville visited Lenaeum during a holiday. Granville 假日時造訪了這個地方。
Greg read about Lenaeum before the trip. Greg 旅行前讀了這個地方的資料。

meaning: 包含多種刺蝽的分類屬
sentences: Lenaeus bugs pierce plant tissue with their sharp mouthparts. 這種刺蝽屬昆蟲用尖銳口器刺穿植物組織。
A Lenaeus rested on the underside of a broad leaf. 一隻刺蝽屬昆蟲停在寬葉背面。

meaning: 該群體所有人使用的語言（Munsee、Unami）；特拉華州
sentences: Gregg visited Lenape during a holiday. Gregg 假日時造訪了這個地方。
Gregge read about Lenape before the trip. Gregge 旅行前讀了這個地方的資料。

meaning: 一個姓氏
sentences: Gregor met a lenard at the market. Gregor 在市場遇到一位一個姓氏。
Gregory thanked the lenard for helping. Gregory 感謝那位一個姓氏提供幫助。

meaning: 名詞；倫卡人；亦可指其語言。
sentences: Lenca communities in Honduras continue ceremonies, farming traditions, and strong ties to ancestral land. 宏都拉斯的倫卡社群仍延續祭儀、農耕傳統與祖地連結。
Lenca survives mainly in documentation and revitalization work rather than as a widespread first language. 倫卡語如今主要存在於記錄與復振工作中，已不是廣泛使用的母語。

meaning: 形容詞；倫卡人的，倫卡語的，或與其相關的。
sentences: Lencan place-names remain scattered across western Honduras and eastern El Salvador. 與倫卡相關的地名至今仍散布在宏都拉斯西部與薩爾瓦多東部。
Lencan word lists are compared carefully when scholars reconstruct the older language family. 學者重建較早的語系時，會仔細比對倫卡語詞表。

meaning: 罕見古方言詞；較可靠資料多把它記為蘇格蘭動詞，指躍步、猛拋，或突然滔滔說起；名詞義不穩。
sentences: lench is better attested as a Scots verb meaning to spring or fling than as a stable modern noun. 這個詞較可靠的記錄多是蘇格蘭動詞，表示跳躍或猛拋，而不是穩定的現代名詞。
lench survives mainly in historical dialect records, so its part of speech is uncertain in modern lists. 這個詞主要保留在歷史方言記錄裡，因此它在現代詞表中的詞類並不穩定。

meaning: 借
sentences: Could you please lend me your umbrella? It's starting to rain. 你能把傘借給我嗎？開始下雨了。
The library allows students to lend up to five books at a time. 圖書館允許學生一次最多借五本書。

meaning: 形容詞；可以外借的，可以出借的。
sentences: lendable copies of the atlas stayed on the open shelf while the fragile edition was locked away. 可外借的那幾本地圖集放在開架上，脆弱版本則被鎖起來。
lendable again after the hinge was repaired, the folding ladder went back into the shared storeroom. 鉸鏈修好後，這把折梯又能借用了，於是被放回共用儲藏室。

meaning: 被借出某物的人
sentences: Hal met a lendee at the market. Hal 在市場遇到一位被借出某物的人。
Hamilton thanked the lendee for helping. Hamilton 感謝那位被借出某物的人提供幫助。

meaning: 借錢的人，尤其是藉錢的人；具體來說，是專門提供貸款的銀行或其他實體
sentences: Hank met a lender at the market. Hank 在市場遇到一位借錢的人，尤其是藉錢的人。
Hans thanked the lender for helping. Hans 感謝那位借錢的人，尤其是藉錢的人提供幫助。

meaning: 名詞；倫杜語；亦可指倫杜人。
sentences: Lendu belongs to the Central Sudanic branch and is spoken in northeastern Congo and nearby Uganda. 倫杜語屬於中蘇丹語支，通行於剛果東北部與鄰近烏干達。
Lendu radio broadcasts reach villages where Swahili is not everybody's strongest language. 倫杜語廣播能傳到那些並非人人都最熟悉史瓦希里語的村落。

meaning: 名詞；語音學中的輕音符號，或不送氣的輕塞音。
sentences: lene above the initial vowel told the reader to begin the Greek word without an h sound. 單字開頭母音上的這個符號告訴讀者，該希臘字起首沒有h音。
lene consonants are produced without the strong puff of breath heard in aspirated stops. 輕塞音發出時沒有送氣塞音那種明顯的氣流爆發。

meaning: 長度
sentences: What is the total length of the new bridge across the river? 這座橫跨河流的新橋總長度是多少？
The movie has a length of over three hours, which is quite long. 這部電影長達三個多小時，挺長的。

meaning: 加長
sentences: We need to lengthen the curtains to cover the large window today. 我們今天需要加長窗簾以遮住那扇大窗戶。
The manager decided to lengthen the meeting to discuss more details. 經理決定延長（加長）會議以討論更多細節。

meaning: 延長某物的人或物
sentences: Hartmann met a lengthener at the market. Hartmann 在市場遇到一位延長某物的人或物。
Harv thanked the lengthener for helping. Harv 感謝那位延長某物的人或物提供幫助。

meaning: 非標準或罕見構詞；按字面可指較長者或使之變長之物，但標準詞通常用 longer 或 lengthener。
sentences: lengther looks like an analogical formation beside longer, but major dictionaries favor other forms. 這個詞看起來像仿照比較級造出的形式，但主要詞典偏好其他標準形式。
lengther can be understood from its parts, yet it has little standing in standard edited English. 這個詞從構詞上不難理解，但在標準書面英語裡幾乎沒有穩固地位。

meaning: 古語形容詞；長的。
sentences: lengthful robes trailed behind the actors and swept dust from the boards. 長袍拖在演員身後，把木板上的灰都掃起來了。
lengthful sermon tried the congregation's patience before the noon bells began to ring. 冗長的講道在正午鐘聲響起前就快耗盡會眾的耐性。

meaning: 以一種漫長的方式，以一種漫長而漫長的方式，尤其是在時間上
sentences: Heidi answered lengthily when asked. Heidi 被問到時以以一種漫長的方式，以一種漫長而漫長的方式，尤其是的方式回答。
Hein walked lengthily across the room. Hein 以以一種漫長的方式，以一種漫長而漫長的方式，尤其是的方式走過房間。

meaning: 名詞；冗長，過長的狀態。
sentences: lengthiness weakened the contract because vital duties were buried in repeated clauses. 合約的冗長削弱了可讀性，因為關鍵義務被埋在反覆的條款裡。
lengthiness of the speech became a joke before the last paragraph was finally reached. 那篇演說的冗長甚至成了笑柄，還沒講到最後一段就已如此。

meaning: 名詞；負責維護一段道路、運河或鐵道的人。
sentences: lengthsman once kept a parish road passable by clearing ditches and cutting back brush. 過去這種工人會清溝、砍除灌木，讓教區道路保持可通行。

lenience from the landlord ended after the third late payment notice. 房東的寬容在第三次逾期通知後就結束了。

lenient editor overlooked stray commas yet stayed severe about unsupported claims. 那位編輯對零星逗號很寬鬆，對沒有依據的主張卻仍很嚴。

meaning: 弗拉基米爾·列寧提出的一種政治意識形態，提出建立由革命先鋒政黨領導的無產階級專政，作為建立共產主義的政治前奏
sentences: Horst discussed Leninism over dinner. Horst 晚餐時談到弗拉基米爾·列寧提出的一種政治意識形態，提出建立。
Hotta noticed Leninism in the debate. Hotta 在辯論中注意到弗拉基米爾·列寧提出的一種政治意識形態，提出建立。

sentences: Leninist theory places a disciplined vanguard party at the center of revolutionary strategy. 列寧主義理論把有紀律的先鋒黨放在革命策略核心。
Leninist faction inside the movement argued for tighter party control over the unions. 運動內部的列寧主義派別主張黨應更緊密地控制工會。

sentences: Hsuan met a Leninite at the market. Hsuan 在市場遇到一位列寧的支持者。
Huashi thanked the Leninite for helping. Huashi 感謝那位列寧的支持者提供幫助。

sentences: The teacher contrasted a lenis sound with a fortis sound. 老師把弱音和強音做比較。
A lenis consonant may sound softer to new language learners. 對語言初學者來說，弱輔音聽起來可能比較柔和。

meaning: 形容詞；靜水的；與湖泊、池塘等緩流水體有關的。
sentences: lenitic insects thrive in ponds where current is weak and reeds shelter the surface. 靜水環境中的昆蟲常在水流微弱、表面有蘆葦遮蔽的池塘繁盛。
lenitic habitat was counted separately from the fast stream before the larvae were tallied. 在計算幼體前，調查人員先把靜水棲地和急流水域分開統計。

meaning: 形容詞；舒緩的；能減輕疼痛或不適的。
sentences: lenitive balm eased the cracked skin on his hands after hours in salt water. 舒緩藥膏減輕了他雙手在鹽水裡泡久後裂開的疼痛。
lenitive draught was prescribed to quiet the cough through the night. 醫師開了舒緩性的藥飲，好讓咳嗽在夜裡平息。

Hy noticed lenitude in the debate. Hy 在辯論中注意到寬容的品質或習慣。

meaning: 名詞；寬厚仁慈；從寬。
sentences: lenity from the council reduced the fine after the shopkeeper repaired the damage. 店主修好損壞後，議會從寬把罰款降低了。
lenity toward the hungry deserters surprised a crew that expected immediate punishment. 對飢餓逃兵的寬貸讓原本以為會立刻受罰的船員很意外。

meaning: 化學物質、礦物或生物學名詞
sentences: Ima studied a lennilite in the lab. Ima 在實驗中研究了化學物質、礦物或生物學名詞。
Indra identified the lennilite during testing. Indra 在檢驗時辨認出化學物質、礦物或生物學名詞。

meaning: 包含寄生開花植物的分類科，現為蘭亞科
sentences: Lennoaceae contains flowering plants that draw food from host roots. 這個科包含從寄主根部取得養分的寄生開花植物。
A Lennoaceae plant appeared above the desert soil without green leaves. 一株這個科植物在沙土上方出現，卻沒有綠葉。

meaning: 屬於紫草目中的Lennoaceae科。
sentences: The botanist found a rare lennoaceous plant in the desert. 植物學家在沙漠中發現了一種稀有的蓋子花科植物。
Lennoaceous species are unusual because they do not have green leaves. 蓋子花科物種很不尋常，因為它們沒有綠色的葉子。

meaning: 古語；柔軟可彎的，為 linnow 的異拼。
sentences: lennow leather bent around the wrist without cracking at the seam. 柔韌的皮革能繞著手腕彎曲而不會在接縫處裂開。
lennow in the old dialect verse means supple rather than stiff or brittle. 這個詞在古老方言詩句裡表示柔軟可彎，不是僵硬或脆裂。

meaning: 男性名字倫納德的暱稱
sentences: Irvin met a Lenny at the market. Irvin 在市場遇到一位男性名字倫納德的暱稱。
Irving thanked the Lenny for helping. Irving 感謝那位男性名字倫納德的暱稱提供幫助。

meaning: 名詞；紗線交扭形成網孔的織法；亦指此種織物。
sentences: leno weave locks the weft in place by twisting paired warp threads around it. 這種織法把成對經線互相扭轉，好把緯線牢牢固定住。
leno curtain lets air through the window while resisting the thread slippage of looser cloth. 這種紗羅窗簾能讓空氣穿過窗戶，同時不易像鬆織布那樣滑紗。

meaning: 女性名字，埃莉諾的變體
sentences: Isabelle met a Lenora at the market. Isabelle 在市場遇到一位女性名字，埃莉諾的變體。
Isidore thanked the Lenora for helping. Isidore 感謝那位女性名字，埃莉諾的變體提供幫助。

meaning: 鏡片
sentences: I need to clean the camera lens before taking any photos. 在拍照前我需要清理相機鏡頭。
She bought a pair of high-quality contact lenses for her eyes. 她買了一副高品質的隱形眼鏡。

meaning: 形容詞；裝有鏡片的；帶鏡頭的。
sentences: lensed goggles protected her eyes while sharpening the view in blowing spray. 帶鏡片的護目鏡在水霧四散時既保護雙眼，也讓視野更清楚。
lensed head on the sorting robot gave it depth cues for separating fruit by size. 分揀機器人的帶鏡頭頭部提供了深度線索，讓它能依大小分開水果。

meaning: 形容詞；沒有鏡頭或鏡片的。
sentences: lensless imaging replaces glass optics with computation and a patterned mask. 無鏡頭成像以運算與圖樣遮罩取代玻璃光學元件。
lensless after the fall, one barrel of the binoculars showed only a dark blur. 摔落後其中一筒沒了鏡片，雙筒望遠鏡只剩一團模糊黑影。

meaning: 形容詞；像透鏡的；具透鏡特徵的。
sentences: lenslike clouds formed above the ridge when steady wind crossed the mountain wave. 穩定氣流越過山波時，山脊上方形成了透鏡狀雲。
lenslike seam of sand thinned toward both ends inside the clay exposure. 黏土露頭中的那條透鏡狀砂層往兩端逐漸變薄。

meaning: lend 的過去式與過去分詞
sentences: Jacob saw the dog lent over the gate. Jacob 看見那隻狗完成了這個動作。
Jacobson noticed that the leaves lent overnight. Jacobson 注意到葉子一夜之間完成了這個變化。

meaning: 名詞；基督教復活節前的四旬期。
sentences: Lent begins on Ash Wednesday and leads many Christians through weeks of fasting and prayer. 四旬期始於聖灰星期三，帶領許多基督徒進入數週的禁食與祈禱。
Lent in that parish meant simple Friday suppers before the evening service. 在那個教區，四旬期代表星期五晚間禮拜前的簡單晚餐。

meaning: 形容詞；四旬期的；與四旬期有關的。
