meaning: 名詞；四旬期；舊稱。
sentences: Lententide appears in older church calendars where modern readers would simply see Lent. 較老的教會曆法會用這個舊稱，現代讀者通常只會看到四旬期。
Lententide brought plainer altar cloths and fewer festive sounds to the sanctuary. 進入四旬期後，聖壇布置會變得更樸素，節慶氣氛的聲響也減少。

meaning: 英格蘭北部方言名詞；春季。
sentences: lenth in northern dialect meant the spring season when daylight begins to lengthen. 北方方言裡的這個詞指的是日照開始拉長的春季。
lenth was the time for lambing before the deep grass of summer rose in the fields. 這個季節正是羊羔出生的時候，還早於田野長出夏季的深草。

meaning: 縱向
sentences: Janet answered lenthways when asked. Janet 被問到時以縱向的方式回答。
Janice walked lenthways across the room. Janice 以縱向的方式走過房間。

meaning: 包含膀胱草及其近親的狸藻科
sentences: Lentibulariaceae includes carnivorous plants with tiny suction traps. 這個科包含有細小吸捕囊的食蟲植物。
A Lentibulariaceae flower rose above the wet bog. 一朵這個科的花從潮濕沼澤上方升起。

meaning: 形容詞；狸藻科的，或與狸藻科有關的。
sentences: lentibulariaceous plants catch prey with bladders or sticky leaves where the soil is poor. 狸藻科植物在土壤貧瘠處靠捕蟲囊或黏葉來捉取獵物。
lentibulariaceous links butterwort and bladderwort as members of the same carnivorous family. 這個形容詞把捕蟲堇與狸藻都歸到同一個食蟲植物家族。

meaning: 名詞；皮孔，木本莖或果皮上供氣體交換的小孔。
sentences: lenticel spots on the apple skin looked like pale freckles against the red peel. 蘋果表皮上的皮孔看起來像紅皮上的淡色雀斑。
lenticel allows gas exchange through bark that would otherwise seal the stem too tightly. 皮孔讓氣體能穿過樹皮交換，否則樹幹外層會封得太密。

meaning: 形容詞；有皮孔的。
sentences: lenticellate twigs showed raised dots that helped identify the young cherry tree. 帶有皮孔的小枝上有隆起小點，這有助於辨認幼年櫻樹。
lenticellate stem looked speckled under magnification because tiny breathing pores covered it. 放大後，這根有皮孔的莖看起來滿是斑點，因為表面布滿微小通氣孔。

meaning: 名詞；透鏡狀小岩體；亦可指鐘殼上露出擺錘的小窗。
sentences: lenticle in the sandstone pinched out at both ends like a buried lens. 砂岩中的透鏡狀小岩體像埋在地下的鏡片，往兩端逐漸消失。
lenticle on the brass clock let the pendulum bob be seen as it swung. 黃銅鐘殼上的小窗讓人能看見擺錘來回擺動。

meaning: 名詞；晶狀體表面圓錐狀突出的眼部異常。
sentences: lenticonus can blur vision because the eye lens bulges outward in a cone. 這種眼部異常會讓視力模糊，因為晶狀體表面向外鼓成圓錐。
lenticonus was visible to the ophthalmologist during the slit-lamp examination. 眼科醫師在裂隙燈檢查時看到了這種圓錐狀晶狀體異常。

meaning: 名詞；雀斑或小型褐色色素斑；醫學舊稱。
sentences: lenticula in older dermatology could mean a small pigmented spot much like a freckle. 較早期皮膚醫學中的這個詞可指小型色素斑，近似雀斑。
lenticula across the bridge of her nose darkened after weeks of midsummer sun. 她鼻樑上的小色斑在盛夏曝曬數週後變得更深。

meaning: 形容詞；透鏡形的；與透鏡、晶狀體有關的。
sentences: lenticular clouds hung motionless over the volcano while the upper wind raced past. 透鏡雲靜止地掛在火山上方，儘管高空強風正疾速掠過。
lenticular screen on the postcard flips between two pictures when you tilt it. 明信片上的透鏡式印刷層一傾斜就會在兩張圖之間切換。

meaning: 新拉丁語形；常作學名的種小名，意為透鏡狀的。
sentences: lenticulare is usually seen as a Latinized species epithet meaning lens-shaped, not as an everyday English noun. 這個詞通常出現在拉丁化的學名中，表示透鏡狀，而不是日常英語名詞。
lenticulare ends with a neuter Latin adjective ending, which points to scientific-name usage. 這個詞以拉丁文中性形容詞字尾結束，因此顯示它多用於學名。

meaning: 由透鏡狀雲組成的雲種，常在山區形成
sentences: Lenticularis clouds hovered like smooth lenses above the mountain. 透鏡狀雲像平滑鏡片般停在山頂上方。
Strong winds shaped the lenticularis over the high ridge. 強風在高山脊上塑造出透鏡狀雲。

meaning: 以雙凸透鏡的方式

Jef walked lenticularly across the room. Jef 以以雙凸透鏡的方式的方式走過房間。

meaning: 形容詞；透鏡狀的；中厚邊薄的。
sentences: lenticulate pebble was thickest at the center and tapered toward both edges. 那顆透鏡狀卵石中央最厚，往兩側邊緣逐漸變薄。
lenticulate cross-section made the blade strong without leaving it clumsy in the hand. 透鏡狀橫切面讓刀身兼具強度與手感，不致顯得笨重。

meaning: 透鏡狀的；小扁豆狀的
sentences: lenticulated clouds hovered above the ridge long after the storm had passed. 山脊上方的透鏡狀雲在暴風雨過後仍久久不散。
lenticulated studs on the bronze shield flashed whenever the torch swung past. 青銅盾上的透鏡狀飾釘每逢火把晃過就會閃光。

sentences: lenticule removed during SMILE surgery is a tiny disc of corneal tissue. 微笑近視雷射取出的角膜薄片是一小片圓盤狀角膜組織。
lenticule arrays in 3-D postcards send a different picture to each eye. 立體明信片上的微透鏡陣列會把不同影像送進左右眼。

meaning: 豆狀核與紋狀體的；常指豆紋動脈
sentences: lenticulostriate arteries are especially vulnerable to damage from chronic hypertension. 豆紋動脈特別容易受到長期高血壓的損害。
lenticulostriate infarcts often produce pure motor weakness without cortical signs. 豆紋區梗塞常造成單純運動無力而沒有皮質症狀。

meaning: 豆狀核與丘腦之間的
sentences: lenticulothalamic fibers carry pallidal output forward to the thalamus. 豆狀核到丘腦的纖維會把蒼白球輸出傳往丘腦。
lenticulothalamic pathways matter when surgeons map deep brain targets. 外科醫師標定深部腦部目標時，豆丘路徑很重要。

meaning: 透鏡狀的；雙凸鏡形的
sentences: lentiform clouds stacked over the volcano in smooth silver layers at dusk. 黃昏時，火山上空的透鏡雲疊成一層層平滑的銀色雲片。
lentiform pebbles in the stream looked polished into tiny glassy lenses. 溪流裡的透鏡狀卵石被磨得像一枚枚發亮的小鏡片。

meaning: 具水晶體的；有晶狀體的
sentences: lentigerous eyes let squid focus light far more sharply than simple eyespots can. 具晶狀體的眼睛讓烏賊聚焦光線的能力遠勝過單純眼點。
lentigerous vision marks a major evolutionary step beyond pigment-cup photoreceptors. 具有晶狀體的視覺系統代表比色素杯感光器更進一步的演化。

meaning: 有雀斑樣斑點的；與雀斑樣痣斑相關的
sentences: lentiginous patches spread across the backs of his hands after decades of sun. 他手背上那些雀斑樣色斑是在多年日曬後逐漸擴散的。
lentiginous seed coats gave the beans a fine peppered appearance. 豆子的種皮布滿細小斑點，看起來像灑了胡椒。

meaning: 雀斑樣痣斑；皮膚上的平坦色素斑
sentences: lentigo on her cheek stayed flat and evenly brown, so it was photographed for follow-up. 她臉頰上的雀斑樣痣斑維持平坦且色澤均勻，因此被拍照追蹤。
lentigo can darken after years of ultraviolet exposure without becoming raised. 雀斑樣痣斑在多年紫外線照射後可能會變深，但不一定會隆起。

meaning: 小扁豆
sentences: She made a healthy and nutritious soup with red lentils. 她做了一道用紅扁豆熬製的健康營養湯品。
Lentils are a great source of protein for vegetarians. 扁豆是素食者優質的蛋白質來源。

meaning: 開花植物屬 Lens 的同義名稱
sentences: Lentilla was once used as another name for the lentil genus. 這是小扁豆屬過去使用的另一個名稱。
An old seed catalogue lists Lentilla beside the familiar plant name. 一本舊種子目錄把這個舊名稱列在常用植物名旁。

A lentisc grew among the dry stones of the Mediterranean slope. 一棵乳香樹長在地中海山坡的乾燥石間。

sentences: lentisco grows on dry Mediterranean slopes where its resinous leaves release a sharp scent. 乳香木生長在乾燥的地中海山坡上，含樹脂的葉片會散出辛烈氣味。
lentisco resin has long been chewed as mastic and used in varnish and sweets. 乳香木樹脂長久以來都被當作口香樹脂，也用於清漆和糖果。

meaning: 乳香樹
sentences: Lentiscus has evergreen leaves and clusters of small red fruits. 乳香樹有常綠葉片和成簇小紅果。
The lentiscus cast a thin shadow across the pale soil. 乳香樹在淡色土壤上投下薄薄樹影。

sentences: Lentisk leaves gave the hillside a resinous Mediterranean scent. 黃連木葉讓山坡帶有地中海樹脂香。
A lentisk trunk twisted around the edge of the path. 一棵黃連木的樹幹在小路邊扭曲生長。

meaning: 古語：遲緩；呆滯
sentences: lentitude in the permit process turned a quick repair into a monthlong delay. 行政流程的遲緩把原本很快的修繕拖成了一個月的延誤。
lentitude of the old tractor became obvious the moment it met the uphill track. 那台老舊拖拉機一碰上上坡路，它的遲鈍就立刻顯露無遺。

sentences: lentitudinous traffic crawled through the pass while crews cleared fallen rock. 道路清障時，山口的車流以極慢速度往前爬行。
lentitudinous prose can suit meditation yet frustrate readers who want momentum. 拖沓的散文也許適合沉思，卻會讓想看節奏的人不耐。

meaning: 音樂：慢板的；緩慢地
sentences: lento at the top of the page tells the pianist to move with grave calm. 樂譜頁首的慢板標記告訴鋼琴家要以沉著平穩的速度前進。
lento passages demand broad bow strokes and patient control of the phrase. 慢板段落需要寬大的運弓和耐心的樂句控制。

meaning: 透鏡狀的；雙凸鏡形的
sentences: lentoid pebbles on the riverbank had been flattened into smooth biconvex shapes. 河岸上的透鏡狀石子被水磨成平滑的雙凸外形。
lentoid nuclei in anatomy are named for the lenslike outline seen in section. 解剖學中的透鏡狀核團正是因切面呈鏡片外形而得名。

meaning: 黏稠度；尤指血液黏度
sentences: lentor of the patient's blood rose sharply during the hyperviscosity crisis. 高黏滯危象期間，病人血液的黏稠度明顯上升。
lentor in the boiled syrup made it fall from the spoon in a thick ribbon. 熬煮後糖漿的黏稠度讓它從湯匙落下時形成粗厚的帶狀。

meaning: 古語：黏稠的；黏附力強的
sentences: lentous mud clung to the wagon wheels until they nearly stopped turning. 黏稠的泥巴緊黏車輪，幾乎讓輪子停轉。
lentous resin oozed from the cut bark in slow amber strings. 黏稠的樹脂從切開的樹皮滲出，拉成一條條琥珀色細線。

meaning: 古拼法：詩末短尾聲
sentences: lenvoi at the end of the ballade turns from argument to a direct address. 歌謠詩末尾的短尾聲會從鋪陳轉向直接致意。
lenvoi lets the poet step outside the main stanza for a brief farewell. 詩末短尾聲讓詩人得以暫時走出主體詩節，作簡短告別。

meaning: 古拼法：詩末短尾聲
sentences: lenvoy closes the sestina with a compact turn on the repeated end-words. 這種詩末短尾聲會用重複的尾字，緊湊地收束六節詩。
lenvoy in some Tudor poems serves as a dedication to a patron. 都鐸時期有些詩裡，這種尾聲兼作獻給贊助者的致詞。

meaning: 包含多種真菌的多孔菌科分類屬
sentences: Lenzites forms shelf-like fruiting bodies on dead wood. 這種真菌屬在枯木上形成架狀子實體。
A Lenzites bracket overlapped another along the fallen log. 一個這種真菌屬的菌架沿倒木與另一個重疊。

meaning: 利奧，男子名；亦可指獅子座
sentences: Leo remains a popular short given name across Europe and the Americas. 這個短男子名在歐洲與美洲一直都很常見。
Leo in astrology covers birthdays that fall in late July and most of August. 占星學中的獅子座涵蓋七月下旬到八月大部分日期出生的人。

meaning: 男子名；地名
sentences: Albert visited Leon during a holiday. Albert 假日時造訪了這個地方。
Alberto read about Leon before the trip. Alberto 旅行前讀了這個地方的資料。

meaning: 倫納德，男子名
sentences: Leonard comes from Germanic name elements commonly glossed as lion and brave. 這個男子名來自日耳曼語姓名成分，常被解作獅子與勇敢。
Leonard often shortens to familiar nicknames in everyday speech. 這個名字在日常口語裡常被縮短成較親暱的稱呼。

meaning: 具達文西風格的
sentences: Leonardesque shading softened the portrait until the smile looked almost secret. 這幅肖像用了達文西式的明暗暈染，讓笑意顯得近乎神祕。
Leonardesque notebooks mix anatomy, machinery, and mirror-writing on the same page. 達文西風格的筆記常把解剖、機械與鏡寫文字放在同一頁。

meaning: 李奧納托，《無事生非》中的梅西納總督
sentences: Leonato welcomes Don Pedro's company to Messina at the opening of the play. 在劇作開場時，梅西納總督迎接唐佩卓一行人來到城中。
Leonato is both Hero's father and the household authority whose honor drives the crisis. 這個角色既是希羅的父親，也是家族權威，他的名譽牽動了整場危機。

meaning: 獅狨；獅絨猴
sentences: leoncito leaps through the canopy with a mane of fur around its small face. 獅狨在樹冠間跳躍時，牠小小的臉四周圍著一圈鬃毛般的毛。
leoncito feeds on fruit, insects, and tree exudates in South American forests. 獅狨在南美森林裡以果實、昆蟲和樹液為食。

meaning: 萊昂的；萊昂語的
sentences: Leonese speech preserves regional forms that standard Spanish no longer keeps. 萊昂語或萊昂地區語音保存了標準西語已不再保留的形式。
Leonese monasteries often combine Romanesque stonework with later Gothic additions. 萊昂地區的修道院常把羅馬式石作和後來增建的哥德式部分並列。

meaning: 一種含水沸石礦物
sentences: Amanda studied a leonhardite in the lab. Amanda 在實驗中研究了含水沸石礦物。
Amarth identified the leonhardite during testing. Amarth 在檢驗時辨認出含水沸石礦物。

meaning: 列昂尼德，斯拉夫男子名
sentences: Leonid is a Slavic form of the Greek name Leonidas. 這是源自希臘名字的一種斯拉夫語形式。
Leonid appears often in Russian and Ukrainian biographies from the last two centuries. 過去兩百年的俄語和烏克蘭語人物傳記裡，這個名字經常出現。

meaning: 與名為良或 Leo 的教宗相關的
sentences: Leonine walls once enclosed the Vatican district on the right bank of the Tiber. 昔日的良氏城牆曾圍住台伯河右岸的梵蒂岡區。
Leonine prayers were recited after Low Mass in many Catholic churches for decades. 許多天主教會曾在低彌撒後誦念良十三世規定的一組經文多年。

meaning: 獅子般的；威嚴而鬃髮濃密的
sentences: leonine hair framed the actor's head like a mane under the stage lamps. 那名演員在舞台燈下的濃密頭髮像鬃毛般環住了頭部。
leonine bearing made the old statesman seem larger than the crowd around him. 那位老政治家的獅子般氣勢讓他看起來比周圍人群更有分量。

meaning: 以獅子的方式
sentences: Anatole answered leoninely when asked. Anatole 被問到時以以獅子的方式的方式回答。
Anatoly walked leoninely across the room. Anatoly 以以獅子的方式的方式走過房間。

meaning: leonine的複數形式
sentences: The student practiced reading several Latin leonines during the class. 學生在課堂上練習朗讀了幾句拉丁語里奧寧詩句。
These medieval leonines are known for having rhymes in the middle of lines. 這些中世紀里奧寧詩句以句中押韻而聞名。

meaning: 天文：獅子座的屬格，用於恆星名
sentences: Leonis appears in star names such as Beta Leonis and Gamma Leonis. 這個拉丁屬格會出現在一些恆星名稱裡，例如獅子座 β 與 γ。
Leonis tells astronomers that the star belongs to the constellation Leo. 這個字形告訴天文學家，那顆星屬於獅子座。

meaning: 主張教宗良氏立場的人
sentences: Andrea discussed Leonist over dinner. Andrea 晚餐時談到主張教宗良氏立場的人。
Andreas noticed Leonist in the debate. Andreas 在辯論中注意到主張教宗良氏立場的人。

sentences: Andrew studied a leonite in the lab. Andrew 在實驗中研究了蒸發岩，由混合的硫酸鉀和硫酸鎂組成，化學式為。
Andries identified the leonite during testing. Andries 在檢驗時辨認出蒸發岩，由混合的硫酸鉀和硫酸鎂組成，化學式為。

meaning: 古地名拼法：Lyonesse，亞瑟傳說中的沉沒國度
sentences: Leonnoys in Arthurian romance names the drowned land west of Cornwall. 在亞瑟王傳奇中，這個古拼法指的是康瓦爾以西沉沒的國度。
Leonnoys later merges with Tristan legend as the homeland of his royal line. 後來的崔斯坦傳說把這片土地寫成他王族血統的故鄉。

meaning: 利奧諾拉地區；亦作女子名
sentences: Angus visited Leonora during a holiday. Angus 假日時造訪了這個地方。
Anita read about Leonora before the trip. Anita 旅行前讀了這個地方的資料。

meaning: 撒哈拉以南非洲的獅耳花分類屬

A Leonotis attracted sunbirds beside the dry garden wall. 一株獅耳花屬植物吸引太陽鳥來到乾燥花園牆邊。

meaning: 一種罕見的疾病，其特徵是臉部和顱骨過度生長，導致獅子臉部外觀
sentences: Ann studied a leontiasis in the lab. Ann 在實驗中研究了罕見的疾病，其特徵是臉部和顱骨過度生長，導致獅子。
Anna identified the leontiasis during testing. Anna 在檢驗時辨認出罕見的疾病，其特徵是臉部和顱骨過度生長，導致獅子。

meaning: 鞍背狨猴所屬的分類屬
sentences: Leontocebus monkeys forage in the lower rainforest canopy. 鞍背狨猴屬猴子在雨林下層樹冠覓食。
A Leontocebus family crossed the vine bridge together. 一群鞍背狨猴屬猴子一起越過藤橋。

meaning: 獅首的；獅頭人身的
sentences: leontocephalous figures in Mithraic shrines often wear a serpent coiled around the body. 密特拉神殿中的獅首神像常被刻成有蛇纏繞全身。
leontocephalous guardians above the gate gave the temple an aggressive, protective look. 大門上方的獅首守護像讓神廟顯得既兇猛又有防護意味。

meaning: 包含鷹嘴草的菊科分類屬
sentences: Leontodon sends yellow flower heads above short grass. 鷹嘴草屬植物在矮草上方開黃色花頭。
A Leontodon seed floated across the meadow on a breeze. 一顆鷹嘴草屬植物種子乘風飄過草地。

meaning: 菊科的雛菊類植物分類屬
sentences: Leontopodium has pale woolly bracts around its tiny flowers. 雛菊屬植物的小花周圍有淡色絨毛苞片。
A Leontopodium clung to the alpine scree above the tree line. 一株雛菊屬植物附著在林線上方的高山碎石坡。

meaning: 包含益母草等植物的唇形科分類屬
sentences: Leonurus bears prickly whorls of pink flowers around the stem. 益母草屬植物在莖周圍長出帶刺粉紅輪傘花。
A Leonurus plant rose beside the abandoned field. 一株益母草屬植物在荒置田地旁長高。

meaning: 豹
sentences: The leopard is a powerful and agile predator known for its spots. 豹是一種強大敏捷、以其斑點聞名的捕食者。
We saw a family of leopards resting under a tree in the savannah. 我們在熱帶草原的一棵樹下看到一群豹正在休息。

meaning: 古拼法：leopard
sentences: leoparde in Middle English verse is simply an older spelling of the modern animal name. 中古英文詩句裡的這個詞只是現代豹名的舊拼法。
leoparde keeps the final silent e that scribes often wrote in medieval manuscripts. 這個古拼法保留了中世抄寫文本裡常見的字尾不發音 e。

meaning: 雌豹
sentences: leopardess carried her cubs one by one to a safer ledge before sunrise. 雌豹在日出前把幼獸一隻一隻叼到更安全的岩架上。
leopardess waited in the acacia until the antelope stepped within one bound. 雌豹伏在相思樹上，等羚羊走進一次撲躍就能抵達的距離。

meaning: 像豹的；具豹紋特徵的
sentences: leopardine rosettes across the fabric were printed as uneven black rings. 布料上的豹紋玫瑰斑被印成一圈圈不規則的黑環。
leopardine grace let the dancer cross the stage in silent springing steps. 豹子般的敏捷讓舞者以無聲而富彈性的步伐掠過舞台。

meaning: 一種化學或生物學名稱
sentences: Archie studied a leopardite in the lab. Archie 在實驗中研究了化學或生物學名稱。
Ariel identified the leopardite during testing. Ariel 在檢驗時辨認出化學或生物學名稱。

meaning: 澳洲兩種樹幹有斑點的弗林德斯木屬樹木
sentences: Leopardwood has spotted bark that resembles a leopard's coat. 豹木的斑點樹皮像豹的毛皮。
A leopardwood stood beside the dry road in Queensland. 一棵豹木生長在昆士蘭乾燥道路旁。

meaning: 利奧波德，男子名
sentences: Leopold comes from Germanic elements usually interpreted as people and bold. 這個男子名來自日耳曼語成分，通常解作人民與勇敢。
Leopold is familiar in Central European history through rulers, patrons, and composers. 中歐歷史中的統治者、贊助者與作曲家讓這個名字相當常見。

meaning: 包含哈拉棕櫚和皮薩瓦棕櫚的棕櫚科分類屬
sentences: Leopoldinia palms grow beside blackwater rivers in the Amazon. 哈拉棕櫚屬棕櫚生長在亞馬遜黑水河旁。
A Leopoldinia crown rose above the flooded forest. 一株哈拉棕櫚屬植物的樹冠高出淹水森林。

meaning: 一種碘酸鉀礦物
sentences: Arnold studied a leopoldite in the lab. Arnold 在實驗中研究了碘酸鉀礦物。
Art identified the leopoldite during testing. Art 在檢驗時辨認出碘酸鉀礦物。

meaning: 莉歐拉，女子名
sentences: Leora is a feminine given name of Hebrew origin meaning my light. 這是源自希伯來語的女子名，意思是我的光。
Leora has a warm, old-fashioned sound that keeps it alive in modern baby-name lists. 這個名字帶有溫暖而略顯古典的音感，因此至今仍出現在現代命名清單裡。

meaning: 緊身連身衣；體操或芭蕾常穿的無腿衣
sentences: leotard lets a gymnast twist and invert without loose cloth catching the bar. 緊身連身衣讓體操選手翻轉時不會有鬆布勾到器械。
leotard for rehearsal was plain black cotton, while the stage version glittered under spotlights. 排練用的連身衣是素黑棉布，正式演出那件則在聚光燈下閃亮。

meaning: 罕見外來詞：可指半融雪泥，也可口語指笨拙的人
sentences: lepa in Serbo-Croatian can mean slushy half-melted snow underfoot. 這個外來詞在塞爾維亞-克羅埃西亞語裡可指腳下那種半融的雪泥。
lepa also appears colloquially for an awkward person, so it is not standard native English. 這個詞也可口語指笨手笨腳的人，因此並不是標準本族英語詞。

meaning: 包含鵝藤壺的有柄藤壺分類科
sentences: Lepadidae contains stalked barnacles attached to floating surfaces. 這個科包含附著在漂浮表面的有柄藤壺。
A Lepadidae colony covered the underside of the driftwood. 一群這個科的有柄藤壺覆蓋浮木底面。

meaning: Lepas屬或鵝藤壺科的有柄藤壺
sentences: A lepadoid barnacle dangled from the rope below the buoy. 一隻有柄藤壺從浮標下方繩索垂掛。
Lepadoid shells open at the tip of a flexible stalk. 這類有柄藤壺的殼在柔韌柄端張開。

meaning: 勒班陀；今希臘納夫帕克托斯，亦指 1571 年海戰
sentences: Lepanto is the old Venetian name for Nafpaktos on the Gulf of Corinth. 勒班陀是希臘科林斯灣畔納夫帕克托斯的威尼斯舊稱。
Lepanto usually evokes the 1571 naval battle that checked Ottoman expansion at sea. 這個地名通常會讓人想到一五七一年遏止鄂圖曼海上擴張的海戰。

meaning: 多見於舊化學名 lepargylic acid，指壬二酸的舊別名；單獨用極罕見
sentences: lepargylic acid is an obsolete chemical name for azelaic acid in older catalogs. 舊化學目錄中的這個酸名是壬二酸的過時名稱。
lepargylic in modern English almost never stands alone and is best read as part of that old acid name. 這個字在現代英語裡幾乎不會單獨使用，通常只應視為那個舊酸名的一部分。

meaning: 牛莓屬的舊屬名；今多併入 Shepherdia
sentences: Lepargyraea once named the buffaloberry shrubs that most floras now place in Shepherdia. 這個舊屬名曾用於牛莓灌木，而多數植物誌如今把它們歸入另一屬。
Lepargyraea canadensis survives mainly in older botanical combinations rather than current usage. 這個舊學名主要殘留在較早的植物命名組合裡，而非現行用法。

meaning: 附著在浮木或船底的有柄藤壺屬藤壺
sentences: Lepas barnacles clung to the hull below the waterline. 鵝藤壺屬藤壺附著在吃水線下的船體。
A Lepas cluster traveled across the ocean on driftwood. 一簇鵝藤壺屬藤壺隨浮木漂過海洋。

meaning: 錫金及喜馬拉雅地區的民族及其語言
sentences: A Lepcha elder taught the children a name for the mountain. 一名雷布查族長者教孩子山的名稱。
Lepcha belongs to the Himalayan branch of the Sino-Tibetan languages. 雷布查語屬於漢藏語系的喜馬拉雅語支。

meaning: 患有痲瘋病的人，患有漢森氏症的人
sentences: Bea studied a leper in the lab. Bea 在實驗中研究了患有痲瘋病的人，患有漢森氏症的人。

The sign painter used letterin to describe the work of adding words to the board. 招牌彩繪師以這個詞指稱在看板上加字的工作。

meaning: 字體設計或書寫的文字；字樣
sentences: The lettering on the sign is easy to read. 牌子上的字樣很容易閱讀。
She practiced lettering with a brush. 她用毛筆練習字體書寫。

meaning: 某些蘭花的俗稱
sentences: Letterleaf orchids carry markings that resemble small written signs. 信葉蘭的葉片帶有像小字跡的斑紋。
A letterleaf flower opened beneath the forest canopy. 一朵信葉蘭在森林樹冠下開放。

meaning: 沒有字母的；不使用字母的
sentences: The letterless map uses only symbols. 這張無字母地圖只使用符號。
A letterless code can still convey directions. 不含字母的代碼仍能傳達方向。

meaning: 活版印刷；以凸起的字模或版面直接壓印在紙張上的印刷技術
sentences: The printer used letterpress to create crisp invitations. 印刷師以活版印刷製作字跡清晰的邀請卡。
Traditional letterpress presses raised type directly against the paper. 傳統活版印刷會把凸起的字模直接壓在紙張上。

meaning: （排版）寬度相當於一個字母的空白鉛字或間距
sentences: The compositor inserted a letterspace between the two initials. 排字工在兩個姓名縮寫字母之間插入一個字母寬的空鉛。
Each letterspace was as wide as a single type character. 每個字母空鉛的寬度都等同一個活字。

meaning: （古語）紙鎮；壓住紙張的重物
sentences: The brass letterweight held the papers flat. 黃銅紙鎮把文件壓平。
She moved the letterweight before signing. 她簽名前移開紙鎮。

meaning: 斑點像象形文字的古巴木材
sentences: Letterwood shows black markings like symbols across the grain. 信木的木紋上有像符號的黑色斑點。
The carver chose letterwood for the small decorative box. 雕刻師選用信木製作小型裝飾盒。

meaning: （舊稱）拉脫維亞人或拉脫維亞語的；亦曾泛指波羅的語族及其民族的
sentences: Older scholars used Lettic to describe Latvian and related Baltic languages. 早期學者以這個舊稱描述拉脫維亞語及相關的波羅的語言。
The archive contains a nineteenth-century study of Lettic folklore. 檔案館藏有一份十九世紀的拉脫維亞民俗研究。

meaning: 雪鼬冬毛製成的灰白色毛皮，古時常用於服飾
sentences: Tudor women lined winter caps with Lettice. 都鐸時期的女性用雪鼬灰白毛皮作冬帽襯裡。
Soft Lettice trimmed the edge of her cloak. 柔軟的雪鼬灰白毛皮鑲在她的斗篷邊緣。

meaning: 舊稱：拉脫維亞人的、拉脫維亞的或拉脫維亞語的
sentences: Grandfather's diary calls Latvian folk songs Lettish. 祖父的日記使用舊稱來指拉脫維亞民歌。
An 1890 atlas marks the coast as Lettish territory. 一本1890年的地圖把那片海岸標為拉脫維亞領土。

meaning: （印刷）放大的裝飾性首字母
sentences: The lettrin begins the chapter in red ink. 放大的裝飾性首字母以紅墨水開啟本章。
A carved lettrin decorates the manuscript page. 雕刻的裝飾性首字母美化了手稿頁面。

meaning: （礦物學，舊稱）青針銅礦，一種呈天藍至蔚藍色、具纖維狀晶體的含水銅鋁硫酸鹽礦物
sentences: Mineralogists now use cyanotrichite instead of lettsomite for this blue mineral. 礦物學家現在以青針銅礦稱呼這種藍色礦物。
A specimen of lettsomite displayed silky, azure-blue fibers. 一件青針銅礦標本呈現帶有絲絹光澤的蔚藍色纖維。

meaning: 萵苣
sentences: I'd like a fresh green salad with extra lettuce and tomatoes. 我想要一份加了額外萵苣與番茄的新鮮綠色沙拉。
She added some crisp lettuce leaves to the chicken sandwich. 她在雞肉三明治中加入了一些脆嫩的萵苣葉。

meaning: 女性名；Letitia 的暱稱
sentences: Letty was stitched onto the baby's quilt because her grandparents liked the nickname best. 嬰兒被子上繡了萊蒂，因為祖父母最喜歡這個暱稱。
Letty appears on the wedding seating cards instead of the bride's formal first name. 婚宴座位卡上寫的是萊蒂，而不是新娘正式的名字。

meaning: 暫歇；短暫緩和
sentences: Letup came just after midnight, and the road crew finally restarted the paving machine. 午夜過後情況終於稍微緩和，鋪路工人才重新啟動鋪路機。
Letup in the wind allowed the harbor pilot to bring the ferry alongside safely. 風勢稍歇後，港口領航員才得以安全地把渡輪靠上碼頭。

meaning: 列伊；羅馬尼亞或摩爾多瓦的貨幣單位
sentences: Leu coins clinked in the kiosk till after tourists bought postcards in Bucharest. 遊客在布加勒斯特買完明信片後，攤亭收銀機裡的列伊硬幣還在作響。
Leu prices on the cafe board helped us estimate how much cash to exchange before dinner. 咖啡館黑板上的列伊標價，讓我們能估算晚餐前要換多少現金。

meaning: 白千層屬的常綠灌木或喬木
sentences: Leucadendron shrubs bear colorful bracts around their cones. 白千層屬灌木的球果周圍有色彩鮮明苞片。
A Leucadendron grew on the windy South African hillside. 一棵白千層屬植物長在南非多風山坡。

meaning: 希臘萊夫卡達島的；與該島有關的
sentences: Leucadian cliffs fill the travel poster with the white headlands of Lefkada. 旅遊海報上的萊夫卡達島海崖，把那片白色岬角拍得十分醒目。
Leucadian pottery in the museum case was grouped with finds from the Ionian islands. 博物館櫥窗裡的萊夫卡達島陶器，與愛奧尼亞群島出土文物放在同一組。

meaning: 白血病的替代拼字
sentences: Jeff studied a leucaemia in the lab. Jeff 在實驗中研究了白血病的替代拼字。
Jeffery identified the leucaemia during testing. Jeffery 在檢驗時辨認出白血病的替代拼字。

meaning: 白血病的；患白血病的
sentences: Leucaemic blasts crowded the marrow smear, leaving almost no room for healthy cells. 骨髓抹片上滿是白血病母細胞，幾乎沒有健康細胞的空間。
Leucaemic changes in the blood count explained why the child's bruises spread so quickly. 血球計數中的白血病性變化，解釋了那個孩子瘀青為何擴散得那麼快。

meaning: 包含鉛樹的豆科植物分類屬
sentences: Leucaena grows quickly and provides leafy fodder for livestock. 鉛樹屬生長迅速，能為牲畜提供葉飼料。
A Leucaena hedge bordered the dry pasture. 一排鉛樹屬灌木圍著乾燥牧場。

meaning: 罕見舊詞：舊時指非洲白化症患者，今多不用且可能冒犯
sentences: Leucaethiop was crossed out by the editor, who replaced the outdated label with a respectful modern description. 編者把這個過時字眼劃掉，改成較尊重的現代描述。
Leucaethiop on the exhibit label was kept only inside quotation marks to show the bias of colonial records. 展品標籤上那個過時詞只保留在引號裡，用來呈現殖民檔案的偏見。

meaning: 罕見舊詞：舊時指非洲白化症患者的，今多不用且可能冒犯
sentences: Leucaethiopic wording in the reprint was annotated as obsolete and offensive by the archive staff. 重印本中的這種過時用語，被館藏人員註明為陳舊且帶冒犯性。
Leucaethiopic features were cited in the caption only to quote a racist nineteenth-century description. 說明牌引述這種過時說法，只是為了呈現十九世紀帶有種族歧視的描述。

meaning: 白色至淡黃色的有機化合物，可作染料中間體
sentences: Leucaniline turned pale yellow in the reaction flask before the dye maker added acid. 染料工人加酸前，反應瓶裡的白色苯胺先變成淡黃色。
Leucaniline residue stained the filter paper during a nineteenth-century dye demonstration. 十九世紀染料示範時，濾紙上留下了白色苯胺的殘跡。

meaning: 開白花的
sentences: Leucanthous lilies brightened the monastery garden long after the red tulips had faded. 開白花的百合在紅色鬱金香凋謝後，仍讓修道院花園顯得明亮。
Leucanthous blossoms on the hillside helped us pick out the white-flowering variety at a distance. 山坡上的白花花朵，讓我們遠遠就辨出那株開白花的品種。

meaning: 淺色輝石
sentences: Leucaugite crystals flashed light gray when the basalt chip was split with a hammer. 玄武岩碎片被鐵鎚劈開時，裡面的淺色輝石晶體閃出淡灰色。
Leucaugite in the thin section stood out from darker minerals under polarized light. 偏光下，薄片中的淺色輝石和較暗的礦物明顯區分開來。

meaning: 罕見化學詞：有機染料中間體
sentences: Leucaurin darkened as the jar sat beside the window, showing the intermediate was not fully stable. 罐子放在窗邊後，裡面的白色染料中間體逐漸變深，顯示它並不完全穩定。
Leucaurin was weighed on wax paper before the apprentice mixed the next batch of magenta dye. 學徒調下一批洋紅染料前，先把這種中間體放在蠟紙上秤重。

meaning: 白血病（造血組織癌）
sentences: Jesse studied a leucemia in the lab. Jesse 在實驗中研究了白血病。
Jesus identified the leucemia during testing. Jesus 在檢驗時辨認出白血病。

meaning: 白血病的；患白血病的
sentences: Leucemic infiltration enlarged the spleen so much that the patient could not finish a meal. 白血病性浸潤讓脾臟腫大到病人連一餐都吃不完。
Leucemic cells dominated the slide, which is why the hematologist ordered treatment that day. 玻片上幾乎都是白血病細胞，所以血液科醫師當天就開了治療。

meaning: 包含某些海綿的分類屬
sentences: Leucetta forms small chalky bodies on the shallow seabed. 這種海綿屬在淺海床形成小型粉筆色身體。
A Leucetta colony grew beneath the shaded pier. 一群這種海綿屬生長在陰影碼頭下。

meaning: 蘇格蘭方言：湖或水域
sentences: Leuch names still survive on old maps where Scots speakers once marked every inlet and lake. 在昔日說蘇格蘭語者的地區，老地圖上仍保留著表示湖水或水域的這類地名。
Leuch lay beyond the sheep pasture, a quiet stretch of water dark under the evening cloud. 羊坡後方那片水域靜靜躺著，在傍晚雲影下顯得深黑。

meaning: 白血病的古老形式
sentences: Jimmy studied a leuchaemia in the lab. Jimmy 在實驗中研究了白血病的古老形式。
Jin identified the leuchaemia during testing. Jin 在檢驗時辨認出白血病的古老形式。

meaning: 白血病的古老形式
sentences: Jinchao studied a leuchemia in the lab. Jinchao 在實驗中研究了白血病的古老形式。
Jingbai identified the leuchemia during testing. Jingbai 在檢驗時辨認出白血病的古老形式。

meaning: 鐵含量極低的斜綠泥石變種
sentences: Leuchtenbergite formed soft green plates along the fracture in the serpentinite outcrop. 蛇紋岩露頭的裂面上長出柔軟的綠色薄片，那是這種低鐵綠泥石。
Leuchtenbergite from the Austrian vein crumbled easily when the curator lifted it for cleaning. 來自奧地利礦脈的這塊低鐵綠泥石，在館員拿起清理時很容易碎裂。

meaning: 白鮭屬中的西斯科魚分類亞屬
sentences: Leucichthys includes ciscos that live in cold northern lakes. 這個分類亞屬包含生活在北方寒冷湖泊的西斯科魚。
A Leucichthys fish rose toward the plankton-rich water. 一條西斯科魚向富含浮游生物的水層上升。

meaning: 蝦屬的舊分類名稱
sentences: Leucifer was formerly used as a name for a shrimp genus. 這是蝦屬過去使用的名稱。
A marine catalogue cross-references Leucifer with the accepted name. 一份海洋目錄把這個舊名稱與現行名稱互相參照。

meaning: 蝦科的舊分類名稱
sentences: Leuciferidae was once used as another name for a shrimp family. 這是蝦科過去使用的另一個名稱。
Older crustacean lists place the animals in Leuciferidae. 較早的甲殼動物名錄把這些動物列在這個舊科名下。

meaning: 白胺酸；一種必需胺基酸
sentences: Leucine helps your muscles recover after hard exercise. 白胺酸有助於肌肉在劇烈運動後恢復。
Leucine is found in eggs, meat, and beans. 白胺酸存在於蛋、肉類和豆類中。

meaning: 留基波斯；古希臘哲學家，常被視為原子論先驅
sentences: Leucippus is often linked to the early idea of atoms. 留基波斯常被認為和早期原子觀念有關。
Leucippus may have influenced Democritus. 留基波斯可能影響了德謨克利特。

meaning: 白化現象；動物部分色素缺失而呈淡白或斑白的狀態
sentences: Leucism made the bird's feathers look patchy and pale. 白化現象讓那隻鳥的羽毛看起來斑駁而淡白。
Leucism does not usually change the color of the eyes. 白化現象通常不會改變眼睛的顏色。

meaning: 白榴石；一種含鉀的火成岩礦物
sentences: Leucite appears in some volcanic rocks. 白榴石會出現在某些火山岩中。
Leucite can form clear, light-colored crystals. 白榴石可以形成淺色而清楚的晶體。

meaning: 含白榴石的；與白榴石有關的
sentences: Leucitic lava cooled into a hard, pale rock. 含白榴石的熔岩冷卻後形成堅硬的淺色岩石。
Leucitic material is useful for identifying some volcanic formations. 含白榴石的物質有助於辨認某些火山地層。

meaning: 白榴石岩；主要由白榴石構成的岩石
sentences: Leucitis is rare but important in some old geological studies. 白榴石岩雖少見，卻在一些早期地質研究中很重要。
Leucitis contains a large amount of white garnet-like mineral matter. 白榴石岩含有大量類似白榴石的礦物成分。

meaning: 白榴岩；富含白榴石的火成岩
sentences: Leucitite forms from unusual magma chemistry. 白榴岩形成於特殊的岩漿化學條件。
Leucitite often contains little or no quartz. 白榴岩通常幾乎不含石英或完全不含石英。

meaning: 白榴石二十四面體；白榴石常見的晶形
sentences: Leucitohedron describes a crystal shape associated with white garnet-like mineral forms. 白榴石二十四面體指的是與白榴石相關的晶體形狀。
Leucitohedron can be hard to picture without a model. 白榴石二十四面體若沒有模型會很難想像。

meaning: 白榴石形；類似白榴石晶形的多面體
sentences: Leucitoid is used to name a crystal form. 白榴石形用來指稱一種晶體外形。
Leucitoid looks complex even in a simple drawing. 白榴石形即使在簡單圖示裡看起來也很複雜。

meaning: 扁蟲屬的舊分類名稱
sentences: Leuckartia was formerly used as a genus name for certain flatworms. 這是某些扁蟲過去使用的分類屬名。
A parasite catalogue gives Leuckartia as an older synonym. 一份寄生蟲目錄把這個名稱列為舊同義名。

meaning: 一個分類科
sentences: Leuckartiidae appears as a family name in older parasite classifications. 這個科名出現在較早的寄生蟲分類中。
The worm's structure once placed it near Leuckartiidae. 這種蠕蟲的構造過去讓人把它歸在接近這個科的位置。

meaning: 隱色的；無色還原態的
sentences: Leuco dye turns colorful after oxidation. 隱色染料在氧化後會變得有顏色。
Leuco form stayed nearly colorless in the bottle. 隱色型態放在瓶中時幾乎沒有顏色。

meaning: 淺色玄武岩；顏色較淡的玄武岩
sentences: Leucobasalt is lighter in color than typical basalt. 淺色玄武岩比一般玄武岩顏色更淡。
Leucobasalt can confuse beginners who expect basalt to be dark. 淺色玄武岩會讓以為玄武岩一定很黑的人感到意外。

meaning: 白血球母細胞；未成熟的白血球前驅細胞
sentences: Leucoblast appears early in white blood cell development. 白血球母細胞出現在白血球發育的早期。
Leucoblast counts may rise in serious blood disorders. 在嚴重血液疾病中，白血球母細胞數量可能上升。

meaning: 白血球母細胞的；與白血球母細胞有關的
sentences: Leucoblastic changes were noted in the marrow. 骨髓中可見白血球母細胞相關變化。
Leucoblastic cells are immature and not fully functional yet. 白血球母細胞型細胞尚未成熟，功能也還不完整。

meaning: 包含單鱗苔蘚的分類科
sentences: Leucobryaceae contains pale mosses with water-holding leaves. 這個科包含葉片能蓄水的淡色苔蘚。
A Leucobryaceae cushion brightened the wet forest floor. 一墊這個科的苔蘚讓潮濕森林地面變明亮。

meaning: 包含多種苔蘚的白苔科分類屬
sentences: Leucobryum forms rounded pale cushions on acidic soil. 白苔屬在酸性土壤上形成圓形淡色苔墊。
A Leucobryum clump held droplets after the morning fog. 一叢白苔屬苔蘚在晨霧後留住水滴。

meaning: 白果的；結白色果實的
sentences: Leucocarpous shrubs stood out because their fruits were white. 結白色果實的灌木因果實潔白而特別顯眼。
Leucocarpous varieties are uncommon in the market. 結白色果實的品種在市面上並不常見。

meaning: 白砷銅礦；一種淡色的含銅礦物
sentences: Leucochalcite can appear as a pale crust on rock. 白砷銅礦可能以淡色薄殼狀出現在岩石表面。
Leucochalcite contains copper and arsenic. 白砷銅礦含有銅和砷。

meaning: 與白膽汁相關的；白色膽汁樣的
sentences: Leucocholic fluid suggested an unusual bile condition. 白膽汁樣液體顯示出不尋常的膽汁狀況。
Leucocholic change is a medical term, not a casual one. 與白膽汁相關的變化是醫學用語，不是日常說法。

meaning: 白膽汁症；古舊醫學中指白色膽汁相關狀態
sentences: Leucocholy appears mainly in older medical writing. 白膽汁症主要出現在較早期的醫學文獻中。
Leucocholy is not a term most people hear today. 白膽汁症不是現代多數人常聽到的詞。

meaning: 色淡的；呈白色或淺色的
sentences: Leucochroic stones look washed out beside darker ones. 淺色的石頭放在深色石頭旁會顯得顏色很淡。
Leucochroic feathers gave the bird a soft appearance. 淺色羽毛讓那隻鳥看起來更柔和。

meaning: 殺白血球的；會破壞白血球的
sentences: Leucocidic toxins can damage white blood cells. 殺白血球性毒素會破壞白血球。
Leucocidic activity made the infection more dangerous. 殺白血球作用讓感染變得更危險。

meaning: 白血球毒素；可殺傷白血球的細菌毒素
sentences: Leucocidin helps some bacteria attack immune cells. 白血球毒素能幫助某些細菌攻擊免疫細胞。

Librarius was a skilled worker with steady hands. 抄寫員是需要穩定手勁的熟練工作者。

meaning: 圖書館
sentences: I often go to the university library to study in silence. 我經常去大學圖書館安靜地讀書。
The local library has a vast collection of books and magazines. 當地圖書館收藏了大量的書籍和雜誌。

meaning: 沒有圖書館的
sentences: Libraryless towns often struggle to offer quiet study space. 沒有圖書館的城鎮常難以提供安靜的讀書空間。
Libraryless neighborhoods lose an important public resource. 缺少圖書館的社區會失去重要的公共資源。

meaning: 擺動；輕微震盪
sentences: Librate slightly, and the hanging lamp will settle soon. 稍微擺動一下，吊燈很快就會穩定下來。
Librate is used in astronomy for a slow rocking motion. 這個詞在天文中用來指緩慢的搖擺運動。

meaning: 天體的擺動；輕微振盪
sentences: Libration lets us see a little more of the moon over time. 天體擺動讓我們隨時間能多看到一點月面。
Libration is a small rocking motion, not a full turn. 這種擺動是輕微搖晃，不是完整旋轉。

meaning: 擺動的；振盪的
sentences: Libratory motion kept the hanging sign in gentle movement. 擺動的運動讓招牌持續輕輕晃動。
Libratory patterns can be hard to notice at first glance. 振盪的模式一開始可能不容易察覺。

meaning: 歌劇劇本的複數
sentences: The composer kept the old libretti in a wooden box. 作曲家把舊歌劇劇本放在木盒裡。
She translated several libretti for the opera company. 她為那家歌劇團翻譯了幾本歌劇劇本。

meaning: 歌劇劇本作者
sentences: Librettist and composer argued for hours over one scene. 歌劇劇本作者與作曲家為了一幕爭論了好幾個小時。
Librettist work demands both drama and rhythm. 撰寫歌劇劇本需要兼顧戲劇性與節奏感。

meaning: 歌劇劇本；音樂劇腳本
sentences: Libretto matters as much as music in a strong opera. 在一部優秀歌劇裡，劇本和音樂一樣重要。
Libretto on its own can still read like poetry. 就算單獨閱讀，歌劇劇本也可能像詩一樣。

meaning: 天秤座流星群的流星
sentences: Librid streaks are linked with the area of the sky near Libra. 這類流星被認為來自接近天秤座的天空區域。
Librid sightings are rare for most casual skywatchers. 對多數隨興觀星的人來說，看到這類流星並不常見。

meaning: 韌皮狀的；纖維狀的
sentences: Libriform fibers help give strength to some plant tissue. 韌皮狀纖維有助於提供某些植物組織強度。
Libriform structure is discussed in plant anatomy. 這種纖維狀構造常見於植物解剖學討論。

meaning: 形成韌皮部的細胞
sentences: Libroplast is a rare term in older plant anatomy. 這是植物解剖學裡較少見的舊用語。
Libroplast refers to a cell involved in forming bast tissue. 這個詞指參與形成韌皮組織的細胞。

meaning: 利比亞的；利比亞人；利比亞阿拉伯語
sentences: Libyan food often features bread, lamb, and spices. 利比亞飲食常見麵包、羊肉與香料。
Libyan history connects North Africa, the Mediterranean, and the desert. 利比亞歷史連結了北非、地中海與沙漠。

meaning: 前吻蝴蝶的舊分類科，現相當於吻蝴蝶亞科
sentences: Libytheidae was an earlier family name for snout butterflies. 這是吻蝴蝶過去使用的分類科名。
Older butterfly books place the species in Libytheidae. 較早的蝴蝶書籍把該物種列在這個舊科名下。

meaning: 包含吻蝴蝶的蛺蝶科分類亞科
sentences: Libytheinae contains butterflies with unusually extended labial palps. 這個亞科包含下唇鬚異常延長的蝴蝶。
A Libytheinae butterfly rested on a sunlit twig. 一隻吻蝴蝶亞科蝴蝶停在向陽細枝上。

meaning: 新熱帶地區樹木和灌木的分類屬
sentences: Licania trees provide fruit for birds in tropical forests. 利卡尼亞屬樹木在熱帶森林為鳥類提供果實。
A Licania branch arched over the narrow jungle stream. 一根利卡尼亞屬枝條拱過狹窄叢林溪流。

meaning: 沉香醇
sentences: Licareol is an old name for a fragrant alcohol used in perfume. 這是香水中一種帶香氣醇類的舊名稱。
Licareol has a soft floral smell. 這種物質帶有柔和的花香。

meaning: 利卡，地名異體
sentences: Licca is an old variant name for a European river. 這是某條歐洲河流的古老異稱。
Licca appears mostly in historical writing. 這個名稱大多出現在歷史文字中。

meaning: 可取得許可的
sentences: Licensable music can be used in ads for a fee. 可授權的音樂能付費用於廣告。
Licensable software usually comes with clear terms. 可取得授權的軟體通常附有明確條款。

meaning: 執照
sentences: You must have a valid driver's license to drive a car legally now. 妳現在必須擁有有效的駕駛執照才能合法開車。
The company was granted a formal license to export its products today. 公司今天被授予了出口其產品的正式許可（執照）。

meaning: 已獲得許可證（由所需當局頒發）。
sentences: Only licensed exterminators can purchase rat poison in this state. 在該州，只有獲得許可的滅鼠人員才能購買老鼠藥。
The opening hours of licensed premises are restricted to prevent all-night drinking. 持牌場所的開放時間受到限制，以防止通宵飲酒。

meaning: 被授權人；持照人
sentences: Licensee must follow the brand rules in the contract. 被授權人必須遵守合約中的品牌規範。
Licensee paid a yearly fee to keep the rights. 被授權人每年付費以保留這些權利。

meaning: 無照的；未獲許可的
sentences: Licenseless drivers face heavy penalties. 無照駕駛者會面臨重罰。
Licenseless sales of alcohol are illegal in many places. 未獲許可販售酒類在許多地方都是違法的。

meaning: 授權人；發照者
sentences: Licenser approved the new use of the brand name. 授權人核准了品牌名稱的新用途。
Licenser can end the deal if terms are broken. 若條款被違反，授權人可以終止合作。

meaning: 授權人
sentences: Licensor keeps ownership while granting limited rights. 授權人在給予有限權利時仍保有所有權。
Licensor asked for a higher fee after sales grew. 銷售增加後，授權人要求更高費用。

meaning: 核發執照；取得執照資格
sentences: Licensure is required before she can open the clinic. 在她開設診所前，必須先取得執照資格。
Licensure standards vary by region and profession. 執照制度的標準會因地區與職業而不同。

meaning: 持照者；特許資格持有人
sentences: Licentiate earned the right to practice after passing exams. 那位持照者通過考試後取得執業資格。
Licentiate status can mark an advanced professional stage. 特許資格有時代表較高階的專業階段。

meaning: 持照資格；特許地位
sentences: Licentiateship gave him formal standing in the profession. 持照資格讓他在該專業中擁有正式地位。
Licentiateship often comes after years of training. 這種資格常在多年訓練後取得。

meaning: 核發許可；發給執照
sentences: Licentiation of new clinics slowed after the rule change. 規則改變後，新診所的核照速度變慢了。
Licentiation is a formal act by an authority. 核發許可是主管機關的正式行為。

meaning: 放蕩的；放縱的
sentences: Licentious behavior ruined the actor's public image. 放蕩的行為毀了那名演員的公眾形象。
Licentious songs shocked older listeners. 放縱露骨的歌曲讓年長聽眾很震驚。

meaning: 放蕩地；淫逸地
sentences: Licentiously he lived as if no rule applied to him. 他過著放蕩的生活，彷彿沒有規矩適用於他。
Licentiously written gossip sold well but aged badly. 用放蕩口吻寫成的八卦賣得好，卻很快過時。

meaning: 放蕩；淫逸
sentences: Licentiousness in the palace became a public scandal. 宮中的放蕩風氣成了公開醜聞。
Licentiousness is often mistaken for freedom. 放蕩常被誤認成自由。

meaning: 相同的；相像的
sentences: Lich forms of the word survive only in old dialect writing. 這個表示相同的詞形只在古老方言文字中留存。
Lich once meant much the same as alike. 這個詞過去的意思大致等於相像。

meaning: 身體；軀體
sentences: Licham is an old word for the body. 這是表示身體的古字。
Licham appears in early English religious writing. 這個詞出現在早期英語宗教文字中。

meaning: 里卡諾斯音
sentences: Lichanos was a movable note in ancient Greek music theory. 里卡諾斯音是古希臘樂理中的可移動音。
Lichanos sat between fixed notes in the tetrachord. 它位於四音音列中的固定音之間。

meaning: 地衣
sentences: Lichen grows slowly on rock and bark. 地衣會緩慢生長在岩石與樹皮上。
Lichen can survive in very harsh places. 地衣能在很嚴苛的地方存活。

meaning: 屬於地衣科。
sentences: The biology students examined the lichenaceous growth on the tree bark. 生物系學生檢查了樹皮上的地衣類生長物。
We found several lichenaceous plants while hiking in the damp forest. 我們在潮濕的森林裡徒步旅行時，發現了幾種地衣科植物。

meaning: 覆蓋著地衣。
sentences: The hikers rested near a lichened rock beside the mountain trail. 登山客在山徑旁一塊長滿地衣的岩石附近休息。
The old stone bridge is now heavily lichened after years of neglect. 這座古老的石橋多年失修，現在表面長滿了地衣。

meaning: 包含所有地衣形成真菌的舊分類類別
sentences: Lichenes was once treated as a separate group from other fungi. 這個舊分類類別過去被視為不同於其他真菌的群組。
Early naturalists placed crusts on rocks within Lichenes. 早期博物學家把岩石上的殼狀體歸入這個舊類別。

meaning: 地衣病
sentences: Licheniasis is a rare medical term for a lichen-like skin condition. 這是指類似地衣狀皮膚狀況的罕見醫學用語。
Licheniasis appears mainly in older medical writing. 這個詞主要出現在較早期的醫學文字中。

meaning: 與地衣有關或從地衣獲得
sentences: The chemist extracted a lichenic acid from the samples collected in the woods. 化學家從樹林裡收集的樣本中提取了一種地衣酸。
They are studying the lichenic compounds to understand their potential medical uses. 他們正在研究這些與地衣有關的化合物，以了解其潛在的醫療用途。

meaning: 生活或生長在地衣上。
sentences: The researcher discovered a new species of lichenicolous fungus under the microscope. 研究人員在顯微鏡下發現了一種新的地衣棲息真菌。
Certain lichenicolous insects depend entirely on these organisms for survival. 某些生長於地衣的昆蟲完全依賴這些生物生存。

meaning: 具有地衣的形狀。
sentences: The doctor noticed a licheniform rash on the patient's arm during the examination. 醫生在檢查時注意到病人手臂上有一片地衣狀的皮疹。
The crystal structure has a distinct licheniform pattern when viewed closely. 仔細觀察時，這種晶體結構具有明顯的地衣狀圖案。

meaning: 某些地衣中的葡聚醣
sentences: Lichenin helps give some lichens their flexible texture. 地衣多醣讓某些地衣具有柔韌質地。
Rain can wash lichenin from exposed lichen tissue. 雨水可能從裸露地衣組織中沖走這種葡聚醣。

meaning: 產生地衣的共生關係
sentences: Lichenism joins a fungus with a photosynthetic partner. 地衣共生把真菌與能進行光合作用的夥伴結合。
The rock surface slowly turned gray through lichenism. 岩石表面透過地衣共生慢慢變成灰色。

meaning: 研究地衣的人；地衣學者
sentences: A lichenist mapped the crusts covering the old cemetery wall. 一名地衣學者繪製覆蓋老墓園石牆的地衣分布圖。
The lichenist distinguished two species by their spore structures. 地衣學者依孢子構造區分兩個物種。

meaning: 它以地衣為食。
sentences: The lichenivorous snail slowly crawled across the mossy rocks in search of food. 這種食地衣的蝸牛在長滿青苔的岩石上緩慢爬行尋找食物。
Many lichenivorous insects thrive in this humid environment. 許多以地衣為食的昆蟲在這種潮濕的環境中繁衍生息。

meaning: 真菌形成地衣生物體的過程
sentences: Lichenization begins when a fungus forms a stable partnership with an alga. 地衣化始於真菌與藻類形成穩定夥伴關係。
Slow lichenization can change a bare rock into a living crust. 緩慢地衣化能把裸岩變成有生命的殼狀體。

meaning: 使覆滿地衣；長出地衣
sentences: Lichenize the stone over time, and it will turn patchy green. 石頭隨時間長出地衣後，會變成斑駁的綠色。
Lichenize is rarely used outside scientific contexts. 這個詞很少在科學語境之外使用。

meaning: 與地衣相似或具有地衣特徵。
sentences: The disease caused a lichenlike patch to appear on the surface of the leaves. 這種疾病導致樹葉表面出現類似地衣的斑塊。
He painted a lichenlike texture on the model building to make it look old. 他在模型建築上畫了類似地衣的紋理，讓它看起來很古老。

meaning: 研究和記錄地衣的人
sentences: A lichenographer drew the growth forms found on each boulder. 一名地衣記錄者畫下每塊巨石上的生長形態。
The lichenographer compared old names with current species boundaries. 地衣記錄者比較舊名稱與現行物種界線。

meaning: 地衣學的或與之相關的。
sentences: The professor published a lichenographic study on the flora of the alpine region. 教授發表了一篇關於高山地區植物群的地衣學研究。
She spent hours analyzing the lichenographic data collected from the expedition. 她花了數小時分析從探險中收集到的地衣學數據。

meaning: 地衣學的或與之相關的。
sentences: The library acquired a rare lichenographical manuscript from the nineteenth century. 圖書館獲得了一份珍貴的十九世紀地衣學手稿。
His lichenographical drawings clearly show the structural differences between the species. 他的地衣學繪圖清楚地展示了這些物種之間的結構差異。

meaning: 描述地衣的人；精通地衣學的人
sentences: A lichenographist described the color and texture of the cliff crust. 一名地衣描述者描寫峭壁地衣殼的顏色與質地。
The lichenographist recognized a rare species on the roof tile. 這名地衣學專家在屋瓦上認出稀有物種。

meaning: 地衣的科學描述
sentences: Lichenography records a lichen's structure, habitat, and distribution. 地衣誌記錄地衣的構造、棲地和分布。
Coastal notes contained careful lichenography of the rocks. 海岸筆記載有對岩石地衣的仔細科學描述。

meaning: 類似地衣
sentences: The dermatologist diagnosed the skin condition as a lichenoid eruption. 皮膚科醫生將這種皮膚病診斷為苔蘚樣疹。
We observed a lichenoid growth spreading across the damp basement wall. 我們觀察到潮濕的地下室牆壁上蔓延著一種類似地衣的生長物。

meaning: 與地衣學有關。
sentences: The team conducted a lichenologic survey of the national park to assess air quality. 該團隊對國家公園進行了地衣學調查，以評估空氣品質。
He keeps all his lichenologic samples in a climate-controlled cabinet. 他將所有的地衣學樣本保存在恆溫恆濕的櫃子裡。

meaning: 屬於或關於地衣學的
sentences: The university offers a new lichenological course for advanced botany students. 這所大學為進階植物學學生開設了一門新的地衣學課程。
Their lichenological research focuses on how these organisms survive extreme cold. 他們的地衣學研究重點是這些生物如何在極度寒冷的環境中生存。

meaning: 地衣學專家
sentences: A lichenologist identified the pale growth on the granite. 一名地衣學專家辨認出花崗岩上的淡色生長體。
The lichenologist climbed the ridge to compare high-altitude species. 地衣學專家爬上山脊比較高海拔物種。

meaning: 地衣的科學研究
sentences: Lichenology examines the partnerships that create lichen bodies. 地衣學研究形成地衣體的共生關係。
Her university course introduced lichenology through local forest species. 她的大學課程以當地森林物種介紹地衣學。

meaning: 包含某些苔蘚蟲的地衣蟲分類屬
sentences: Lichenopora builds stony colonies with a lichenlike surface. 地衣蟲屬形成表面像地衣的石灰質群體。
A Lichenopora patch covered the shaded side of the reef. 一片地衣蟲屬群體覆蓋礁石陰面。

meaning: 包含外觀獨特如地衣苔蘚蟲的分類科
sentences: Lichenoporidae contains bryozoans with distinctive crusty colonies. 這個科包含群體外殼獨特的苔蘚蟲。
A Lichenoporidae colony grew on the old shell surface. 一群這個科的苔蘚蟲長在舊貝殼表面。

meaning: 覆有地衣的；像地衣的
sentences: The hikers crossed lichenose rocks near the stream. 健行者走過溪邊覆滿地衣的岩石。
A lichenose wall surrounded the old garden. 一道覆著地衣的牆圍著老花園。

meaning: 覆蓋著地衣。
sentences: The hikers carefully climbed over the slippery, licheny logs blocking the trail. 登山客小心翼翼地爬過擋在小徑上長滿地衣的濕滑圓木。
We found a licheny branch that had fallen from the old oak tree after the storm. 暴風雨過後，我們發現了一根從老橡樹上掉下來、長滿地衣的樹枝。

meaning: 利奇羚
sentences: Lichi lives in wet grasslands and feeds near water. 利奇羚生活在潮濕草地，常在水邊覓食。
Lichi can move quickly through shallow marshes. 利奇羚能快速穿過淺沼地。

meaning: 巴西山菊屬
sentences: Lichnophora is a plant genus native to Brazil. 巴西山菊屬是巴西原生的植物屬。
Lichnophora includes species valued in local herbal use. 這個屬包含一些在地方草藥使用中受重視的種類。

meaning: 一個分類科
sentences: Lichnophoridae is a family name preserved in taxonomic references. 這個科名保存在分類學資料中。
The organism's body plan once led to its placement in Lichnophoridae. 這種生物的體形過去讓人把它歸入這個科。

meaning: 李錫尼的；與李錫尼有關的
sentences: Licinian policy changed the balance of imperial power. 李錫尼時期的政策改變了帝國權力平衡。
Licinian coins are sought by some history collectors. 與李錫尼有關的錢幣受到一些歷史收藏者青睞。

meaning: 合法的；被允許的
sentences: Licit trade still needs careful oversight. 合法交易仍需要謹慎監督。
Licit choices can still raise moral questions. 被允許的選擇仍可能引發道德疑問。

meaning: 拍賣；公開競標
sentences: Licitation began at noon and drew many buyers. 公開競標在中午開始，吸引了許多買家。
Licitation is a formal word for sale by bidding. 這是指以出價方式出售的正式說法。

meaning: 合法地；正當地
sentences: Licitly obtained data can still be misused. 合法取得的資料仍可能被濫用。
Licitly he sold the goods through a registered shop. 他透過登記商店正當地販售那些商品。

meaning: 合法性；正當性
sentences: Licitness alone does not make an act wise. 光有合法性並不代表一個行為就是明智的。
Licitness of the deal was never in doubt. 那筆交易的合法性從未受到質疑。

meaning: 舔
sentences: The little boy enjoyed licking his strawberry ice cream cone. 小男孩很享受地舔著他的草莓冰淇淋甜筒。
The dog happily licked its owner's hand when he arrived home. 當主人回到家時，狗開心地舔著他的手。

sentences: Lifedrop stained the bandage bright red. 那一滴維繫生命的血把繃帶染成鮮紅色。
Lifedrop was all the story needed to feel tragic. 那一滴血就足以讓整個故事顯得悲傷。

meaning: 充滿生氣的；活潑的
sentences: Lifeful music spilled into the street. 充滿生氣的音樂流到街上。
Lifeful kids turned the yard noisy in minutes. 活潑的孩子幾分鐘內就讓院子熱鬧起來。

meaning: 充滿生氣地；活潑地
sentences: Lifefully she greeted everyone at the door. 她在門口充滿生氣地向每個人打招呼。
Lifefully the market woke before sunrise. 市集在日出前就活潑地甦醒了。

meaning: 生氣蓬勃；活力
sentences: Lifefulness returned to his face after rest. 休息後，他的臉上恢復了生氣。
Lifefulness of the crowd made the night memorable. 人群的活力讓那個夜晚很難忘。

sentences: The lifeguard rescued the little child from the deep swimming pool. 救生員從深水池中救出了那個小孩。

meaning: 毫無生氣地；死氣沉沉地

meaning: 無生命；缺乏生氣

meaning: 簡短傳記；人生小傳
sentences: Lifelet on the back cover summed him up in six lines. 封底上的簡短小傳用六行字概括了他。
Lifelet gave only the happiest parts of her story. 那篇人生小傳只寫了她故事裡最快樂的部分。

meaning: 栩栩如生的；逼真的
sentences: Lifelike doll startled the baby at first. 那個栩栩如生的娃娃一開始嚇到了嬰兒。
Lifelike face on the statue drew a crowd. 雕像上逼真的臉吸引了人群。

meaning: 逼真度；栩栩如生的特質
sentences: Lifelikeness of the mask made it unsettling. 那副面具的逼真度讓人感到不安。
Lifelikeness matters most in portraits of loved ones. 為所愛之人作肖像時，逼真度最重要。

meaning: 救命索；生命線
sentences: Lifeline kept the climber from falling farther. 救命索讓攀登者沒有再往下墜。
Lifeline for the village is the only bridge. 對那個村子來說，唯一的橋就是生命線。

meaning: 終身的
sentences: She has a lifelong passion for classical music and started playing at three. 她對古典音樂有著終身的熱愛，三歲就開始彈奏了。

meaning: 無期徒刑犯；長期服役者
sentences: Lifer knew every hallway in the prison. 那名無期徒刑犯熟悉監獄裡的每條走道。
Lifer chose to mentor younger inmates. 那名服無期徒刑的人選擇指導較年輕的受刑人。

meaning: 終身收益權
sentences: Liferent let her live in the cottage until death. 終身收益權讓她可以住在那間小屋直到離世。
Liferent protected his right to the income, not the sale. 終身收益權保障的是他的收益權，不是出售權。

meaning: 終身收益權人
sentences: Liferenter collected the rent but owned no title. 終身收益權人收租，卻不持有所有權。
Liferenter had to keep the property in good condition. 終身收益權人必須維持不動產狀況良好。

meaning: 女性終身收益權人
sentences: Liferentrix remained in the house after her husband died. 丈夫過世後，那位女性終身收益權人仍住在屋裡。
Liferentrix could enjoy the land without selling it. 那位女性終身收益權人可以享用土地利益，但不能出售。

meaning: 紫葳屬的多年生開花植物
sentences: Liferoot returns each spring from its underground roots. 紫葳屬多年生植物每年春天從地下根重新生長。
A liferoot plant carried yellow flowers above the meadow grass. 一株紫葳屬植物在草地上方開出黃花。

meaning: 拯救生命的人或事。救生員或其他救援人員。
sentences: My dad loves his job as a surf lifesaver. 我爸爸熱愛衝浪救生員的工作。
Paramedics are not just ordinary workers but lifesavers with a very important job. 護理人員不僅是普通工作人員，也是擔負著非常重要工作的救生員。

meaning: 救生；救命的
sentences: Lifesaving takes strength and quick judgment. 救生需要體力與迅速判斷。
Lifesaving became his purpose after the accident. 那場意外之後，救人性命成了他的志業。

meaning: 充滿活力的；愉快活潑的
sentences: Lifesome tune made everyone tap the table. 充滿活力的曲調讓大家都跟著敲桌子。
Lifesome mood returned after the rain stopped. 雨停後，愉快活潑的氣氛又回來了。

meaning: 活潑地；充滿生氣地
sentences: Lifesomely the children ran across the yard. 孩子們充滿生氣地跑過院子。
Lifesomely she told the story with bright eyes. 她眼神明亮地把故事說得十分活潑。

meaning: 活力；生氣蓬勃
sentences: Lifesomeness of the party faded after midnight. 過了午夜後，聚會的活力漸漸消退。
Lifesomeness in his laugh cheered us all up. 他笑聲中的生氣讓我們都振作起來。

meaning: 生命泉源；活力來源
sentences: Lifespring of her courage was her family. 她勇氣的泉源是家人。
Lifespring can mean the deepest source of hope. 這個詞可以指最深層的希望來源。

meaning: 壽命
sentences: Traveling around the world is a dream of a whole lifetime. 環遊世界是一生的夢想。

meaning: 朝向生命的；有助延生的
sentences: Lifeward choices slowly improved his health. 朝向生命的選擇慢慢改善了他的健康。
Lifeward care focuses on keeping patients alive and stable. 延生照護著重讓病人維持生命與穩定。

meaning: 畢生志業；一生的主要成就
sentences: Lifework took her forty years to finish. 她的畢生志業花了四十年才完成。
Lifework often grows from one stubborn idea. 畢生的工作往往源自一個執著的想法。

meaning: 有生命感的；生動的
sentences: Lifey dog jumped around the kitchen. 那隻很有生命感的狗在廚房裡跳來跳去。
Lifey style made the whole room feel warmer. 生動的風格讓整個房間感覺更溫暖。

meaning: 後進先出
sentences: Lifo moves the newest box out first. 後進先出會先把最新放進去的箱子移出來。
Lifo works well when access is only from the top. 當只能從上方取用時，後進先出很適合。

meaning: 舉起；抬高
sentences: Lift the basket by its two handles. 從籃子的兩個提把把它舉起來。

meaning: 可抬起的；可舉升的
sentences: Liftable table folded flat against the wall. 那張可抬起的桌子可以折平貼在牆邊。
Liftable lid made cleaning much easier. 可掀起的蓋子讓清理容易許多。

meaning: 舉起者；升降裝置
sentences: Lifter at the gym moved the bar with ease. 健身房裡的舉重者輕鬆把槓鈴舉起。
Lifter under the sofa raised it just enough. 沙發底下的升降器把它稍微抬高了一點。

meaning: 抬起；舉升
sentences: Lifting heavy boxes all day hurt my back. 整天搬重箱子的舉升動作讓我背痛。
Lifting the curtain let in cool air. 抬起窗簾讓涼風進來了。

meaning: 無電梯的
sentences: Liftless building was hard for my grandmother. 沒有電梯的大樓對我奶奶很不方便。

meaning: 電梯操作員
sentences: Liftman greeted every rider with the same calm smile. 電梯操作員用同樣沉穩的笑容迎接每位乘客。

meaning: 可結紮的；可綁住的
sentences: Ligable vessel was closed without much bleeding. 那條可結紮的血管被處理後沒有太多出血。
Ligable tissue made the procedure simpler. 可結紮的組織讓處置變得較簡單。

meaning: 韌帶
sentences: He tore a ligament in his ankle during the football match. 他在足球比賽中弄斷了腳踝的韌帶。
Ligaments are strong bands of tissue that connect bones together. 韌帶是連結骨骼的強韌組織帶。

meaning: 韌帶的；與韌帶有關的
sentences: Ligamental pain got worse after the fall. 跌倒後，韌帶相關的疼痛加劇了。
Ligamental support keeps the joint steady. 韌帶性的支撐能讓關節保持穩定。

meaning: 韌帶的；與韌帶有關的
sentences: Ligamentary damage can limit simple movement. 韌帶損傷可能限制基本動作。
Ligamentary strain healed slowly over the winter. 那次韌帶拉傷在整個冬天裡慢慢恢復。

meaning: 韌帶的；像韌帶的
sentences: Ligamentous tissue looked inflamed near the knee. 膝蓋附近的韌帶組織看起來有發炎。
Ligamentous bands held the joint in place. 韌帶樣帶狀組織把關節固定在原位。

meaning: 以韌帶般的方式
sentences: Ligamentously the fibers bound the parts together. 那些纖維以韌帶般的方式把各部分連在一起。
Ligamentously the tissue stretched but did not tear. 那片組織以類似韌帶的狀態被拉伸卻沒有撕裂。

meaning: 韌帶
sentences: Ligamentum in the knee was badly torn. 膝蓋裡的一條韌帶嚴重撕裂。
Ligamentum connects bone to bone. 韌帶會把骨頭和骨頭連接起來。

meaning: 有蓋編籃
sentences: Ligas kept the bread warm on the trip. 那個有蓋編籃在路上保持了麵包的溫度。
Ligas sat by the door filled with fruit. 那個有蓋編籃放在門邊，裡面裝滿水果。

meaning: 結紮；綁紮
sentences: Ligate the vessel before removing the mass. 先把血管結紮，再移除腫塊。
Ligate both ends to stop the bleeding. 把兩端都綁紮起來以止血。

meaning: 結紮

Ligation of the tube is a permanent choice. 管道結紮是一種永久性的選擇。

meaning: 用於放置、固定或綁紮結紮線的器械
sentences: The ligator held the thread while the surgeon tied the knot. 結紮器在外科醫師打結時固定線材。
A ligator helped secure the band around the small vessel. 結紮器幫助把帶子固定在小血管周圍。

meaning: 效忠；臣屬義務

meaning: 水平橫木；橫樑

meaning: 光

meaning: 可點燃的；可照亮的

meaning: 燈船

meaning: 減輕、變亮

meaning: 使變輕之物；淡化劑

Lightener in the paint softened the color. 顏料裡的淡化劑讓顏色變柔和。

meaning: 變輕；減輕；變淡

meaning: 更輕的；更淡的；較明亮的

meaning: 用駁船轉運貨物；駁運費

Lighterful filled the barge almost to the top. 一整駁船的量幾乎把平底船裝滿。

meaning: 駁船夫；駁船經營者
sentences: Lighterman guided the barge through the busy river. 駁船夫駕著平底船穿過繁忙的河道。

meaning: 細體字；非粗體字
sentences: Lightface looks cleaner for long paragraphs. 細體字用在長段落看起來更清爽。

meaning: 充滿光亮的；明亮的

meaning: 明亮；充滿光亮的特質
sentences: Lightfulness changed the mood of the whole room. 明亮感改變了整個房間的氣氛。
Lightfulness came in as the clouds moved away. 雲散開後，光亮感就進來了。

meaning: 燈頭；照明頭

meaning: 頭暈的；昏眩的

meaning: 頭暈地；輕率地
sentences: Lightheadedly, he stood up too fast and grabbed the wall. 他頭暈地一下站太快，只好扶住牆壁。

meaning: 頭暈；昏眩
sentences: Lightheadedness hit me when I got out of bed. 我下床時突然一陣頭暈。
Lightheadedness can come from heat and not enough water. 太熱又喝水不足時可能會頭暈。

meaning: 輕鬆愉快的；無憂無慮的
sentences: Lighthearted jokes made dinner feel easy and fun. 輕鬆的玩笑讓晚餐氣氛自在又愉快。
Lighthearted music drifted out of the cafe. 輕快愉悅的音樂從咖啡館飄了出來。

meaning: 輕鬆愉快地
sentences: Lightheartedly, they teased each other over breakfast. 他們在早餐時輕鬆愉快地互相打趣。
Lightheartedly, she waved off the small mistake. 她輕描淡寫地帶過那個小失誤。

meaning: 輕鬆愉快；無憂無慮
sentences: Lightheartedness returned once the storm passed. 暴風雨過後，輕鬆愉快的心情又回來了。
Lightheartedness in his voice calmed everyone down. 他語氣中的輕快讓大家都放鬆了。

meaning: 燈塔

sentences: The room has very bright and modern lighting. 房間有著非常明亮且現代化的照明。

meaning: 略淡的；稍淺的

meaning: 燈塔守護員；燈船燈務員
sentences: Lightkeeper checked the beacon before nightfall. 燈塔守護員在天黑前檢查了航標燈。
Lightkeeper kept careful notes on the weather and sea. 燈務員仔細記下天氣與海況。

meaning: 無光的；漆黑的
sentences: Lightless hallways made the old house feel colder. 無光的走廊讓老房子顯得更冷清。

meaning: 黑暗；無光狀態
sentences: Lightlessness filled the room after the power cut. 停電後，房間陷入一片黑暗。
