Nora answered lonelily during the short chat. 諾拉在短暫聊天中以一種孤獨的方式回答。

meaning: 孤獨感；因缺少陪伴而生的寂寞。
sentences: loneliness can sting even in a crowded apartment block. 就算住在擁擠公寓裡，孤獨感也一樣會刺人。
Her loneliness eased when letters began to arrive weekly. 每週開始收到信後，她的孤寂感才慢慢緩下來。

meaning: 孤獨
sentences: He felt very lonely after his best friend moved away. 在好友搬走後，他感到非常孤獨。
The old man lives alone but he never feels lonely. 老人獨自生活，但他從不感到寂寞。

meaning: 獨處；單獨的狀態。
sentences: loneness helped the monk keep his attention on prayer. 獨處狀態幫助那位修士把心神放在祈禱上。
His loneness on the island sharpened every sound at night. 島上的獨處感讓夜裡每種聲音都變得更清楚。

meaning: 寂寞的
sentences: He felt very lonesome after his best friend moved to a different city. 最好的朋友搬到另一個城市後，他感到非常寂寞。
She enjoyed a quiet walk along the beach on a lonesome winter afternoon. 她喜歡在一個孤單的（寂靜的）冬日午後在海灘上漫步。

meaning: 以一種孤獨的方式，以一種缺乏陪伴的方式。
sentences: Cyclists moved lonesomely when the light changed. 紅綠燈變換時，騎士以符合一種孤獨的方式移動。
Nora answered lonesomely during the short chat. 諾拉在短暫聊天中以一種孤獨的方式回答。

meaning: 寂寞；孤清的感受。
sentences: lonesomeness settled over the depot after the last train. 末班車開走後，整座車站罩上一股冷清。
That lonesomeness in the plain is why the song feels old. 那首歌之所以顯得蒼老，就是因為它寫出了平原上的孤清。

meaning: 長的
sentences: It was a long and tiring journey across the desert. 那是一段漫長且令人疲憊的沙漠之旅。
She has long dark hair and beautiful brown eyes. 她留著長長的深色頭髮，有一雙漂亮的棕色眼睛。

meaning: 長途電話；打到本地通話區以外的電話。
sentences: A long-distance call to Alaska once cost a small fortune. 從前打一通到阿拉斯加的長途電話要花上一大筆錢。
That long-distance call kept the operator busy for minutes. 那通長途電話讓接線員忙了好幾分鐘。

meaning: 遠視的；亦指有遠見的。
sentences: long-sighted children may squint less at the hills than at books. 遠視的孩子看遠山可能比看書吃力少。
A long-sighted policy saves water before a drought arrives. 有遠見的政策會在旱災來前先把水留住。

meaning: 音樂：中古記譜法中的長音符。
sentences: A longa lasts longer than a breve in medieval notation. 在中古記譜法裡，這個長音符比短音符更長。
One longa in the manuscript has a heavy square stem. 那份手稿裡有個長音符用了粗重的方形筆畫。

meaning: 龍眼；亦指龍眼樹。
sentences: A longan splits to show translucent flesh around one seed. 龍眼剝開後，會露出包著單一種子的半透明果肉。
The longan tree fruited well after the dry spring. 那棵龍眼樹在乾燥春季過後結果很好。

meaning: 罕見：長久忍耐；寬容與克制。
sentences: longanimity kept the judge calm through hours of provocation. 長久的忍耐力讓法官在連番挑釁下仍保持平靜。
Her longanimity spared the apprentice a public rebuke. 她的寬忍讓學徒免於當眾挨罵。

meaning: 罕見：能長久忍耐的；寬容克制的。
sentences: longanimous monks answered insults with silence. 能長久忍讓的修士以沉默回應辱罵。
A longanimous reply cooled the quarrel at once. 一句寬容克制的回覆立刻讓爭吵降了溫。

meaning: 朗加維爾；莎士比亞戲劇中的人物名。
sentences: Kai mentioned Longaville during a family story. 凱在家人聊天中提到了朗加維爾。
Nora read about Longaville before her trip. 諾拉出發前讀到了朗加維爾。

meaning: 形容喙長的；用於鳥獸。
sentences: A longbeak curlew can reach prey deep in wet sand. 長喙的杓鷸能探到濕沙深處的獵物。
That longbeak profile helps separate the bird from gulls. 那種長喙外形有助於把這種鳥和海鷗分開。

meaning: 留長鬍子的人；亦可詩意地指老者。
sentences: A longbeard in the tavern spoke as if every war were yesterday. 酒館裡那位長鬍子老人說起往事，像每場戰爭都還在昨天。
One longbeard from the guild still remembered hand-forged nails. 公會裡有位老前輩還記得手工打鐵釘的年代。

meaning: 長艇；尤指大船上的長形划艇。
sentences: A longboat carried the anchor crew out through the surf. 長艇載著拋錨人員穿過浪區。
One longboat was lowered for the shore landing. 有一艘長艇被放下，準備靠岸登陸。

meaning: 長弓；尤指中世紀英格蘭式長弓。
sentences: A longbow stores power in a tall, single stave. 長弓把力量蓄在一根高而整的弓身裡。
That longbow needed years of practice before it shot true. 那張長弓要練上好多年，箭路才會穩。

meaning: 長幅平紋棉布。
sentences: longcloth was packed in bolts for the Calcutta trade. 那種長幅平紋棉布曾成匹裝箱運往加爾各答交易。
Fine longcloth breathes better than heavier calico. 細緻的長幅平紋棉布比厚斜紋棉更透氣。

meaning: 馴馬用長繩；使馬繞圈操練的牽繩。
sentences: A longe let the mare circle the trainer at a trot. 馴馬長繩讓母馬繞著訓練者小跑成圈。
That longe tangled because the handler let it drag. 那條馴馬長繩會打結，是因為牽的人讓它拖在地上。

meaning: 美國西部用語：未烙印的小牛。
sentences: A longear in western ranch talk is an unbranded calf. 在美國西部牧場話裡，這個詞指還沒打烙印的小牛。
One longear slipped under the fence before roundup day. 有頭未烙印的小牛在圍捕前先鑽過了欄柵。

meaning: long 的比較級；較長的，較久的。
sentences: A longer bridge solved the flood problem at the ford. 較長的橋把渡口逢洪水就中斷的問題解掉了。
The longer route saved fuel by avoiding the steep grade. 較長的那條路反而因避開陡坡而更省油。

meaning: 罕見／古語：長壽的；長命的。
sentences: A longeval oak can outlast several village churches. 長壽的橡樹可能比好幾代村中教堂活得還久。
Such longeval tortoises make human dynasties seem brief. 這麼長壽的陸龜，會讓人類王朝都顯得短暫。

meaning: 長壽
sentences: Eating a healthy diet and exercising regularly are essential for longevity. 健康飲食和規律運動對長壽至關重要。
The study focused on the longevity of people living in remote mountain villages. 該研究聚焦於偏遠山村居民的壽命。

meaning: 罕見：長壽的；存續很久的。
sentences: A longevous cedar kept throwing shade after two centuries. 兩百年後，那株長壽的雪松仍舊投下樹蔭。
That longevous custom survived three changes of regime. 那個延續已久的老習俗熬過了三次政權更替。

meaning: 長久感受到的；期待已久的。
sentences: A longfelt grievance finally surfaced in the hearing. 那樁積壓已久的委屈終於在聽證時浮上檯面。
Their longfelt need was for a clinic, not a statue. 他們長久盼望的是診所，不是雕像。

meaning: 細長鱸魚的頸蛇科的任何成員。
sentences: longfin refers to a fish with unusually long fins. 細長鱸魚的頸蛇科的任何成員。
A specialist uses longfin for a fish with unusually long fins. 細長鱸魚的頸蛇科的任何成員。

meaning: 罕見／方言：冗長的；拖得很長的。
sentences: A longful sermon emptied the benches by noon. 冗長的講道還沒到中午就把長椅坐空了。
That longful lawsuit drained the farm for years. 那場拖得很長的官司讓農場耗了好幾年。

That longhair taste favored quartets over marching songs. 那種偏文藝高雅的趣味，比起進行曲更偏愛四重奏。

His longheadedness kept the firm out of the property bubble. 他的深謀遠慮讓公司躲過了房地產泡沫。

meaning: 長角牛，尤指美國西南部的長角牛。
sentences: A longhorn wandered across the scrub with horns six feet wide. 一頭長角牛穿過灌木地，雙角張開將近六呎。
That longhorn breed came north with Spanish stock. 這種長角牛品系是隨著西班牙牛群北上的。

meaning: 動物學：長尾的。
sentences: A longicaudal lizard uses its tail for balance in leaps. 長尾蜥蜴跳躍時會用尾巴維持平衡。
The longicaudal form helps separate this bird from its short-tailed kin. 長尾型態有助於把這種鳥和短尾近親區分開。

meaning: 動物學：長尾的。
sentences: A longicaudate specimen stood out in the museum case. 那件長尾標本在博物館展示櫃裡特別顯眼。
The longicaudate morph is named for its extended tail. 這種長尾型正是因為尾部特別延長而得名。

sentences: A longicone shell tapers slowly from chamber to chamber. 這種細長圓錐殼會一室一室緩慢收尖。
The fossil longicone lay straight in the limestone slab. 那枚細長圓錐殼化石直直躺在石灰岩板裡。

meaning: 長角甲蟲的一種，以前是長角甲蟲的分類昆蟲群。

Mina asked how longicorn might affect the body. 美娜問長角甲蟲的一種可能如何影響身體。

meaning: 舊分類名：長角甲蟲類，今大致相當於角天牛科。
sentences: Longicornia was once a formal name for long-horned beetles. 這個舊分類名曾正式指稱長角甲蟲類。
In Longicornia, the striking feature is the very long antennae. 這一舊群最醒目的特徵就是極長的觸角。

meaning: 幾何／罕見：長邊的；呈狹長平行四邊形狀的。
sentences: A longilateral court made the ball stay in play longer. 狹長的球場讓球更不容易很快出界。
That longilateral plot was too narrow for a square house. 那塊長邊地太狹長，不適合蓋方正的房子。

meaning: 罕見／廢語：舌長的。
sentences: A longilingual saint in legend could lick his own nose. 傳說裡那位聖人舌頭長得能舔到自己的鼻尖。
The longilingual epithet is obsolete and purely descriptive. 這個舊形容詞已經廢用，意思只是描述舌頭很長。

meaning: 古語：冗長饒舌的言談；長篇空話。
sentences: longiloquence drowned the witness's simple answer. 冗長空話淹沒了證人原本簡單的回答。
longiloquence let the senator take ten minutes to dodge the question. 那位參議員靠冗長說辭拖了十分鐘，仍避開問題。

meaning: 古語：手很長的；前肢特長的。
sentences: longimanous apes swing with unusually extended arms. 前肢特長的猿類會用異常修長的手臂擺盪。
Among longimanous mammals, reach matters more than speed. 在前肢特長的哺乳動物中，臂展比速度更重要。

meaning: 專門用語：關於長度或距離測量的。
sentences: longimetric data from the survey fixed the valley's width. 這次測量取得的長度數據確定了山谷的寬度。
With longimetric methods, the engineer compared both spans precisely. 藉由長度測量方法，工程師精確比較了兩段跨距。

meaning: 專門用語：長度或距離的測量。
sentences: longimetry guided the masons when they reset the broken arch. 石匠重砌斷裂拱門時，要靠長度測量來定位。
longimetry let the mapmaker check the road against a baseline. 製圖員藉由長度測量把道路和基線互相比對。

meaning: 渴望，尤指對遙遠或難得之物的深切想望。
sentences: longing filled her letters from the polar station. 她從極地站寄回的信裡滿是思念與渴望。
longing kept him imagining the harbor of his childhood. 深切的想望讓他一直想像著童年時的港口。

meaning: 帶著渴望、渴望、渴望。
sentences: Cyclists moved longingly when the light changed. 紅綠燈變換時，騎士以符合帶著渴望、渴望、渴望的方式移動。
Nora answered longingly during the short chat. 諾拉在短暫聊天中以帶著渴望、渴望、渴望的方式回答。

meaning: 古語：渴望；想望的狀態。
sentences: longingness sharpened whenever the chapel bells began at dusk. 每當黃昏教堂鐘聲響起，那份想望就更強烈。
Her longingness for news made every footstep on the stairs matter. 她急切盼望消息，樓梯上的每一步聲都變得重要。

meaning: 朗吉努斯的；關於《論崇高》或其崇高理論的。
sentences: Longinian critics value language that lifts the mind above the ordinary. 朗吉努斯傳統的批評家重視能把心靈提升到日常之上的語言。
In Longinian aesthetics, sublimity can outweigh technical polish. 在朗吉努斯式美學裡，崇高感有時比技法修飾更重要。

meaning: 古語：遙遠；久遠的距離感。
sentences: longinquity kept the mountain fires faint even at night. 由於距離遙遠，那些山火即使在夜裡也只顯得微弱。
longinquity made the island seem detached from every trade route. 遙遠的距離感讓那座島看來像是脫離了所有商路。

meaning: 動物學：長翼的；具細長飛羽的。
sentences: longipennate seabirds skimmed the swells without a single flap. 長翼海鳥掠過浪峰時幾乎不必振翅。
A longipennate form helps the bird travel far offshore. 長翼體型有助於那種鳥飛到很遠的外海。

meaning: 屬於或屬於前長翅目（Longipennes）的各種長翅鳥類
sentences: The longipennine birds glided effortlessly over the ocean for hours. 這些長翅鳥在海洋上空輕鬆地滑翔了數小時。
Sailors often spotted longipennine species following the ship across the Atlantic. 水手們經常看到長翅物種跟隨著船隻橫跨大西洋。

meaning: 動物學：長喙的；亦指長吻類的。
sentences: longirostral waders probed deep mud for buried worms. 長喙涉禽把喙伸進深泥裡找埋著的蠕蟲。
The longirostral skull belongs to a crocodilian with a narrow snout. 這具長吻型頭骨屬於一種吻部狹長的鱷類。

meaning: 動物學：長喙的；長吻的。
sentences: longirostrate birds can reach insects hidden inside bark. 長喙鳥能夠探到樹皮內藏著的昆蟲。
A longirostrate snout lets the fish pick prey from crevices. 長吻讓那種魚能從縫隙裡啄取獵物。

meaning: 動物學：長顎的；長吻的，尤指鱷類。

sentences: Luminator lights above the bus sign flickered again. 公車站牌上方的照明裝置又閃了。
Luminator units keep the display easy to read at night. 發光裝置讓顯示內容在夜裡也容易看清。

meaning: 發冷光；發光

meaning: 冷光；發光現象

Luminescence on the beach surprised everyone at night. 夜裡海灘上的發光現象讓大家都很驚訝。

meaning: 發冷光的；發光的
sentences: Luminescent waves rolled in under the moon. 發光的海浪在月光下拍上岸。
Luminescent stickers glowed on the bedroom ceiling. 發光貼紙在臥室天花板上亮了起來。

meaning: 發光的；傳光的
sentences: Luminiferous threads ran through the costume at night. 夜裡，那套服裝上布滿了發光細線。

meaning: 發光體；照明物
sentences: Luminificent objects hung above the dance floor. 發光物懸掛在舞池上方。
Luminificent pieces turned the plain room festive. 那些照明物讓原本平淡的房間熱鬧起來。

meaning: 光效主義
sentences: Luminism often favors calm water and quiet skies. 光效主義常偏愛平靜水面與安靜天空。
Luminism gave the evening scene a still beauty. 光效主義讓傍晚景色多了一種靜止的美。

meaning: 光效派畫家；光效主義者
sentences: Luminist artists often chase subtle changes in light. 光效派畫家常追逐細微的光線變化。

meaning: 光學研究者；光線研究者
sentences: Luminologist teams study how light affects sleep. 光線研究者會研究光如何影響睡眠。
Luminologist advice helped us choose softer bulbs. 光線研究者的建議幫我們選了較柔和的燈泡。

meaning: 光度計
sentences: Luminometer readings showed the lamp was growing dim. 光度計讀數顯示那盞燈越來越暗。
Luminometer checks help the shop keep even lighting. 光度計檢查能幫店裡維持均勻照明。

meaning: 發光度；明亮度
sentences: Luminosity from the moon made the road easy to see. 月亮的明亮度讓路面很清楚。
Luminosity changed as clouds crossed the sky. 雲飄過天空時，明亮度也跟著改變。

meaning: 發光的；明亮的
sentences: Luminous stars filled the sky above the lake. 明亮的星星布滿湖上的天空。
Luminous fabric made her jacket easy to spot. 發亮的布料讓她的外套很容易被看見。

meaning: 明亮地；發光地
sentences: Luminously painted walls made the small room feel open. 牆面明亮地上色後，小房間感覺更開闊。
Luminously glowing signs led us through the station. 發亮地閃著的標誌帶我們穿過車站。

sentences: Luminousness in her eyes returned after she rested. 她休息後，眼神裡的明亮感回來了。

meaning: 笨拙的人；傻大個
sentences: Lummox that he is, Ben knocked over the chair again. 班這個笨手笨腳的傢伙又把椅子撞倒了。
Lummox friends can still be kind and loyal. 笨拙的朋友也可以很善良又講義氣。

Lummy, you cleaned the whole room already. 天啊，你已經把整個房間整理好了。

meaning: 塊、腫塊
sentences: She found a small hard lump on her arm and decided to see a doctor. 她在手臂上發現了一個堅硬的小腫塊，決定去看醫生。

meaning: 裝卸工
sentences: Lumper crews unloaded the truck before sunrise. 裝卸工人在日出前就把卡車卸完了。
Lumper fees can surprise small drivers. 裝卸工費用有時會讓小型貨運司機很意外。

sentences: Lumpet shoes made every step feel heavy. 厚重的鞋子讓每一步都很沉。
Lumpet furniture crowded the tiny room. 粗笨的家具把小房間擠得很滿。

meaning: 圓鰭魚
sentences: Lumpfish eggs are often sold as a cheaper roe. 圓鰭魚的魚卵常被當成較便宜的魚子販售。
Lumpfish look odd but can be useful in fish farms. 圓鰭魚外型古怪，但在養魚場裡可能很有用。

meaning: 塊狀感；凹凸不平

meaning: 笨重的；沉重的
sentences: Lumping bags slowed us on the stairs. 笨重的袋子讓我們上樓變慢。

meaning: 笨重地；遲緩地
sentences: Lumpingly he crossed the room with both boxes. 他笨重地抱著兩個箱子穿過房間。

meaning: 笨拙的；遲鈍的
sentences: Lumpish dancing made everyone laugh in a friendly way. 他那笨拙的舞步讓大家善意地笑了。

meaning: 笨拙地；遲鈍地

meaning: 笨拙；遲鈍
sentences: Lumpishness made his first dance look awkward. 他的笨拙讓第一支舞看起來很不自然。

meaning: 笨拙或愚鈍的人
sentences: Lumpkin dropped his keys again at the door. 那個笨手笨腳的人又在門口把鑰匙掉了。
Lumpkin never notices the joke until much later. 那個愚鈍的人總是過很久才聽懂玩笑。

meaning: 把貨物分批裝卸的碼頭工人
sentences: Lumpman carried the sacks onto the cart before noon. 裝卸工在中午前把麻袋搬上推車。
Lumpman asked for gloves before moving the heavy crates. 搬運工在移動重箱前先要了手套。

meaning: 圓鰭魚科的海魚，腹面有吸附用的腹鰭盤。
sentences: A lumpsucker uses its pelvic disc to cling to rocks. 圓鰭魚用腹鰭盤吸附在岩石上。
The young lumpsucker had a rounded body and thick skin. 幼年圓鰭魚身體圓厚，皮膚也很厚。

meaning: 有塊狀物的；凹凸不平的
sentences: Lumpy gravy ruined the mashed potatoes tonight. 結塊的肉汁今晚把馬鈴薯泥弄得不好吃。
Lumpy ground made my bike ride slow and shaky. 凹凸不平的地面讓我騎車又慢又晃。

meaning: 月神蛾屬的蛾，通常指月神蛾。
sentences: A luna has long tails on its pale green hindwings. 月神蛾的淡綠色後翅有長尾突。
The luna emerges at night and does not feed as an adult. 月神蛾在夜間羽化，成蟲階段不進食。

meaning: 瘋狂；極愚蠢的行為
sentences: Lunacy is driving to the beach in that storm. 在那種暴風雨裡開車去海邊簡直是瘋狂。

meaning: 夢遊
sentences: Lunambulism scared his family when he opened the front door asleep. 他睡著時去開大門，讓家人很害怕。
Lunambulism can make a quiet night suddenly dangerous. 夢遊可能讓平靜的夜晚突然變得危險。

meaning: 月亮的
sentences: The lunar calendar is used to determine the date of many traditional festivals. 陰曆（月曆）被用來確定許多傳統節日的日期。

sentences: Lunare light gave the yard a pale silver glow. 月色讓院子泛著淡淡銀光。

meaning: 銀扇草屬，十字花科的開花植物。
sentences: Lunaria is a flowering plant genus with translucent seed pods. 銀扇草屬的開花植物會結出半透明莢果。

meaning: 月球居民；想像中的月球人
sentences: Lunarian waved from the comic page in a shiny suit. 那個月球人穿著發亮的衣服，從漫畫頁上向人揮手。
Lunarian stories kept the kids awake and laughing. 關於月球居民的故事讓孩子們笑到睡不著。

meaning: 相信月亮會影響天氣的人
sentences: Lunarist blamed the full moon for the coming rain. 那位相信月亮影響天氣的人把即將下雨怪到滿月頭上。
Lunarist at the market swore tomorrow would be windy. 市場裡那位月象信徒堅稱明天會刮風。

meaning: 月球運行儀
sentences: Lunarium on the shelf showed the moon circling Earth. 架上的月球運行儀展示了月亮繞著地球轉。
Lunarium helped my brother picture why the moon looks different each week. 那個月球模型幫我弟理解為什麼月亮每週看起來都不一樣。

meaning: 月亮的；按月計算的
sentences: Lunary tales often sound softer at night. 和月亮有關的故事在夜裡常顯得更柔和。

meaning: 新月形的
sentences: Lunate cookies lined the tray in neat rows. 新月形餅乾整齊排在烤盤上。
Lunate marks appeared on the wet window after the stickers fell off. 貼紙掉下後，濕窗上留下了新月形痕跡。

meaning: 一種小型蛤類

meaning: 呈新月狀地

Lunately bent leaves framed the lamp in the corner. 彎成月牙的葉子圍著角落那盞燈。

meaning: 月亮的；農曆的

meaning: 瘋狂地；荒唐地
sentences: Lunatically fast music shook the thin walls all night. 快得近乎瘋狂的音樂整晚震著薄牆。

meaning: 朔望月；一個月相週期
sentences: Lunation lasts about four weeks from new moon to new moon. 一個月相週期從新月到下一次新月，大約四週。

sentences: Lunatize a calm crowd with that rumor, and chaos will follow. 用那則謠言讓平靜的人群發狂，接著就會出亂子。

meaning: 月骨
sentences: Lunatum pain made her grip on the mug weak. 月骨疼痛讓她拿杯子的手變得沒力。

meaning: 隆達語
sentences: Lunda is spoken in parts of central Africa. 隆達語通行於中非部分地區。

meaning: 與倫敦週一集會有關的場所或文集
sentences: Lundinarium sat dusty in the corner of the old archive room. 那本與週一集會有關的舊冊子積灰放在檔案室角落。

meaning: 女洗衣工
sentences: Lundress hung sheets across the yard before sunrise. 女洗衣工在日出前把床單晾滿院子。
Lundress scrubbed the cuffs until her hands turned red. 女洗衣工把袖口刷到雙手都發紅了。

meaning: 鼻煙的一種
sentences: Lundyfoot left a sharp smell in his coat pocket. 那種鼻煙在他的外套口袋裡留下刺鼻氣味。

meaning: 新月形；弓形區域

meaning: 呂內爾甜麝香葡萄酒

sentences: Lunes curved edge was easy to trace with a finger. 那個月牙形區域的彎邊很容易用手指描出來。

meaning: 半月形窗；半月形結構
sentences: Lunette above the door let in a soft strip of light. 門上的半月窗讓一道柔光照了進來。
Lunette at the old church was painted pale blue. 老教堂上的半月形窗框被漆成淡藍色。

meaning: 肺
sentences: Smoking is extremely harmful to your lungs and overall health. 吸菸對妳的肺部與整體健康極其有害。

meaning: 有某種肺的；具肺的
sentences: Lunged creatures can survive where gill-only ones cannot. 有肺的生物能在只有鰓不行的地方活下來。

meaning: 像猛衝般的；突進的

meaning: 猛衝的人；撲擊者
sentences: Lunger at the bus door nearly knocked me sideways. 公車門口那個硬衝的人差點把我撞歪。

meaning: 肺魚
sentences: Lungfish rose to the surface and gulped air. 肺魚浮到水面吸了一口氣。
Lungfish can live through dry times in wet mud. 肺魚能在乾旱時期躲在濕泥裡活下來。

meaning: 肺草花

sentences: Lungful of cold air woke me faster than coffee. 一大口冷空氣讓我比喝咖啡還快清醒。

meaning: 圍腰布
sentences: Lungi felt cool and light in the summer heat. 那件圍腰布在夏天穿起來又涼又輕。

meaning: 海鳩

meaning: 瘦長又懶散的人

meaning: 無肺的
sentences: Lungless animals must breathe through skin or gills. 沒有肺的動物必須靠皮膚或鰓呼吸。

meaning: 灰白斑駁的
sentences: Lyard patches showed clearly on the old horse. 那匹老馬身上的灰白斑點很明顯。
Lyard coat made the pony easy to spot. 灰白斑駁的毛色讓那匹小馬很容易被看見。

meaning: 利亞斯，法國地名
sentences: Lyas sits in southern France among quiet hills. 利亞斯位在法國南部安靜的丘陵之間。
Lyas looked peaceful in the travel photos. 旅遊照片裡的利亞斯看起來很平靜。

meaning: 灰蝶屬，灰蝶科中的蝴蝶分類屬。
sentences: Lycaena is a genus of small copper-colored butterflies. 這個名稱是小型銅色蝴蝶的分類屬。
Lycaena larvae often feed on dock and sorrel leaves. 這個名稱幼蟲常取食酸模與羊蹄葉片。

meaning: 灰蝶科的蝴蝶；灰蝶類。
sentences: A lycaenid is a small butterfly in the family of blues and coppers. 灰蝶類是藍灰蝶與銅灰蝶科中的小型蝴蝶。
The lycaenid rested with its wings closed over a flower. 灰蝶停在花上時把翅膀合起來。

sentences: Lycaenidae is the butterfly family of blues, coppers, and hairstreaks. 灰蝶科包含藍灰蝶、銅灰蝶與線灰蝶。
Lycaenidae caterpillars often interact with ants. 灰蝶科毛毛蟲常與螞蟻互動。

meaning: 狼人；自認會變狼的人
sentences: Lycanthrope ran through the movie forest at midnight. 電影裡的狼人半夜跑過森林。
Lycanthrope frightened the children in the old tale. 古老故事裡的狼人嚇到了孩子們。

meaning: 變狼妄想；狼人妄想症
sentences: Lycanthropia made him believe his body was changing. 變狼妄想讓他相信自己的身體正在改變。
Lycanthropia is a rare form of delusion. 這是一種罕見的妄想型態。

meaning: 狼人的；變狼妄想的
sentences: Lycanthropic stories kept us awake at camp. 跟狼人有關的故事讓我們在營地裡睡不著。
Lycanthropic fear spread after the strange howling. 奇怪的嚎叫後，大家心裡蔓延著對狼人的恐懼。

meaning: 狼人；相信自己會變狼的人
sentences: Lycanthropist in the novel hid during every full moon. 小說裡那位自認會變狼的人每逢滿月都躲起來。
Lycanthropist scared the village in the bedtime story. 睡前故事裡的狼人把村莊嚇壞了。

meaning: 使變成狼人；使產生變狼妄想
sentences: Lycanthropize the hero, and the story turns dark fast. 若讓主角變成狼人，故事很快就會轉黑暗。
Lycanthropize him in the legend, and children gasp. 若在傳說裡讓他變成狼人，孩子們就會倒吸一口氣。

meaning: 狼化的；像狼人的
sentences: Lycanthropous features gave the mask a creepy look. 狼人般的特徵讓那個面具有點可怕。
Lycanthropous dreams troubled him for weeks. 像變成狼人的夢困擾了他好幾週。

meaning: 變狼妄想；狼人化
sentences: Lycanthropy appears in both myths and medicine. 變狼妄想這件事同時出現在神話與醫學裡。
Lycanthropy made the old movie strangely sad. 那部老電影裡的狼人化情節帶著一種奇怪的悲傷。

meaning: 與中學或中等教育有關的（罕見）。
sentences: The lyceal program combines laboratory work with Latin and Greek. 中學教育課程把實驗室作業與拉丁文、希臘文結合起來。
A lyceal curriculum prepares older pupils for advanced study. 中學課程為年長學生進階學習作準備。

meaning: 供講座、閱讀、表演或音樂會使用的公共場所。
sentences: The town lyceum hosts a chamber concert on Friday evening. 城鎮公共講堂週五晚上舉辦室內樂音樂會。
Residents gathered at the lyceum to hear a lecture on astronomy. 居民聚集在公共講堂聆聽天文講座。

meaning: 荔枝
sentences: Lychee is a sweet and refreshing tropical fruit. 荔枝是一種甜美清爽的熱帶水果。
She bought a bowl of fresh lychees from the market. 她在市場買了一碗新鮮的荔枝。

meaning: 希臘東正教守夜禮中的晚禱部分。

sentences: Lychnis is a flowering plant genus in the pink family. 剪秋羅屬是石竹科的開花植物屬。
Lychnis flowers often have vividly colored petals. 剪秋羅屬植物的花瓣通常色彩鮮明。

meaning: 利用燈或蠟燭火焰占卜的形式（罕見）。
sentences: Traditional lychnomancy interprets movements in a candle flame as signs. 傳統燭火占卜把火焰動勢解讀為徵兆。
The novel depicts lychnomancy beside a single oil lamp. 那部小說描寫有人在一盞油燈旁進行燈火占卜。

meaning: 教堂低處的側窗（建築史、古語）。
sentences: The medieval church has a lychnoscope near the floor of the nave. 那座中世紀教堂的中殿近地面處有一扇低側窗。
A lychnoscope once let people outside glimpse the altar area. 低側窗過去讓外面的人得以窺見祭壇區域。

meaning: 與利用光線觀察內部構造的儀器有關的。
sentences: Doctors explained lychnoscopic in plain language. 醫師用簡單的話解釋了與利用光線觀察內部構造的儀器有關的。
Mina asked how lychnoscopic might affect the body. 美娜問與利用光線觀察內部構造的儀器有關的可能如何影響身體。

sentences: Archaeologists decoded Lycian inscriptions on the tomb. 考古學家解讀了墓上的利西亞文銘文。
Visitors studied Lycian coins in the museum. 參觀者在博物館研究利西亞錢幣。

meaning: 紅螢科（Lycidae）的網翅甲蟲，通常身體細長、翅鞘具隆脊網紋。
sentences: Under bark, a lycid emerged from the damp wood. 樹皮下，一隻網翅甲蟲從潮濕木頭中爬出。
Bright markings helped identify the lycid. 鮮明斑紋有助於辨認這隻紅螢科甲蟲。

Lycidae adults have soft wing covers with a netlike texture. 網翅螢科成蟲的鞘翅柔軟且呈網狀質地。

sentences: Kai mentioned Lycium during a family story. 凱在家人聊天中提到了雅典附近的蘭心學院(Lyceum)。

meaning: 蛇鱈屬，北方海域的蛇鱈科魚類分類屬。
sentences: Lycodes is a genus of eel-like fishes from northern seas. 蛇鱈屬是北方海域鰻形魚類的分類屬。
Lycodes species live on cold ocean floors. 蛇鱈屬魚類生活在寒冷海底。

meaning: 蛇鱈科，北方海域鰻形魚類的一科。
sentences: Lycodidae is a family of eel-like marine fishes. 蛇鱈科是鰻形海魚的一科。
Lycodidae bodies taper toward the tail and lack pelvic fins. 蛇鱈科魚體向尾部變細，且沒有腹鰭。

meaning: 似石松的；形態或分枝方式近似石松植物的。
sentences: Botanists described the stem as lycodoid. 植物學家形容這根莖的形態似石松。
Its lycodoid branches spread along the rock. 它那似石松的枝條沿著岩石伸展。

meaning: 茄紅素；存在於番茄、西瓜等紅色果實中的紅色類胡蘿蔔素。
sentences: Cooking tomatoes can increase lycopene availability. 烹煮番茄可能提高茄紅素的可利用率。
Nutrition labels listed lycopene among the pigments. 營養標示把茄紅素列為其中一種色素。

meaning: 馬勃科的舊稱或異名。
sentences: Lycoperdaceae is an older name associated with the puffball family. 這個名稱是馬勃科的舊稱。
Lycoperdaceae references appear in older fungal classifications. 這個名稱出現在較早的真菌分類中。

meaning: 馬勃科的；與馬勃科真菌有關的。
sentences: Mycologists recorded a lycoperdaceous fruiting body. 真菌學家記錄了一個馬勃科的子實體。
The lycoperdaceous fungus released brown spores. 那種馬勃科真菌釋放出棕色孢子。

meaning: 馬勃類真菌的舊分類目。
sentences: Lycoperdales was an order for puffball-like fungi. 這個名稱是馬勃類真菌的舊分類目。
Lycoperdales fungi release brown spores from mature fruiting bodies. 這個名稱真菌成熟子實體會釋放棕色孢子。

meaning: 似馬勃的；外形或構造近似馬勃菌的。
sentences: A lycoperdoid sac split open at maturity. 一個似馬勃的囊在成熟時裂開。
The fossil showed a lycoperdoid outline. 這塊化石呈現似馬勃的輪廓。

meaning: 馬勃屬，形成粉狀孢子雲的真菌分類屬。
sentences: Lycoperdon is a genus of puffballs that release dusty spores. 馬勃屬是真菌成熟後會釋放粉狀孢子的分類屬。
Lycoperdon fruiting bodies split open when the spores mature. 馬勃屬子實體的孢子成熟時會裂開。

meaning: 馬勃的通用名，也可指馬勃屬真菌。
sentences: A lycoperdon is a puffball fungus with a spore-filled interior. 這個名稱是內部充滿孢子的馬勃真菌。
The lycoperdon puffed out spores when a raindrop struck it. 馬勃被雨滴打中時噴出孢子。

meaning: 番茄屬的舊分類名稱，現多併入茄屬。
sentences: Lycopersicon is an older genus name for tomatoes and close relatives. 這個名稱是番茄及近親的舊分類屬名。
Lycopersicon appears in older botanical books on tomato classification. 這個名稱出現在較早的番茄植物分類書籍中。

meaning: （歷史用語）由美洲地笠草製成的樹脂，昔日曾作內服止血劑；勿與茄紅素混淆。
sentences: An old pharmacopoeia prescribed lycopin for internal bleeding. 一本古藥典曾開立美洲地笠草樹脂治療內出血。
The apothecary stored lycopin in a sealed vial. 藥劑師把那種美洲地笠草樹脂存放在密封小瓶裡。

meaning: 石松類植物，具有孢子穗的維管植物。
sentences: A lycopod is a club moss with narrow leaves and spore cones. 石松是葉片狹窄並有孢子穗的石松類植物。
The lycopod spread low across the damp forest floor. 石松沿著潮濕森林地表低矮蔓延。

sentences: Lycopode is the fine yellow spore powder of club mosses. 石松粉是石松孢子形成的細黃色粉末。
Lycopode was once used to make a brief flash in stage effects. 石松粉曾用於舞台效果中製造短暫閃光。

meaning: 石松科，包含石松等植物。
sentences: Lycopodiaceae is the club-moss family of spore-bearing plants. 石松科是產生孢子的石松類植物科。
Lycopodiaceae species have creeping stems and tiny leaves. 石松科植物有匍匐莖與細小葉片。

meaning: 石松科石松科的或與之相關的。
sentences: Lycopodiaceous mosses are commonly found in the damp areas of the forest. 石松科的苔蘚常見於森林中潮濕的區域。
The students collected a lycopodiaceous specimen for their biology lab. 學生們為生物實驗課收集了一個石松科的樣本。

meaning: 石松目，石松類植物的分類目。
sentences: Lycopodiales is an order of ancient-looking club mosses. 石松目是外形古老的石松類植物分類目。
Lycopodiales plants reproduce with spores rather than seeds. 石松目植物以孢子繁殖而非種子。

meaning: 石松屬，石松科植物的分類屬。
sentences: Lycopodium is a club-moss genus with upright spore stalks. 石松屬是具有直立孢子柄的石松分類屬。
Lycopodium spores form a pale powder beneath the cones. 石松屬的孢子在孢子穗下形成淡色粉末。

meaning: 石松綱；以石松類為主的植物分類群。
sentences: Doctors explained Lycopsida in plain language. 醫師用簡單的話解釋了石松綱。
Mina asked how Lycopsida might affect the body. 美娜問石松綱可能如何影響身體。

meaning: 已滅絕南美後獸類的分類屬。
sentences: Lycopsis is an extinct South American metatherian genus. 這個名稱是已滅絕的南美後獸類分類屬。
Lycopsis fossils show a predator with enlarged canine teeth. 這個名稱化石顯示這種掠食者有放大的犬齒。

meaning: 地筍屬，唇形科的多年生草本植物分類屬。
sentences: Lycopus is a mint-family genus of wetland herbs. 地筍屬是唇形科的濕地草本分類屬。
Lycopus leaves grow in opposite pairs along square stems. 地筍屬葉片成對生在方形莖的兩側。

meaning: 石蒜科植物中的有毒生物鹼，可抑制蛋白質合成。
sentences: Lycorine is a toxic alkaloid found in several amaryllis-family plants. 石蒜鹼是數種石蒜科植物中的有毒生物鹼。
Lycorine can inhibit protein synthesis in exposed cells. 石蒜鹼會抑制暴露細胞的蛋白質合成。

meaning: 狼蛛屬，狼蛛科中多種地棲蜘蛛的分類屬。
sentences: Lycosa is a genus of ground-running wolf spiders. 這個名稱是在地面奔跑的狼蛛分類屬。
Lycosa hunts without a web and relies on sharp vision. 這個名稱不結網捕獵，而是依靠敏銳視力。

meaning: 狼蛛科的蜘蛛；狼蛛類。
sentences: A lycosid is a wolf spider that hunts actively on the ground. 狼蛛類是會在地面主動捕獵的蜘蛛。
The lycosid carried its egg sac attached to the abdomen. 狼蛛把卵囊附在腹部上攜帶。

meaning: 狼蛛科，蜘蛛目中會奔跑捕獵的一科。
sentences: Lycosidae is the spider family known as wolf spiders. 狼蛛科是俗稱狼蛛的蜘蛛科。
Lycosidae females carry their young on their backs. 狼蛛科雌蛛會把幼蛛背在身上。

meaning: 粉蠹蟲科的甲蟲。
sentences: A lyctid is a small wood-boring beetle. 粉蠹蟲是會蛀食木材的小型甲蟲。
Lyctid larvae tunnel through starch-rich hardwood. 粉蠹蟲幼蟲會鑽入富含澱粉的硬木。

meaning: 粉蠹蟲科，鞘翅目中蛀食木材的一科。
sentences: Lyctidae is the family of powderpost beetles. 粉蠹蟲科是粉蠹甲蟲的分類科。
Lyctidae damage appears as fine powder around small exit holes. 粉蠹蟲科造成的木材損害會在小孔旁出現細粉。

meaning: 克里特島最重要的城市之一。
sentences: Kai mentioned Lyctus during a family story. 凱在家人聊天中提到了克里特島最重要的城市之一。
Nora read about Lyctus before her trip. 諾拉出發前讀到了克里特島最重要的城市之一。

meaning: 男性名，普勞圖斯戲劇中的角色。
sentences: Kai mentioned Lycus during a family story. 凱在家人聊天中提到了男性名。
Nora read about Lycus before her trip. 諾拉出發前讀到了男性名。

meaning: 利迪炸藥；以苦味酸為主要成分的早期高爆炸藥。
sentences: The artillery shell contained lyddite. 那枚砲彈裝有利迪炸藥。
Military engineers tested lyddite before the war. 軍事工程師在戰前測試利迪炸藥。

sentences: Kai mentioned Lydia during a family story. 凱在家人聊天中提到了莉迪亞（聖經人物）。
Nora read about Lydia before her trip. 諾拉出發前讀到了莉迪亞（聖經人物）。

meaning: 呂底亞的；與古代呂底亞、其人民、語言或文化有關的。
sentences: The exhibit displayed Lydian gold coins. 展覽展示了呂底亞金幣。
Scholars compared Lydian with neighboring languages. 學者比較了呂底亞語與鄰近語言。

meaning: 黑燧石；一種深色、細粒的燧石。
sentences: Geologists found lydite in the gravel bed. 地質學家在礫石層中找到黑燧石。
The arrowhead was carved from lydite. 那個箭頭以黑燧石雕成。

meaning: 鹼液，尤指氫氧化鈉或氫氧化鉀的強鹼溶液。

meaning: 無腦膜褶皺類；一類腦部構造分類名。

meaning: （解剖學、古語）腦表面平滑、缺少腦回和腦溝的；與舊分類名 Lyencephala 有關。
sentences: The treatise called the primitive cortex lyencephalous. 那篇論文把原始皮質稱為腦表面平滑的。
A lyencephalous brain lacks the usual convolutions. 腦表面平滑的腦部缺少通常的褶皺。

meaning: 長蝽科的植物吸汁害蟲。

The lygaeid pierced the seed coat with its sucking beak. 長蝽用刺吸式口器刺穿種皮。

meaning: 狂犬病的；與狂犬病或其病理特徵有關。
sentences: The clinic reviewed the dog’s lyssic symptoms. 診所檢視了那隻狗的狂犬病症狀。
A lyssic infection can damage the nervous system. 狂犬病感染可能損害神經系統。

meaning: 狂犬病恐懼症；對感染狂犬病的強烈、不成比例恐懼，屬罕見醫學用語。
sentences: Severe lyssophobia made the traveler avoid every stray dog. 嚴重狂犬病恐懼症使那名旅客避開每隻流浪狗。
Therapy helped her manage lyssophobia after the bite healed. 咬傷痊癒後，治療幫助她控制狂犬病恐懼症。

meaning: 裂解的；與細胞或組織分解、溶解有關，屬罕見生物學形容詞。
sentences: The lyterian process released enzymes into the tissue. 裂解過程將酶釋放到組織中。
Pathologists described the lesion as lyterian. 病理學家形容該病灶具有裂解性。

meaning: 千屈菜科，包含千屈菜等開花植物。
sentences: Lythraceae is the family of loosestrifes and pomegranates. 千屈菜科包含千屈菜與石榴等植物。
Lythraceae flowers often have crumpled petals and many stamens. 千屈菜科花朵常有皺褶花瓣與許多雄蕊。

meaning: 屬於千屈菜科，包括珍珠菜、石榴、指甲花、菱角和紫薇。
sentences: The garden is full of lythraceous shrubs that bloom in the summer. 花園裡到處都是在夏天開花的千屈菜科灌木。
Crape myrtle is a popular lythraceous tree used for landscaping. 紫薇是一種常用於景觀美化的熱門千屈菜科樹木。

meaning: 千屈菜屬，千屈菜科的草本植物分類屬。
sentences: Lythrum is a genus of wetland herbs with clustered flowers. 千屈菜屬是花朵成簇的濕地草本分類屬。
Lythrum salicaria bears purple spikes beside streams. 千屈菜會在溪流旁長出紫色花穗。

meaning: 裂解的；能使細胞破裂，或與細胞裂解過程有關。
sentences: A lytic phage ruptures its bacterial host. 裂解性噬菌體會使細菌宿主破裂。
The drug triggered a lytic response in infected cells. 藥物在受感染細胞中引發了裂解反應。

meaning: 犬及其他食肉動物舌下的棒狀軟骨；古人曾誤認為是導致狂犬病的蠕蟲。
sentences: Veterinary anatomy locates the lytta beneath a dog’s tongue. 獸醫解剖學把這條棒狀軟骨定位在狗舌下。
Earlier writers mistook the lytta for a rabies-causing worm. 早期作者誤把這條軟骨當成導致狂犬病的蠕蟲。

meaning: 木糖的一種立體異構物；一種天然存在的醛戊糖，曾在細菌多醣中被發現。
sentences: Chemists identified lyxose in a bacterial polysaccharide. 化學家在細菌多醣中鑑定出木糖的一種異構物。
Pure lyxose has the formula of an aldopentose. 純木酮糖的分子式符合醛戊糖。
